title: Service Operations Manager
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Manager, Service Operations is a management role, responsible for leading and overseeing the successful delivery of support services to clients within a Region/Country or Services Division.
  
  
The Manager, Service Operations is a people management role responsible for ensuring achievement of organisational and team objectives and fostering a collaborative and motivated work environment.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**

* Manages service delivery to clients.
* Manages client incidents by investigating and providing solutions that help solve client problems as escalated by team leaders and engineers.
* Works with client delivery teams to evaluate client reviews to ensure proactive incident management at client sites.
* Ensures that the standard client information repository related to technology, operations manuals, etc. is current and accurate.
* Creates and maintains a comprehensive list of client requirements, the scope of deliverables, technology and the delivery model.
* Runs the support services operations in alignment with the service management service operations (SMSO) process, delivering promised outcomes to clients.
* Provides operational support and continuous service improvement post client handover from Technical Services (or other) teams.
* Plans and implements key service improvement priorities based on a continual service improvement approach.
* Ensures that tracking and monitoring of the performance of service delivery through all channels (human, digital, self-service, automated) is carried out, metrics and reports are analyzed, and issues are resolved.
* Responsible for the day to day running of the Support Services Operations team in line with the performance established by the business.
* Ensures maximum uptime and the accurate and early response to client operational issues.
* Responsible for resource planning and work allocation to meet agreed service levels.
* Identifies opportunities for continuous service improvement.
* Engages with clients for technical operations as part of routine operations.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Advanced organizational and team management skills.
* Excellent communication skills – both verbal and written coupled with excellent ability to collaborate with internal stakeholders and external clients.
* Advanced understanding of budgets and cost management.
* Excellent time management, prioritization and delegation abilities.
* Advanced focus on client centricity.
* Highly focused on business outcomes.
* Advanced ability to work across different cultures and social groups.
* Ability to work well in a pressurized environment and adapt to changing circumstances.
* Advanced service management service operations (SMSO) expertise.

**Academic qualifications and certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology or Business Administration or related, with significant experience in Infrastructure Service Operations.
* ITIL certification(s) preferred.

**Required experience:**

* Advanced experience in service delivery management position within a large scale (preferably multi-national) technology services environment across a range of services.
* Advanced experience in a service delivery environment including technical and service management exposure.
* Advanced experience leading and managing a team.
* Advanced experience designing, implementing, and running a service delivery model.

**Workplace type:**
Hybrid Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune
  
  
Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through
  
  
responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with
  
  
unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and
  
  
application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move
  
  
confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more
  
  
than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as
  
  
established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each
  
  
year in R&D.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.
  
  
**Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters**
NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters whether in writing or by phone in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. title: Partner operations Manager
description:
**About Legodesk**

Legodesk is legal-powered recovery infrastructure for Indian lenders: banks, NBFCs, fintechs and ARCs.

We run our clients' end-to-end legal recovery workflow. That covers legal notices, execution proceedings, suit filing, arbitration, Section 138 cases, insolvency and consumer matters. The work is delivered through our technology platform and a network of partner advocates across India.

We are profitable, ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certified, CERT-In empanelled, and incubated at IIM Bangalore's NSRCEL.

**Legal Background not Required**

If you have managed external partners who don't report to you, we want to hear from you. Examples include field agents, collection agencies, delivery or logistics partners, distributors, franchisees, freelancers or empanelled vendors. We will teach you the legal process.

**Why join**

* Build a national legal network with a technology-first operating model.
* Lean, profitable team with direct access to the founders.
* Competitive pay with performance-linked incentives.

**Reports to:**
Revenue team |
**Experience:**
2–4 years

**The role:**
You run the partner network as an operating system. You own allocation, SLAs, performance management, payouts and the processes and tools that let the network scale without adding headcount.

**Responsibilities**

* Own network-level KPIs: allocation turnaround, hearing attendance, update compliance, case throughput and partner cost per case.
* Design and run case allocation by jurisdiction, capacity and partner performance.
* Run the partner scorecard and monthly reviews. Tier, coach or exit partners based on data.
* Administer the milestone-based payout model, with minimal advances and fees released on verified milestones.
* Write SOPs, and work with product and tech to automate allocation, reminders, updates and payouts.
* Lead and develop coordinators as the team grows.
* Report network health and risks to leadership every week.

**Must have**

* 4–7 years in partner or supply operations at a marketplace, gig, logistics, fintech-field or collections company.
* A track record of improving SLAs for a network of external partners at scale.
* Strong analytical skills: you design metrics, dashboards and incentive structures.
* Experience working with product teams on operational automation.

**Good to have**

* Experience of managing coordinators.
* Exposure to legal or collections operations.
* **You might currently be:**
  a Partner Operations Manager, Supply Operations Manager, Fleet or Partner Manager, or Field Operations Manager.

title: Workplace Programs Manager
description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* 12 years of experience in workplace programs (e.g., food, events, transportation) or a related area like real estate, sustainability, or project management.
* 12 years of experience in facility management, hospitality, corporate services, or property management.
* Experience in vendor or contract management.
* Experience developing and executing communications and engagement strategy.
* Experience in a leadership role.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* 15 years of experience in the hospitality industry managing food program, event planning and coordination. Experience in a technical discipline and business, or management, demonstrating a blend of technical acumen and business/financial leadership.
* Significant experience in a high-tech, fast-paced environment with the ability to prioritize multiple and changing initiatives.
* Knowledge and experience managing event operations, Audiovisual (AV) Systems, stage lighting and rigging, event power requirements, hybrid and virtual event technologies, technical production management, etc.
* Fluent in AI/ML tools, understanding of their applicability, functionality, and limitations.

**About The Job**
We are seeking a dynamic and organized Event Manager to oversee and execute high-stakes internal and external events across Google's offices in India. This role focuses on delivering seamless event operations with strong technical expertise in audiovisual (AV) systems, stage lighting, event power setup, and hybrid event technologies. You will be passionate about creating memorable experiences, managing complex technical logistics, and collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams and external vendors.
  
  
As the Event Manager for India, you will be responsible for defining an ambitious operational vision, strategic roadmap, and performance standards for event infrastructure and operations across our campus facilities. You will lead technical production teams, AV engineers, lighting technicians, and external vendors to deliver event experiences. You will serve as the single point of accountability for event technology readiness, ensuring high-voltage power stability, seamless hybrid/virtual streaming, and flawless AV/lighting integration across large-scale gatherings, corporate summits, and executive presentations.
  
  
Leveraging deep event management experience and a strong technical background, you will drive core objectives focused on event reliability, technical production quality, and AI integration for event workflows. Specifically, you will implement innovative event tech solutions, maintain strategic supplier relationships with technical equipment vendors, leverage data-driven post-event insights, and manage event budgets to ensure scalable and impactful event execution across India.
  
  
The Real Estate and Workplace Services (REWS) team creates inspiring spaces and innovative services that bring Google’s culture and values to life. We build and maintain all aspects of what keeps our Googley workspaces operating seamlessly across multiple cities and regions globally. We also manage the industry-leading services that help make Google a great place to work -- from how we design healthy and collaborative workspaces, create energizing food experiences, provide convenient transportation and fitness options, to delivering environments where Google and our employees can thrive.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Set the operational vision and technical standards for event execution across India, establishing long-term roadmaps for AV infrastructure, hybrid platforms, and venue tech setup.
* Provide technical leadership to production crews, AV engineers, lighting designers, and sound engineers, ensuring flawless execution of high-stakes events and broadcasts.
* Oversee end-to-end event logistics, power distribution management, stage design, and venue technical readiness across multi-city office spaces in India.
* Establish clear SLAs and performance metrics for external AV providers, staging crews, event technology platforms, and equipment rental partners.
* Build and maintain robust relationships with leading production houses, event tech providers, facility power engineers, and cross-functional Google teams.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Job desc CarCutter
description:
**About CarCutter**
CarCutter is a leading SaaS solution for automotive image enhancement. Our technology helps dealerships and marketplaces create high-quality vehicle imagery at scale through mobile image capture and AI-powered image processing.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a permanent Customer Support & Automation Lead to lead and transform our Care function.
  
  
This is a hands-on leadership role combining team management, operational excellence, automation, and AI adoption. You will help build a more scalable, efficient, and data-driven support organization while maintaining a high-quality customer experience.
  
  
You will report to the Head of Customer Experience and Operations, based in Paris, France, and work closely with Customer Success, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Operations.
  
  
The position is based in Bengaluru, India.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop the Care team, creating a culture of ownership, quality, and continuous improvement.
* Manage daily support operations, workload distribution, ticket prioritization, escalations, coaching, and performance reviews.
* Assess and improve support processes, workflows, tools, and team capabilities.
* Own the roadmap for support automation and AI adoption.
* Improve the use of Zendesk workflows, triggers, views, macros, automations, reporting, and integrations.
* Identify opportunities to automate or simplify repetitive support activities.
* Evaluate and implement AI-assisted capabilities such as response suggestions, ticket summaries, knowledge recommendations, translation, customer context consolidation, automated quality evaluation, and AI-powered support experiences.
* Maintain a structured knowledge base, including SOPs, troubleshooting guides, response templates, and escalation procedures.
* Define and monitor key support metrics, including response and resolution times, SLA compliance, customer satisfaction, backlog, escalation rate, automation rate, and quality scores.
* Use support data to identify recurring issues and turn insights into coaching, process, and product improvements.
* Act as the escalation point for complex or high-impact customer issues.
* Work with Product and Engineering to communicate recurring customer problems and follow technical issues through to resolution.
* Prepare regular support performance and improvement reports for the Head of Customer Experience and Operations.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* Several years of experience in customer support, customer operations, or Care, including experience leading a support team.
* Strong hands-on experience with Zendesk is required, including workflows, triggers, views, macros, automations, reporting, or integrations.
* Proven experience improving support processes and operational efficiency.
* Practical experience using, testing, or implementing AI tools in a customer support environment.
* Strong understanding of support KPIs, SLAs, quality assurance, and customer experience measurement.
* Experience managing escalations and collaborating with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, or Sales.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to use data to identify problems and guide operational decisions.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Knowledge of HubSpot and/or Zoho.
* Experience with Zendesk AI, Copilot, AI agents, chatbots, Make, Zapier, APIs, or webhooks.
* Experience with knowledge management, technical support, SaaS products, or automated quality assurance.
* Experience in the automotive, marketplace, imaging, or AI industry.

Personal Qualities
  
  
You are a people-focused leader with a hands-on, structured, and analytical mindset. You are curious about technology, comfortable challenging existing processes, and able to distinguish useful AI applications from unnecessary complexity.
  
  
You take ownership from idea to implementation, communicate clearly with both frontline teams and senior stakeholders, and understand that automation should improve, not diminish, the customer experience.

title: Housekeeping Manager
description:
**Manager – Housekeeping (Bangalore) | Z Hotels | Zolo**

**Own hygiene standards. Lead the team. Protect room readiness.**

**Company Name:**
ZoloStays

**Designation:**
Manager – Housekeeping

**Location:**
Marathahalli - Bangalore

**Salary Range:**
up to 8 LPA (Subject to hike according to market standards)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience Required:**
5 – 7 years in Hotel housekeeping

**Why this role exists**

In hospitality, brand trust starts inside the room. Guests may forgive delays. They may even forgive small service gaps. But they rarely forgive poor cleanliness. At Z Hotels, housekeeping is not just about cleaning rooms.

It is about:

* Protecting guest trust
* Maintaining brand standards
* Ensuring operational readiness every single day

As the hotel business scales:

* Room inventory increases
* Occupancy rises
* Turnaround pressure becomes higher
* Guest expectations become non-negotiable

Cleanliness cannot depend on individuals alone. It must be: Governed + Audited + Enforced consistently.

The biggest operational failures usually happen when:

* Room cleanliness varies across shifts
* Room readiness delays impact check-ins
* Audit discipline weakens
* Linen and consumable leakage increases
* Team productivity is not controlled
* Complaints are handled reactively instead of structurally

Without strong housekeeping leadership:

* Guest complaints increase
* Ratings decline
* Occupancy flow gets disrupted
* Operational costs increase
* Brand credibility weakens

**This role exists to ensure:**

* Zero-compromise cleanliness standards across the hotel
* Rooms remain inspection-ready before guest check-ins
* Housekeeping operations run with strict SOP discipline
* Inventory and costs remain tightly controlled
* Audit and safety compliance stay consistently strong

**If this role is strong:**

* Guest ratings improve consistently
* Check-ins happen smoothly without delays
* Teams operate with discipline and accountability
* Costs remain controlled and predictable
* Brand trust strengthens significantly

**If this role is weak:**

* Complaints and escalations increase
* Readiness delays disrupt operations
* Hygiene standards become inconsistent
* Cost leakages rise
* Operational reliability weakens

This role directly controls: Ratings + room readiness + operational discipline + brand trust

**Your mandate is clear**

* Maintain zero-compromise cleanliness standards
* Ensure room readiness before timelines
* Build disciplined housekeeping execution across shifts
* Control housekeeping inventory and costs
* Ensure audit and compliance readiness consistently

This is not a supervision role. This is a cleanliness governance and operational standards leadership role.

**About Zolo and Z Hotels**

Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent. People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options. Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.

* Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.
* Z Vacations enables meaningful travel experiences.
* Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.

Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life. Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation by partnering deeply with property owners who think long term.

**Z Hotels is built on:**

* Consistency
* Reliability
* Operational discipline

The hospitality model works only when:

* Rooms are clean every single time
* Turnaround remains fast and predictable
* Standards are enforced daily
* Costs are controlled tightly without compromising quality

At scale: Housekeeping becomes the backbone of guest experience.

This role directly impacts: Guest trust + ratings + readiness + operational reliability

**What you will be responsible for**

1. Own Cleanliness Governance & Brand Standards

* Conduct regular room inspections across shifts
* Design and enforce housekeeping audit checklists
* Identify recurring hygiene gaps proactively
* Drive deep-cleaning schedules and hygiene programs
* Maintain consistency in room standards daily
* Enforce zero tolerance for hygiene compromise

2. Lead Team Performance & Accountability

* Assign daily workload and operational zones clearly
* Track housekeeping productivity and output
* Conduct structured team reviews and coaching
* Correct underperformance quickly and professionally
* Build supervisory capability and second-line leadership
* Maintain discipline and professionalism across shifts

3. Govern Inventory & Cost Discipline

* Track linen movement, inventory, and usage carefully
* Control shrinkage, pilferage, and damage proactively
* Monitor chemical consumption and usage discipline
* Track vendor supplies, quality, and billing accuracy
* Flag cost overruns and operational leakages early
* Plan procurement requirements proactively

4. Drive Speed, Turnaround & Room Readiness

* Align staffing plans with occupancy forecasts
* Coordinate closely with front office for room readiness
* Prioritize early check-ins and operational urgencies
* Reduce room turnaround time systematically
* Prevent readiness delays during peak occupancy
* Maintain smooth check-in operational flow

5. Ensure Audit, Safety & Compliance

* Conduct regular hygiene and safety audits
* Ensure safe chemical handling and storage discipline
* Maintain equipment handling standards consistently
* Ensure housekeeping documentation remains audit-ready
* Train teams on hygiene, safety, and compliance protocols

6. Protect Guest Experience

* Handle serious cleanliness complaints personally
* Respond immediately to urgent guest concerns
* Coordinate service recovery with front office teams
* Identify root causes for repeat complaints
* Ensure issue closure and long-term prevention

**What success looks like after 12 months**

* Rooms consistently pass internal and external audits
* Guest complaints on cleanliness remain minimal
* SOP adherence remains strong across shifts
* Housekeeping costs stay within operational targets
* Team productivity becomes stable and predictable
* Zero safety or compliance violations occur
* Peak occupancy operations remain smooth and controlled

The housekeeping function begins to feel: Structured + Predictable + Scalable—not reactive.

**Who this role is for**

You will likely thrive here if:

* You have zero tolerance for hygiene compromise
* You notice operational gaps quickly
* You enforce standards firmly and consistently
* You can discipline and develop teams effectively
* You understand operational cost control deeply
* You balance speed with quality naturally

**Experience we value**

5–7 years in:

* Hotel housekeeping
* Hospitality operations
* Housekeeping leadership roles

Experience managing:

* Teams
* Audits
* Inventory
* Room readiness operations
* Strong exposure to SOP-driven environments preferred
* Hospitality background is strongly preferred.
* Operational discipline is non-negotiable.

**The impact you will have**

* Direct impact on guest ratings and reviews
* Protect room readiness and occupancy flow
* Improve housekeeping productivity and discipline
* Control operational costs and inventory leakage
* Strengthen brand credibility and hospitality standards

**Why join now**

Z Hotels is scaling rapidly. As occupancy increases: Housekeeping discipline becomes the biggest differentiator.

This role offers:

* Full ownership of cleanliness and readiness standards
* Strong operational leadership visibility
* Exposure to large-scale hospitality operations
* Growth into Cluster Housekeeping / Ops leadership roles

**APPLY NOW**

title: Store Manager
description:

title: Partner Enablement Operations Manager
description:
FEQ327R583
  
  
The Partner Enablement Operations Manager is a senior operator and builder responsible for designing and running a scalable, predictable, and data-driven operating model for partner enablement at Databricks.
  
  
This role serves as the operational backbone and strategic integrator for partner enablement, connecting global strategy to regional execution across AMER, EMEA, and APJ regions while ensuring programs are delivered consistently, efficiently, and at scale.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings strong executive presence, systems thinking, and a bias for automation. They know how to reduce operational friction, build governance that scales, and introduce AI-enabled workflows that improve responsiveness without adding unnecessary complexity or headcount.
  
  
We are looking for A builder who can architect operating systems, drive cross-functional alignment, and convert recurring operational friction into structural improvement.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the partner enablement operating model, including core planning cadences, governance mechanisms, and execution frameworks that connect strategy to execution.
* Run QBRs, MBRs, and executive reviews for partner enablement leadership, using clear metrics and forward-looking insights to drive accountability and decision-making.
* Lead end-to-end execution of partner enablement initiatives, ensuring timelines, dependencies, and deliverables are managed effectively across functions and regions.
* Build and maintain dashboards and operating reviews that surface partner engagement, program performance, risk signals, and areas requiring intervention.
* Act as a key point of contact for cross-regional operational issues and escalations, resolving immediate friction while converting recurring issues into structural improvements.
* Design and implement scalable workflows, SOPs, SLAs, and intake mechanisms that improve consistency, reduce manual effort, and create a better experience for internal stakeholders and partners.
* Introduce AI-enabled and automation-first workflows for intake, reporting, support, certification, and partner operations where they can safely improve speed, quality, and scale.
* Collaborate closely with the Partner organization, Learning and Enablement, Professional Services, and other cross-functional teams to remove friction and improve execution across the partner ecosystem.
* Partner closely with the broader operations business to drive cross-functional leverage of ideas and excellence, ensuring new methods and operational innovations are scaled beyond just partner operations.
* Establish clear ownership models, decision rights, and governance guardrails to support regional nuance without creating shadow processes or operational inconsistencies.
* Architect and maintain automated intake management workflows and SLA tracking mechanisms to optimize request processing and eliminate wait-time bottlenecks.
* Establish standardized metric definitions and executive reporting frameworks that pair activity and outcome indicators to ensure reporting integrity across cross-functional teams.

**What You Bring**
**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in Learning Operations, Program Management, Professional Services Operations, or a related operational leadership field in a high-growth technology environment.
* Proven experience supporting global or multi-region teams and translating central strategy into executable operating plans.
* Preferred experience in the Data & AI space, with a strong understanding of Databricks' platform capabilities, key differentiators, and end-to-end solutions, and the ability to work effectively with technical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ownership of operating cadence, forecasting, planning, and execution frameworks in a complex, matrixed environment.
* Strong analytical capability and the ability to turn data into executive insight, operational decisions, and measurable business outcomes.
* Experience improving processes and workflows, with a clear track record of reducing manual effort and increasing scale through automation or AI-enabled solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions without direct authority.
* Ability to work independently, manage priorities across time zones, and drive execution in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
* Must be open to working a flexible schedule, including frequent late hours to accommodate discussions with the broader enablement team and partner liaisons, the majority of whom are based in the AMER timezone.
* Demonstrated ability to drive cross-functional alignment and lead strategic delivery across matrixed global organizations.
* Experience designing and optimizing workflow automation, structured intake management, and operational reporting engines with strict metric definition discipline.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in partner enablement, customer education, learning operations, or training operations.
* Deep expertise working with and for System Integrators (SIs) and ISVs, with a strong grasp of their core operational principles and business models.
* Fluency with AI tools, workflow automation, and analytics platforms used to streamline operations and generate actionable insights.
* Strong commercial and operational acumen, including comfort with utilization, forecasting, partner spend, margin thinking, or RevOps-aligned execution.
* Experience operating in a highly matrixed international environment with sensitivity to regional and cultural nuance.

**Why Join Us**
You will play a central role in shaping how partner enablement scales at Databricks.
  
  
This is a high-visibility role with meaningful impact, offering the opportunity to build a more efficient, governed, and AI-enabled operating model that helps our partner ecosystem grow with the business.
  
  
If you enjoy turning ambiguity into structure, building systems that remove friction, and helping teams scale through better operations rather than more manual work, this role is for you.
  
  
**Success Metrics**

* Operational Predictability: Build a disciplined partner enablement operating cadence where risks are surfaced early and execution is measurable and consistent.
* Stakeholder Experience and Self-Sufficiency: Increase the percentage of standard partner enablement requests handled through structured, low-touch, or self-service workflows.
* Escalation Management and Process Resilience: Reduce recurring operational friction by improving escalation handling, clarifying ownership, and improving systemic resolution of recurring issues.
* Scalable Execution: Improve throughput, consistency, and delivery quality across global partner enablement programs without relying on incremental manual work.
* AI-Enabled Transformation: Deploy practical AI-enabled workflows that improve speed, visibility, and efficiency across intake, reporting, support, and partner operations.

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Operations Manager — Child Health Programs, SKIDS

Bengaluru | Full-time | On-site with school and clinic visits

About SKIDS

SKIDS delivers preventive child health screening and coordinated care through schools and clinics. We are seeking a healthcare professional who can lead teams and translate clinical workflows into dependable day-to-day operations.

Responsibilities

• Plan and supervise clinic operations and school-screening schedules, staffing, equipment and logistics.

• Recruit, onboard, train and supervise screening and support teams in coordination with leadership.

• Ensure equipment readiness, consumables availability, infection-control practices and adherence to approved SOPs.

• Coordinate consent collection, accurate data capture, clinician review and timely parent reports.

• Manage parent and school communication, referral coordination and follow-up tracking.

• Monitor attendance, productivity, reporting turnaround, service quality and operating costs.

• Resolve delivery issues, document incidents and escalate clinical concerns promptly to the appropriate clinician.

• Maintain operational records and improve workflows using digital tools and regular team reviews.

• Support quality audits and expansion to new partner locations.

Requirements

• BDS, a degree in Optometry, or a relevant recognised qualification in Behavioural Therapy. This is an operations role requiring one of these clinical or allied-health backgrounds.

• Preferably 3–6 years of relevant healthcare experience, including team supervision or operations coordination.

• Experience in clinics, school-health programs, community screening or child-development services is preferred.

• Strong planning, staff coordination, parent communication and digital documentation skills.

• English communication; Kannada is an advantage. Willingness to travel locally between partner schools and clinics.

• A child-centred approach, sound judgement and attention to privacy, consent and service quality.

Professional scope

Clinical activities must remain within each professional's qualifications, registration requirements and authorised scope. Clinical decisions and abnormal findings must be referred to the appropriate supervising clinician.

Success measures

Reliable program delivery, complete and accurate records, timely reports and follow-up, well-prepared teams, positive parent and partner experience, and efficient use of resources.

Apply with your CV, professional qualification, and a short example of a team or service-delivery improvement you have led. Do not include identifiable patient information.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of KYC analysts specializing in screening and ongoing monitoring, providing guidance, support, and mentorship.
* Oversee daily operations, ensuring screening alerts and reviews are completed accurately and within defined KRIs and SLAs.

* Collaborate with Compliance, Legal, Risk, and Audit teams to resolve issues and ensure alignment with regulatory expectations.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement by encouraging process enhancements, knowledge sharing, and best practices.
* Communicate key risks, challenges, and operational issues to relevant stakeholders in a timely and effective manner.

* Good understanding of risk management principles.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal.

title: Manager - Customer Experience (Hospitals)
description:
**Job Description – Manager – Customer Experience**
Position: Manager – Customer Experience
  
  
Department: Customer Experience / Hospital Operations
  
  
Level: Central / Corporate
  
  
Location: Bangalore
  
  
Reporting To: Head – Hospital Operations / Business Head
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for an experienced and customer-centric Manager – Customer Experience to drive and standardize the patient and attendant experience across Even Hospitals.
  
  
The role will have central-level ownership of Customer Experience, Housekeeping, and Security, ensuring consistent service standards, operational discipline, safety, cleanliness, and hospitality across all hospital units.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be highly hands-on, data-driven, and strong in stakeholder management, with the ability to identify gaps, implement processes, and continuously improve the overall patient journey.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Customer Experience
* Own the overall patient and attendant experience across Even Hospitals.
* Define and implement standardized Customer Experience (CX) processes, SOPs and service standards across all units.
* Map the end-to-end patient journey and identify opportunities to improve experience at every touchpoint.
* Monitor patient feedback, complaints, grievances, NPS/CSAT and other CX metrics.
* Establish a structured VOC (Voice of Customer) mechanism and ensure timely closure of feedback.
* Drive root-cause analysis for recurring complaints and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Work closely with Clinical, Nursing, Front Office, Operations, Billing and other teams to resolve patient experience issues.
* Develop service-recovery mechanisms for escalated patient/attendant concerns.
* Conduct regular audits across hospitals to assess adherence to CX standards.
* Drive initiatives to improve patient satisfaction, service quality and overall hospital experience.
* Housekeeping Management
* Provide central oversight and governance for Housekeeping operations across all hospitals.
* Standardize housekeeping SOPs, cleaning protocols, checklists and service standards.
* Monitor cleanliness and hygiene standards across patient areas, OPD, wards, common areas and other hospital facilities.
* Define and monitor housekeeping manpower requirements, deployment and productivity.
* Conduct regular housekeeping audits and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* Coordinate with vendors/agencies wherever housekeeping services are outsourced.
* Monitor housekeeping consumables, equipment and inventory.
* Work closely with Infection Control and Hospital Operations teams to maintain required hygiene standards.
* Track housekeeping-related complaints and ensure timely resolution.
* Security Management
* Provide central oversight of Security operations across Even Hospitals.
* Establish and maintain security SOPs, access-control protocols and incident-management processes.
* Ensure appropriate security manpower deployment across hospitals and shifts.
* Monitor visitor, patient attendant and staff access protocols.
* Ensure effective management of security incidents, emergencies and escalations.
* Conduct periodic security audits and identify gaps in hospital safety and security.
* Coordinate with hospital leadership and external security agencies where applicable.
* Drive security training, discipline and service standards for security personnel.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and reporting of security incidents.
* Central Governance & Standardization
* Develop common CX, Housekeeping and Security standards across all Even Hospitals.
* Create dashboards and monthly MIS covering key operational and experience metrics.
* Conduct periodic reviews with Unit Operations Heads and relevant stakeholders.
* Identify best practices from individual hospitals and implement them across the network.
* Drive cross-functional projects aimed at improving operational efficiency and customer experience.
* Support new hospital/unit launches by establishing CX, housekeeping and security processes from day one.
* People & Vendor Management
* Lead and mentor CX/housekeeping/security teams either directly or through respective unit managers.
* Define manpower requirements and productivity benchmarks.
* Participate in recruitment and onboarding of key team members.
* Set performance standards and KPIs for teams and vendors.
* Manage outsourced service providers and ensure adherence to agreed SLAs.
* Conduct regular vendor performance reviews and drive improvements.

Key Performance Indicators
  
  

* Patient NPS / CSAT
* Patient complaints and escalation rate
* Complaint resolution TAT
* Customer feedback closure %
* Housekeeping audit scores
* Hospital cleanliness and hygiene scores
* Security audit scores
* Security incidents and response TAT
* Housekeeping & Security manpower productivity
* Vendor SLA adherence
* Patient experience improvement initiatives
* Reduction in recurring complaints
* Compliance with hospital/NABH standards

Candidate Profile
  
  

* Experience: 10 - 15 years of experience in Customer Experience, Hospital Operations, Hospitality, Facility Management or a similar service-oriented environment.
* Experience in healthcare/hospital operations would be strongly preferred.
* Prior experience managing Housekeeping and Security will be an advantage.
* Strong understanding of patient/customer experience and service quality.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work across multiple hospitals/locations.
* Strong execution orientation with the ability to work hands-on at the unit level.
* Experience in SOP creation, audits, MIS and process improvement.
* Should be comfortable managing internal teams as well as external vendors.

Ideal Candidate
  
  
Someone who can act as the central CX owner for Even Hospitals and ensure that a patient receives a consistent, safe, clean and high-quality experience irrespective of which Even Hospital they visit.
  
  
**Key Focus**
Customer Experience + Housekeeping + Security + Service Standards + Audits + Continuous Improvement.
  
  
Skills: customer experience,hospital operations,hospitals,customer experience, housekeeping, security , service standards,

title: Manager Financial Operations
description:
Teamwork makes the stream work.**Roku is changing how the world watches TV**

Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.

From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.

**What is the role?**

The Manager, Financial Operations will lead the day-to-day execution of financial close operations, multi-partner reconciliation, data pipeline governance, and operational reporting within Roku's Revenue Infrastructure function. This role owns the hands-on delivery of reconciliation workflows, journal entry execution, exception management, data quality assurance, and operational analytics that underpin Commerce Platform financial integrity. Operating as the execution arm of the Financial Systems & Controls pillar, this leader ensures that month-end close, daily reconciliation, partner settlement validation, and financial data operations are completed accurately, on time, and with full auditability. The role manages a team of Financial Operations Analysts and partners closely with Revenue Accounting, Treasury, Platform Engineering, and Payment Operations to deliver reliable, scalable financial operations across the Commerce ecosystem. This role bridges the gap between strategic financial architecture and the analyst-level execution that delivers production outcomes. The ideal candidate combines strong operational execution discipline with financial systems knowledge, SQL/Python proficiency, reconciliation expertise, and people management experience in high-volume commerce, payments, fintech, or subscription environments.

**How will I use AI at Roku?**

At Roku, we don't just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability.

We value curious, adaptable builders, who can show how they've used AI, agents, or automation to move faster, improve quality, and scale their impact. Strong candidates know how to frame problems, guide AI-assisted work, check the output, and learn quickly. Above all, they bring curiosity, adaptability, and sound judgment.

**What are the responsibilities of the role?**

* Oversee and review the team's end-to-end month-end and quarter-end financial close for Commerce Platform revenue, liabilities, and partner payables — own the close calendar, priorities, and on-time completion
* Direct and review the team's execution and validation of automated journal entries across revenue recognition, deferred revenue, chargebacks, and partner settlements; ensure posting failures are investigated and resolved
* Partner with Revenue Accounting and Treasury to resolve close blockers, inter-company settlements, and timing differences; represent the team in US / PST close reviews
* Ensure the team maintains close checklists, run books, and process documentation, and that SOX evidence packages are complete and audit-ready
* Oversee the team's daily and monthly multi-partner reconciliation workflows across authorization-to-settlement, settlement-to-payout, and bank reconciliation
* Review, triage, and prioritize reconciliation breaks, exceptions, and discrepancies; ensure the team resolves them within SLAs
* Monitor exception aging trackers and drive resolution, escalating to payment processors, banks, and internal teams as needed
* Guide root-cause investigation on recurring breaks; review the team's findings and approve process fixes for implementation
* Oversee partner onboarding into reconciliation workflows against readiness criteria and acceptance standards
* Direct the team's build and maintenance of operational dashboards (Looker / Tableau) tracking reconciliation status, exception rates, close timelines, and pipeline health; review them for accuracy
* Review and present weekly and monthly operational status reports to leadership — exception aging, SLA performance, pipeline uptime
* Direct ad-hoc analytical support for financial investigations, partner disputes, and settlement discrepancy research; review outputs before they reach stakeholders
* Ensure the team executes SOX control activities for owned financial workflows; review control steps, evidence, and test results
* Oversee preparation and delivery of audit evidence packages for internal and external audit requests within required timelines; act as the primary point of contact
* Review day-to-day processes for control gaps and operational risks; escalate for framework-level decisions
* Ensure standard operating procedures (SOPs) with clear RACI ownership are maintained for all operational workflows
* Set clear expectations and allocate daily workload across reconciliation, close, data operations, and reporting; follow up and track every deliverable to closure
* Review and quality-check the team's deliverables (reconciliations, journals, dashboards, reports) before release — hold the bar on accuracy, timeliness, and documentation
* Drive skill development in SQL, Python, financial analysis, and reconciliation methodologies; conduct regular one-on-ones and career development conversations
* Run daily connects / standups with the India team, plan and track work, remove blockers, and ensure operational continuity during US business hours
* Proactively identify manual, repetitive, or error-prone areas and direct the team to build automation (Python scripts, Airflow DAGs, SQL procedures) that reduces toil
* Champion AI adoption within the team — leverage AI tools to accelerate development, surface patterns in data, and improve productivity
* Define and track monthly KPIs and performance metrics for the team — throughput, error rates, SLA adherence, and automation coverage
* Foster an analytical, data-driven mindset — encourage hypothesis-driven investigation, evidence-based decisions, and connecting the dots across workflows
* Build a culture of documentation and knowledge sharing — ensure processes are organized, repeatable, and not dependent on any single individual

**What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku?**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, or a quantitative field
* 7+ years in Financial Operations, Revenue Operations, Reconciliation, or Commerce / Payments, including 3+ years directly managing analyst teams (ideally distributed / offshore teams supporting US-based stakeholders)
* Strong working proficiency in SQL (window functions, CTEs, complex joins across large datasets) — enough to review and guide the team's analytical work
* Familiarity with Python for data automation and scripting — enough to review and guide the automation the team builds
* Experience with data warehouse platforms (such as Snowflake), ETL/orchestration tools (Airflow, dbt), and BI tools (Looker, Tableau)
* Experience operating in high-volume commerce, payments, or subscription environments with multi-currency, multi-partner complexity
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to investigate discrepancies, perform root-cause analysis, and drive resolution
* Detail-oriented with high standards for accuracy, timeliness, and documentation
* Demonstrated ability to identify automation opportunities and implement solutions that reduce manual effort by measurable margins
* Experience using AI/ML tools or LLMs to enhance operational workflows, data analysis, or code generation
* Proven people-management track record — leading, mentoring, and developing analyst teams; allocating work, reviewing output, following up to closure, and getting results through others
* Strong decision-making skills with the ability to balance speed, accuracy, and risk in a fast-paced operational environment
* Demonstrated ability to work across time zones and partner effectively with US-based stakeholders
* Effective communication skills — ability to explain complex financial/data issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Experience in streaming, media, ecommerce, or digital subscription businesses is a plus
* Experience with payment settlement operations across multiple processors (such as Adyen, PayPal, Braintree) is a plus
* Familiarity with financial controls frameworks (SOX, SOC2) and audit processes is a plus
* Experience building automated reconciliation solutions or financial data pipelines from scratch is a plus
* Experience with Git/GitLab version control for SQL/Python code management is a plus
* Experience with Jupyter Notebooks for financial analysis and data exploration is a plus

**What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?**

Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.

**What are some of the benefits?**

Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.

**Accommodations**

Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to EmployeeRelations@Roku.com.

**What should I know about Roku's culture?**

Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV.

We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002.

To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet.

By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's Applicant Privacy Notice, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing WorkforcePrivacy@Roku.com.

It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

**About The Role**
The Benefits team is a cornerstone of Rippling's product offerings, and the Benefits Operations Health Carrier Connections team is essential for ensuring a seamless, automated flow of enrolment and eligibility data across both 1st-party and 3rd-party carrier networks. We manage a high volume of complex health insurance data exchanges every month, and we're looking for an Operations Supervisor to lead our India-based team of Customer Experience (CX) Specialists. In this role, you will manage a dedicated team of individual contributors, driving operational excellence, unblocking technical hurdles with carriers, and ensuring our clients experience flawless benefits administration
  
  
Your team will be responsible for managing end-to-end CX cases, directly addressing health insurance connection issues, and ensuring an outstanding experience for our clients. By focusing on rapid dispute resolution, proactive carrier communication, and maintaining top-tier data accuracy, your team will play a crucial role in keeping client operations running smoothly while delivering world-class customer satisfaction
  
  
This role requires you to be a proactive problem-solver, supporting your team in addressing and resolving complex health insurance system and process issues. You will not only guide your team through identifying root causes but also contribute to implementing fixes that prevent future connection delays and data mismatches. Your work will involve significant collaboration with clients, 1st-party and 3rd-party health carriers, external vendors, and various internal departments. Ultimately, you will have a major impact on the success of Rippling's Benefits platform and the overall satisfaction of our customers
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Oversee and guide a team of Health Carrier Connection CX Specialists, providing the support necessary to ensure the smooth handling and resolution of 1st-party and 3rd-party health insurance carrier connection cases.
* Lead critical and complex escalations from the front, stepping into high-stakes client or carrier situations to de-escalate tension, restore confidence, and personally drive swift resolutions
* Track adherence to team SLAs, response times, and quality benchmarks, proactively identifying and addressing any gaps to ensure an outstanding customer experience.
* Provide consistent, high-quality coaching and constructive feedback to team members to foster their professional growth and maintain high performance.
* Act as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders and work closely with clients and carriers to resolve escalated CX and integration issues.
* Contribute to process design, optimisation of existing workflows, and the creation of new standard operating procedures (SOPs) by working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and other internal partner teams.

**What You Will Need**

* 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing operational role, ideally within Implementation, Product support and a minimum of 2+ years of experience managing a team
* Proven ability to mentor and develop a team, with a focus on coaching, feedback, and performance management
* 3+ years of experience in EDI file transmissions (834 files or proprietary files) would be good to have
* Strong communication skills (written and verbal) and a deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences.
* Strong project management and organisational skills: good attention to detail with excellent work product, time management, and execution.
* Strong research and process improvement skills.

**Additional Information**
Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

title: Team Lead - CRP Services
description:
**Why join Rolls-Royce?**

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere. Join Rolls-Royce and you could have the opportunity to work in a world-class engineering environment, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

**Job Purpose:**

The Team Lead – CRP Services will lead the GBS team in India in supporting the Civil Aerospace Service Business team in Derby throughout the end-to-end Contract Review Pack process. The role is accountable for day-to-day service delivery, data management, variance and forecast impact analysis, reporting, automation, controls and stakeholder coordination to enable accurate financial forecasting for aftermarket service contracts.

**Role Overview:**

The role leads a small team of analysts responsible for operating controlled CRP processes across multiple systems, executive data sources, Excel, Power BI and purpose-built tools. It ensures the CRP window is delivered accurately, on time and in line with required controls, while driving continuous improvement, automation, resource planning, quality reviews and team development. The Team Lead acts as the primary operational link between the GBS India team and Derby-based Service Business stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the GBS India CRP Services team to deliver an excellent level of service to the Derby-based Civil Aerospace Service Business team.
* Manage the identified elements of the end-to-end operational delivery of Contract Review Pack processes across multiple systems, tools and data sources within agreed timelines and controls.
* Oversee master data management, standardisation and integration across platforms and applications, ensuring data quality supports accurate financial forecasting.
* Own and drive automation and process improvement opportunities using advanced Excel, Power BI, Python, SQL, VBA and other relevant tools to improve accuracy, control and efficiency.
* Manage workflow, resource allocation, service levels and monthly quality reviews in collaboration with Derby-based stakeholders and leadership.
* Lead the setup, revision and documentation of CRP processes, including Standard Operating Procedures, controls and continuous improvement actions.
* Line manage, coach and develop analysts, including performance monitoring, capability building, individual development planning and collaborative problem solving.

**Key Experiences and Qualifications:**

5–8 years of relevant experience in data management, financial analytics, forecasting support, reporting, process improvement or business operations, including experience leading a team or coordinating delivery through others. Aerospace, supply chain, aftermarket services or financial planning experience is desirable. The recommended grade range for this role is GG9–GG10, reflecting a team lead position with operational accountability, stakeholder ownership, people-management responsibility and delivery of continuous improvement across the CRP process.

**Must-Have Skills:**

* Graduate or engineering degree with strong analytical, numerical and business problem-solving capability.
* Experience leading, coaching or coordinating analysts in a time-bound operational or forecasting process.

* Advanced Microsoft Excel capability, including complex data handling, controls and reporting.

* Strong stakeholder management, relationship management and communication skills, including working with UK-based stakeholders.

* Power BI reporting, dashboard development and data visualisation capability.

* Extract, Transform, Load (ETL), data integration and reporting experience.
* Oracle Hyperion Planning or similar financial planning system experience.

Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls-Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your vision too.

Rolls-Royce creates fair and impartial teams and non-discriminatory workplaces where we can all be at our best.

title: Manager Regulatory Intelligence
description:
Redica Systems is a data and analytics SaaS platform that helps regulated industries improve their quality and stay on top of evolving regulations. We are shaping the future of predictive quality with our pioneering work in AI workflows and the development of an exclusive intelligence layer for quality and regulatory data. Our purpose-built processes transform one of the industry’s most complete data sets—aggregated from hundreds of health agencies and unique Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) sourcing—into meaningful answers and insights that reduce regulatory and compliance risk.

Founded in 2010, Redica Systems serves over 200 customers in the Pharma, BioPharma, MedTech, and Food and Cosmetics industries, including 19 of the top 20 Pharma companies and 9 of the 10 top MedTech companies. More information is available at
redica.com.

**The Role**

Redica Systems is looking for a Manager, Regulatory Intelligence to lead a team responsible for monitoring, evaluating, and structuring regulatory developments across 150+ countries.

In this role, you will oversee the quality, accuracy, and timely delivery of regulatory intelligence covering Pharmaceutical, Biologics, MedTech, and Animal Health sectors. You'll guide the team in interpreting regulatory developments, determining industry relevance and impact, and maintaining reliable information within Redica's regulatory intelligence platform.

We're looking for a hands-on leader who brings strong GxP knowledge, sound judgment, and a practical approach to managing people, improving processes, and making effective use of technology.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Data Solutions Coordinators, providing clear priorities, guidance, feedback, and performance management.
* Oversee global regulatory monitoring activities, ensuring relevant developments are identified, evaluated, and processed accurately and on time.
* Guide the team's assessment of regulatory developments, including industry scope, GxP applicability, operational impact, and classification decisions.
* Maintain standards for structured regulatory data, including metadata accuracy, effective dates, consultation deadlines, enforcement timelines, and document relationships.
* Establish and monitor team KPIs covering productivity, quality, accuracy, and turnaround times, addressing gaps and improving performance.
* Manage team workload, resource allocation, and priorities to maintain consistent regulatory coverage and meet operational objectives.
* Work with Product, Engineering, and other internal teams to improve monitoring capabilities, classification logic, quality controls, and workflows.
* Identify opportunities to use AI, automation, and other technologies to improve the efficiency, consistency, and scalability of regulatory intelligence operations.

**About You**

* **Communicates Effectively**
  : Develops and delivers clear, concise communications across multiple platforms, ensuring accurate and timely sharing of regulatory intelligence insights, updates, and trends with teams and stakeholders.
* **Decision Quality**
  : Demonstrates the ability to make good and timely decisions in data operations. Understands the implications of various data choices.
* **Optimizes Work Processes**
  : Demonstrates the ability to enhance and streamline data processes. Seeks opportunities for data process improvement.
* **Business Insight**
  : Demonstrates an understanding of the business and uses this knowledge to inform data decisions
* **Tech Savvy**
  : Demonstrates a basic understanding of current technologies used in data operations. Can effectively use these technologies in daily work and is open to adopting new ones.

**Qualifications**

* 6+ years of experience in Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, GxP, or Regulatory Intelligence within Pharmaceutical, Biologics, Medical Device, or Animal Health industries.
* Previous experience leading, supervising, or managing teams, with demonstrated responsibility for work quality, performance, and delivery.
* Strong understanding of GxP principles and global regulatory frameworks, including the ability to interpret regulatory language and assess industry impact.
* Experience overseeing regulatory monitoring, intelligence gathering, data classification, or compliance-related operations.
* Demonstrated ability to establish quality standards, manage operational KPIs, and improve team workflows.
* Comfortable working with technology-enabled processes, data platforms, and AI or automation tools.
* A Master's degree in Regulatory Affairs, Pharmaceutics, Quality Assurance, or a related discipline is preferred.

Top pharmaceutical companies, food manufacturers, medtech companies, and service firms from around the globe rely on Redica Systems to mine and process government inspection, enforcement, and registration data. This enables them to quantify risk signals from their suppliers, identify market opportunities, benchmark against peers, and prepare for the latest inspection trends.

Our data and analytics have been cited by major media outlets such as MSNBC, The Wall Street Journal, and The Boston Globe.

title: Head of Revenue Operations
description:
**About BHIVE Group:**
BHIVE Group is a Bengaluru-headquartered real estate and workspace company, with a vision to help people live a better quality of life and a mission to become one of India’s most loved and admired real estate companies by 2033.

Its flagship business, BHIVE Workspace, launched in 2014 and is one of India’s leading flexible workspace providers. It offers managed offices, coworking, on-demand and virtual offices, meeting spaces, food and beverage and other workplace services to more than 1,000 clients, from startups to global enterprises.

1. 30+ centres across Bengaluru and Mumbai, with over 2 million sq ft of workspace and around 42,500 seats.
2. Expanding rapidly, with four large new campuses in Bengaluru, including Hebbal and Bellandur, and premium campus formats such as BHIVE Platinum Plus.

**About the Role:**
We are looking for a Head – Revenue Operations to own the efficiency of how BHIVE sells, contracts, serves and renews clients across every revenue line. This is a high-impact leadership role that shapes how a growing, IPO-bound company runs its revenue engine.

You will be accountable for sales and customer management efficiency across the organisation: how well we sell, how well we deliver what we sold, and how well we serve and retain clients. You will lead the revenue operations team and work as a peer to business and sales leaders, driving outcomes through data, process design, systems and cross-functional influence rather than direct reporting lines.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Cross-business revenue mandate:**

* Drive funnel, process and data efficiency across all revenue lines, including managed office, coworking, on-demand workspace, F&B, outbound sales, pre-sales and other monetization.
* Run the weekly revenue review and pipeline forecast with the leadership team.
* Partner with the leaders of each revenue line to put shared processes, systems and data in place, while the business strategy and teams stay with those leaders.
* Ensure customer success and account management delivery is efficient and measurable.
* Partner with Finance to improve collection efficiency upstream, through contracts, billing and early warnings.

**2. Revenue lifecycle: process, SLAs and metrics:**

Own the process, SLAs and metrics across the full client lifecycle, from first enquiry to renewal, and make sure they are followed.

* **Lead capture and source accuracy:**
  every lead captured in the CRM, with the correct source recorded and kept accurate.
* **Qualification and routing:**
  pre-sales qualification and routing to the right sales team, with tracked turnaround times.
* **Site visits:**
  every visitor registered and every visit linked to a deal in the CRM before it happens.
* **Proposals, pricing and approvals:**
  discount and pricing approval workflows followed, with exceptions visible.
* **Contracting:**
  consistent use of the contracting system, fast turnaround and protection of standard terms.
* **Handover and move-in:**
  a clean handover from sales to operations and projects, so we deliver what was sold.
* **Billing and collections:**
  correct billing from day one, timely collection of security deposits, and early flags on overdue accounts.
* **Account management and customer success:**
  set, measure and enforce standards for client meeting cadence, response times, ticket resolution and client communication.
* **Renewals, rebalancing and expansion:**
  visibility of renewals well ahead of expiry, clear ownership and a tracked process for each, and root-cause analysis of churn translated into action with the business teams.

**3. Revenue governance:**

* Own deal attribution rules across direct, broker, channel-partner and referral sources.
* Own broker onboarding and the validation of brokerage payouts before payment.
* Ensure accurate sales incentive calculations.
* Maintain clean, trusted revenue data and strong controls across the lifecycle.

**4. Systems, data and reporting:**

Own how our revenue systems are used and how they talk to each other, with the goal of one trusted source of truth for pipeline, bookings, occupancy and revenue. Judge what the tools should do, not just report from them.

**5. Leading the revenue operations team:**

* Lead, build and develop the revenue operations team.
* Set team priorities, ways of working and quality standards.
* Build the capability to scale revenue operations as the business grows.

**Who You Are:**

* **Experience:**
  you bring 10–15 years of experience, with senior leadership in revenue operations, sales operations or business operations.
* **Background:**
  you come from B2B businesses with recurring revenue and a long client lifecycle, such as flexible workspace, commercial real estate, hospitality or SaaS.
* **Systems depth:**
  you are hands-on with a CRM (HubSpot preferred), and comfortable with data warehouses, integrations and dashboards.
* **Track record:**
  you have built and fixed processes end to end, with measurable results to show, not just reports.
* **Influence:**
  you drive change in teams you do not manage, and hold people to standards without needing authority over them.
* **Seniority:**
  you work as a peer with senior business and sales leaders.
* **Education:**
  you have an MBA (preferred); an engineering or analytical background is a plus.

**Collaboration and communication:**
Proactive monitoring and collaboration with team members and internal departments are necessary to guarantee seamless operations at the centre.

**How the role Interact with other teams or Individuals:**
Ensure effective communication and coordination between different cross functional teams to align the revenue function with overall business goals.

**About the Role:**

. This is an exciting opportunity to build and shape a premium, food-led retail experience from the ground up, bringing together business performance, operational excellence, inspiring people leadership, and outstanding guest experiences.

description:
