title: Head Chef
description:
Key Responsibilities:

1. Recruitment & Team Building

* Recruit, screen, and onboard chefs and kitchen staff across Tribal Brew Daily and North West outlets.
* Build a bench of trained, deployable kitchen talent to support new outlet launches without revenue disruption.
* Partner with HR/Operations to close kitchen manpower gaps within agreed timelines.
* Reduce attrition-linked revenue loss through structured onboarding and career pathing.

2. Food Sales & Revenue Growth

* Own the food (F&B) revenue contribution target as a defined share of total outlet sales — “fill the food part of Tribal Brew.”
* Drive upselling and cross-selling of food items alongside beverages at every outlet.
* Identify high-margin, high-velocity menu items and push their visibility and sales at store level.
* Track outlet-wise food sales performance and course-correct underperforming outlets.
* Align new launches and promotions with revenue and footfall opportunities identified through R&D.

3. Menu Planning & R&D

* Lead menu planning and seasonal menu refreshes for both Tribal Brew Daily and North West.
* Develop and test new products with a clear view on cost, margin, and revenue potential before rollout.
* Run pilot launches and food trials, and use customer/outlet feedback to refine offerings.
* Continuously improve recipes for taste, consistency, cost efficiency, and speed of execution.

4. Wastage Control & Cost Management

* Track wastage at every outlet — raw material, prep, and plate wastage — and drive it down against target.
* Investigate root causes of wastage (over-prep, poor storage, expiry) and implement corrective action.
* Report wastage cost impact monthly and tie improvement targets to outlet P&L.
* Drive food costing discipline to protect gross margin on every menu item.

5. Inventory, FIFO & Storage Management

* Implement and audit FIFO (First-In-First-Out) discipline across all outlet kitchens and stores.
* Set and monitor storage standards — temperature control, labeling, segregation, and hygiene.
* Own product shelf-life / longevity management: define shelf-life standards for each product and minimize spoilage-driven loss.
* Coordinate with Procurement to align ordering quantities with actual consumption and shelf-life data.

6. Training & Development

* Conduct structured onboarding and kitchen training for all new chefs and kitchen staff.
* Develop training modules, recipe manuals, and skill assessment programs for both brands.
* Run regular refresher training across all outlets, tied to KPI gaps (wastage, speed, quality).
* Mentor kitchen teams to improve efficiency, consistency, and productivity, linking training outcomes to sales and cost performance.

7. Systems & Automation (Store Level)

* Identify and roll out kitchen systems and automation to reduce manual dependency and human error at store level.
* Standardize prep and production workflows so outlets can scale without proportional cost increase.
* Work with Operations/Tech teams to pilot and implement automation tools (e.g., digital checklists, inventory/wastage tracking systems).

8. SOP Development — QSR & Restaurant

* Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) tailored separately for QSR (Tribal Brew Daily) and full-service/restaurant (North West) formats.
* Standardize recipes, prep methods, storage procedures, and service processes across formats.
* Ensure SOP compliance across all outlets and continuously refine SOPs for operational efficiency.

9. Quality Assurance & Food Presentation

* Ensure consistency in taste, portion size, plating, and product quality across all outlets and both brands.
* Conduct regular quality audits and implement corrective actions where standards slip.
* Establish and maintain plating and presentation standards that reflect each brand's identity.

10. FSSAI Hygiene & Food Safety

* Ensure full compliance with FSSAI regulations and company food safety standards across all outlets.
* Conduct regular hygiene and food safety audits; maintain documentation and inspection readiness.
* Train kitchen teams on food handling, sanitation, personal hygiene, and contamination prevention.

11. Outlet Visits & Operations

* Visit 2–3 outlets daily across the outlet network, covering MG Road, Indiranagar, Magrath Road, Agara, Mysore, and Bel Road, along with North West in Koramangala.
* Support kitchen setup, training, and go-live readiness for upcoming Tribal Brew Coffee (TBC) outlets.
* Coordinate with Procurement and Operations to close outlet kitchen equipment and resource requirements on time.
* Identify operational gaps on visits and implement corrective measures to protect revenue, quality, and cost.

* Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking an experienced Electrical Engineering or Computer Science expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based scientific and engineering tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.
* In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers, review technical tasks for accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure tasks reflect authentic computer science, software systems, and electrical engineering workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent delivery of challenging technical tasks.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of scientific and engineering tasks.
* Review technical tasks end to end, including problem statements, codebases, circuit netlists, hardware description languages (HDL), datasets, computational environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Validate tasks involving high-performance computing (HPC), parallel computing, algorithms, distributed systems, compilers, operating systems, databases, ML systems, GPU computing, circuit design, signal processing, power systems, and embedded systems.
* Ensure tasks reflect realistic software engineering, research, and electrical engineering workflows requiring meaningful multi-step technical reasoning.
* Verify technical correctness across algorithm complexity, numerical accuracy, memory management, concurrency, circuit laws, power balance, signal processing, timing constraints, and system stability.
* Validate compilers, simulation tools, software dependencies, computational environments, and build processes to ensure reproducible results.
* Identify unreliable tests caused by nondeterministic behavior, race conditions, hardware-dependent performance thresholds, or simulation convergence issues.
* Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful technical outputs such as functional correctness, performance, frequency response, waveforms, timing, efficiency, and system behavior.
* Identify technical inaccuracies, flawed assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass computation, simulations, or automated evaluations.
* Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval.
* Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
* Strong programming skills in C/C++, Rust, Python, Julia, Fortran, MATLAB/Octave, or hardware description languages (HDL), with advanced Linux and terminal proficiency.
* Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: parallel computing, systems programming, scientific software development, circuit simulation, signal processing, power systems, or digital hardware design.
* Strong understanding of algorithms, computational systems, numerical methods, software testing, or electrical engineering principles.
* Experience reviewing complex codebases, technical implementations, engineering simulations, or research outputs.
* Ability to evaluate algorithm correctness, computational performance, numerical accuracy, concurrency behavior, and reliability of technical results.
* Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, race conditions, and flawed engineering assumptions.
* Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams.
* Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with HPC and systems development tools such as MPI, OpenMP, CUDA, LLVM/GCC, CMake, gdb, Valgrind, perf, sanitizers, or Slurm.
* Familiarity with electrical engineering and hardware simulation tools such as ngspice, Xyce, Icarus Verilog, Verilator, GHDL, Yosys, pandapower, PyPSA, MATPOWER, openEMS, GNU Radio, or QEMU.
* Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing frameworks such as pytest.
* Experience developing technical benchmarks, programming challenges, simulation-based evaluations, or automated grading systems.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated technical solutions.
* Open-source development or maintainer experience, particularly reviewing and validating external contributions.
* Industry experience in semiconductors, high-performance computing, power utilities, telecommunications, or embedded systems.
* Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

**Offer Details:**

* **Commitments Required:**
  At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
* **Employment type :**
  Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
* **Duration of contract :**
  4 week [expected start date is next week]

title: Manager - Sourcing (FSF)
description:

Scale Readiness

Vendor Quality

As

, you'll lead video editing at Headout, building the team, systems, and creative standards that make great travel content possible at scale.

We create long-form and short-form videos that help millions of people make better travel decisions. From explaining the London Underground to breaking down museum tickets or navigating an unfamiliar city, our videos turn complicated information into something simple, useful, and engaging.

You'll own creative quality, editorial standards, timelines, and the post-production pipeline while building workflows that help the team deliver excellent videos consistently. You'll partner with producers and writers to improve storytelling and formats, use YouTube performance data to make better creative decisions, and develop editors who can work independently.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll continue editing and independently own a smaller slate of videos alongside your management responsibilities, with lower individual output targets than the editors you manage.

**🤩 What makes this role special?**

* **Set the Editorial Standard:**
  You'll define what great looks like across storytelling, pacing, motion graphics, visual clarity, and audience retention. Your goal is to make informational travel content genuinely engaging without relying on unnecessary effects or visual complexity.
* **Build a Scalable Post-Production System:**
  You'll own the pipeline from asset handover and first cuts to feedback, quality checks, and final delivery. You'll build workflows, templates, and reusable visual systems that help the team produce better videos, faster.
* **Stay Hands-On with the Craft:**
  You'll continue editing videos yourself, experimenting with formats, and making creative decisions. You'll balance your own editing responsibilities with leading the team and maintaining quality across projects.
* **Build a Team of Independent Editors:**
  You'll lead editors working across long-form and short-form content, owning creative quality, timelines, feedback, and delivery. You'll mentor them, strengthen their editorial judgement, and build a culture of ownership and constructive feedback.
* **Shape Stories That People Want to Watch:**
  You'll work closely with producers and writers to improve formats, identify storytelling opportunities, and solve creative challenges. You'll turn information people are actively searching for into content they find useful and enjoyable.
* **Use Data to Make Better Creative Decisions:**
  You'll use YouTube metrics, including click-through rate (CTR), audience retention, and average view duration, to understand what's working and improve future edits. Data will inform your creative judgement, not replace it.
* **Make Creative Work More Efficient:**
  You'll experiment with new tools, including AI, to eliminate repetitive tasks and give editors more time to focus on creative decisions. You'll build systems that reduce firefighting, improve consistency, and make every project easier to execute than the last.

**💝 What skills & experience do you need?**

* **4–6 years of experience**
  in video editing and post-production, with experience leading editors or managing multiple projects.
* **Strong editing skills:**
  A portfolio demonstrating excellent storytelling, pacing, motion graphics, visual clarity, and editorial judgement. A portfolio is a must.
* **Team leadership:**
  Experience leading editors, managing feedback and timelines, maintaining creative quality, and developing team members.
* **Strong storytelling instincts:**
  Ability to make informational content engaging and easy to understand without relying on unnecessary effects or visual complexity.
* **Workflow management:**
  Ability to manage multiple deadlines, streamline post-production processes, and build reusable templates and systems that improve speed and consistency.
* **Understanding of YouTube:**
  Familiarity with how editing decisions influence click-through rate (CTR), audience retention, and average view duration.
* **Technical expertise:**
  Strong knowledge of editing software, motion graphics, asset management, and collaborative workflows.
* **Feedback and mentorship:**
  Ability to give clear, actionable feedback that strengthens editorial judgement and helps editors become more independent.
* **Hands-on ownership:**
  Willingness to continue editing videos while managing and developing a team.
* **A systems-first mindset:**
  Someone who simplifies workflows, balances quality with speed, uses data to inform creative decisions, and looks for ways to make every project more efficient than the last.

title: Chemical Engineering
description:
**About Turing:**

* Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.
* Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

**Role Overview:**

* We are seeking an experienced Chemical Engineering expert to lead a team of technical trainers developing realistic, terminal-based engineering tasks for a frontier AI training and evaluation initiative.
* In this role, you will oversee a pod of approximately 5–10 trainers, review chemical engineering tasks for technical accuracy, reproducibility, and evaluation quality, and ensure tasks reflect authentic chemical engineering workflows. You will also mentor trainers, maintain quality standards, and drive consistent task delivery.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead and mentor a pod of technical trainers, ensuring consistent quality, productivity, and timely delivery of chemical engineering tasks.
* Review engineering tasks end to end, including problem statements, reaction kinetics, thermodynamic and property data, process flowsheets, computational environments, reference solutions, and automated tests.
* Validate tasks involving reaction engineering, thermodynamics, phase equilibria, transport phenomena, separation processes, process simulation, process control, optimization, combustion, and electrochemical engineering.
* Ensure tasks reflect realistic chemical engineering workflows and require meaningful multi-step technical reasoning.
* Verify engineering correctness across mass and energy balances, thermodynamic consistency, property data, unit handling, and numerical convergence.
* Validate computational models, stiff ODE/DAE solvers, solver tolerances, initial conditions, and simulation results to ensure reproducibility and technical accuracy.
* Review automated graders to ensure they evaluate meaningful engineering outputs such as conversion, yield, selectivity, purity, energy consumption, and process constraint satisfaction.
* Identify technical inaccuracies, unrealistic assumptions, incorrect tolerances, and opportunities to bypass engineering calculations or simulations.
* Provide clear, actionable technical feedback, track revisions, and ensure quality issues are resolved before task approval.
* Onboard trainers, allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, escalate blockers, and maintain technical documentation and best practices.

**What we're looking for:**

* Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced technical experience in Chemical Engineering.
* Strong programming skills in Python, Julia, C/C++, or MATLAB/Octave, with proficiency in Linux environments.
* Hands-on expertise in at least one major area: process modeling, reaction kinetics, thermodynamic modeling, process simulation, or optimization.
* Strong understanding of chemical engineering fundamentals, numerical methods, computational modeling, and technical validation.
* Experience reviewing complex technical work, chemical process simulations, computational models, or research outputs.
* Ability to evaluate mass and energy balances, thermodynamic assumptions, numerical accuracy, solver convergence, and the reliability of computational results.
* Strong analytical judgment with the ability to identify technical errors, edge cases, and flawed engineering assumptions.
* Experience mentoring, reviewing, or leading small technical teams.
* Excellent written communication skills for providing precise technical feedback and documenting quality standards.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with chemical engineering simulation and computational tools such as Cantera, CoolProp, Pyomo, IDAES, DWSIM, CasADi, or OpenFOAM.
* Familiarity with commercial process simulation software such as Aspen Plus, Aspen HYSYS, or gPROMS, including reproducing workflows using open-source tools.
* Experience with process optimization, reactor modeling, separation systems, process control, or electrochemical simulations.
* Familiarity with Docker, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing.
* Experience developing or evaluating AI coding agents, terminal-based agents, or LLM-generated engineering solutions.
* Industry experience in petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals, energy, specialty chemicals, or chemical process manufacturing.
* Prior experience in AI training, technical quality control, benchmark development, or evaluation programs.

**Offer Details:**

* **Commitments Required:**
  At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
* **Employment type :**
  Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
* **Duration of contract :**
  4 week [expected start date is next week]

title: CAD Manager
description:
You'll be working with the engineering team.
  
  
This team runs on coffee and an infectious passion for building products that have never been built before. Our Flexible Energy Stack — the e^pack (battery pack) and e^pump (charging station) — together unlock 15-minute rapid charging.
  
  
Our philosophy: Break. Believe. Build.
  
  

* Break stuff. Break assumptions. Break the thumb rule
* Believe in the team. Believe in the process. Believe through failures
* Build fast. Build passionately. Build to simplify

Role Description
  
  
As CAD Manager in Mechanical Engineering, you'll lead the CAD team behind the e^pump and e^pack. You'll own CAD and drawing quality, Teamcenter and ERP data, project BOMs, and release timelines — turning Design Engineering intent into production-ready data.
  
  
What you will do

* Own Teamcenter, ERP part data and all project BOMs, kept in sync

* Experience of leading a CAD team

* ERP, BOM structuring, part numbering and configuration management
* Zero tolerance for poor data quality

What matters
  
  
Quality of work, problem-solving, dissatisfaction with mediocrity, and resilience after failure.

title: Manager - Special Projects & Sustainability
description:
**Position Title**
- Manager – Special Projects & Sustainability

**Department:**
Business Development

**Reporting to:**
Director – Business Development

**Location:**
Corporate Office, with travel to manufacturing sites as required

**1. Role Purpose**

Identify, evaluate and execute strategic projects that deliver measurable business value through technology adoption, green energy, brewing-process optimisation, waste-to-wealth initiatives and resource efficiency.

The role combines technology scouting, data analytics, financial modelling and end-to-end project execution. The incumbent will be responsible for converting opportunities into commercially viable investments and ensuring delivery against approved business cases, frozen engineering designs, budgets, specifications and timelines.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Technology Scouting and Special Projects.**

* Maintain current knowledge of developments in renewable energy, industrial energy efficiency, waste recovery, circular economy and emerging technologies relevant to brewing and process manufacturing.
* Identify and evaluate opportunities in solar and other green energy solutions, heat recovery, energy optimisation, biogas, compressed biogas (CBG) and alternative fuels.
* Identify opportunities to convert brewing by-products and manufacturing waste—including spent grain, surplus yeast, effluent and other process residues, as applicable—into saleable products, energy or useful raw materials.
* Benchmark industry practices, assess technology providers and develop a prioritised pipeline of commercially attractive projects.

**B. Data Analytics and Business Case Development**

* Analyse plant operating data, energy consumption, production yields, waste streams, water usage and operating costs to identify improvement opportunities.
* Independently develop detailed, data-driven business cases and financial models covering capital expenditure, operating costs, revenue potential, savings, payback, NPV, IRR and sensitivity analysis.
* Compare alternative technologies and commercial models, validate assumptions and assess technical feasibility, investment risks and expected returns.
* Prepare evidence-based investment recommendations for management approval, supported by clear assumptions and quantified benefits.
* Use advanced Excel for financial modelling and data analysis. Proficiency in Power BI or equivalent dashboarding tools is desirable; familiarity with SQL, Python and AI-enabled analytical tools is an advantage.

**C. Project Execution and Commissioning**

* Take approved projects from detailed planning and engineering through procurement, installation, commissioning, performance testing and operational handover.
* Establish and maintain the approved design, scope, specifications, budget, quality standards and schedule as the execution baseline.
* Coordinate with engineering consultants, technology providers, contractors, plant teams and internal stakeholders to ensure timely and effective implementation.
* Enforce strict adherence to the frozen design and approved specifications. Any proposed deviation must undergo documented technical and commercial evaluation and formal approval before implementation.
* Monitor project progress, expenditure, risks, quality and milestones; promptly escalate deviations and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure commissioning, performance validation, documentation, training and handover, followed by verification of actual financial and operational benefits against the approved business case.

**D. Sustainability and Resource Efficiency**

* Develop projects to reduce energy consumption, conventional energy costs.
* Evaluate waste-to-energy, waste-to-wealth, water recovery.
* Quantify environmental and financial benefits against defined baselines and identify opportunities to replicate successful projects across manufacturing locations.
* Ensure proposed initiatives meet applicable regulatory, environmental, quality and safety requirements.

**E. Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with Engineering, Plant Operations, Finance, Procurement and other relevant functions to validate proposals and deliver approved projects.
* Build relationships with technology providers, equipment manufacturers, consultants and potential commercial partners.
* Present investment proposals, project updates, risks and benefits realisation to the Director – Business Development and senior management.

3. Qualifications and Experience

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Energy, Environmental or another relevant engineering discipline.
* A postgraduate qualification in energy management, sustainability, project management or business management is desirable.

**Experience**

* Approximately 8–12 years of relevant experience in industrial project execution, engineering, energy management, process manufacturing or technology implementation.
* Demonstrated experience in delivering projects from feasibility through commissioning.
* Proven capability in financial modelling, investment evaluation and project cost and schedule control.
* Exposure to renewable energy, brewing or fermentation, bioenergy, CBG, waste management, resource recovery or industrial energy efficiency is desirable.

**Preferred industry background**

Brewing and distilleries, food and beverage, bioenergy and CBG, chemicals, cement, paper and pulp, renewable energy, industrial engineering or EPC project execution.

4. Critical Competencies

* Strong technical understanding of industrial processes, utilities, energy systems and resource efficiency.
* Advanced Excel proficiency and the ability to independently build comprehensive financial models and data-backed business cases.
* Strong quantitative, analytical and commercial decision-making skills.
* Hands-on project planning, execution, commissioning and performance validation experience.
* High discipline in engineering design freeze, scope control, change management, quality and cost control.
* Ability to challenge vendor assumptions and translate technical opportunities into measurable financial returns.

5. Key Performance Indicators

Performance will be measured against agreed annual targets:

1. **Value creation:**
   Verified cost savings and incremental revenue delivered.
2. **Project execution:**
   Projects commissioned within approved budgets and timelines.
3. **Design compliance:**
   Adherence to frozen designs and formal change-control procedures.
4. **Investment performance:**
   Actual returns against approved business cases.
5. **Resource efficiency:**
   Measurable improvements in energy, and identified oppurtunties
6. **Waste-to-wealth:**
   Commercial value realised from by-products and waste streams.
7. **Benefits realisation:**
   Achievement of agreed technical, financial and environmental outcomes after commissioning.

title: Captain
description:
**Company Description**
Shilton Hospitality Pvt Ltd is a diversified hospitality company operating business hotels, resto-bars, catering services, music festivals, and leisure resorts. The organization focuses on delivering high-quality guest experiences across both corporate and leisure segments. Team members are exposed to a dynamic environment that blends food and beverage service, events, and resort operations. **Role Description**
The Captain role is a full-time, on-site position based in Bangalore Urban. The Captain oversees daily restaurant or banquet floor operations, including managing the service team, coordinating table assignments, and ensuring prompt, courteous service to all guests. This role is responsible for briefing staff before service, monitoring order taking and delivery, handling guest queries or concerns, and maintaining hygiene and safety standards. **Qualifications**
  

* Strong guest service and interpersonal skills, with the ability to handle guest feedback and resolve issues calmly and professionally.
* Team leadership and supervisory abilities, including experience guiding service staff, delegating tasks, and motivating the team during busy operations.
* Sound knowledge of food and beverage service standards, table settings, menu presentation, and basic understanding of cuisines and beverages.
* Operational skills in order coordination, POS or billing systems, cash handling, and maintaining service-related documentation.
* Attention to detail in maintaining cleanliness, hygiene, and safety standards across the restaurant or banquet floor.
* Effective communication skills in English and local languages, with the ability to coordinate with kitchen, bar, and management teams.
* Prior experience in a restaurant, hotel, or banquet service environment as a Captain or Senior Steward is preferred.
* Relevant hospitality education or certification is an advantage, along with willingness to work flexible schedules, weekends, and holidays.

title: Head of Operations - Instawork Robotics Labs
description:
Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Our AI-powered labor marketplace helps local businesses scale, and enables global technology companies to push the frontiers of robotics and AI. Backed by world-class investors like Benchmark, Spark Capital, Craft Ventures, Greylock, Y Combinator, and others, we’re looking for exceptional talent to reimagine the way the world works.
  
  
**About IRL (Instawork Robotics Labs)**
Researchers at UC Berkeley have identified a “100,000-year data gap” - the gulf between what trained AI language models and what physical robots actually have to learn from. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork’s answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments - kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, homes - to capture the high-fidelity task data that the world’s leading Robotics labs use to train their foundation models. Read more here.
  
  
**Build. Scale. Operate.**
We’re looking for a hardcore operations leader who thrives in the real world — someone who has built and scaled large, distributed operations from the ground up and knows what it takes to turn an idea into an operation that actually works.
  
  
This is not a role for someone who only manages dashboards, processes, or strategy decks.
  
  
We’re looking for a builder and operator, someone who can start with a blank sheet of paper, build the team, design the processes, solve problems on the ground, and scale the operation without losing speed or quality.
  
  
You’ll be operating in an environment where things change quickly, the problems are often ambiguous, and there is rarely a playbook to follow.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Build and scale operations from the ground up — define the operating model, build processes, hire teams, establish metrics, and create the systems needed to scale.
* Own large, distributed, real-world operations across multiple locations, teams, and workflows.
* Build high-performing teams — hire exceptional operators, develop leaders, set a high bar for execution, and create a culture of ownership and accountability.
* Turn chaos into structure — identify operational bottlenecks, build repeatable processes, and continuously improve how the organization operates.
* Be relentlessly execution-oriented — when something breaks, you don’t wait for someone else to solve it. You get to the ground, understand the problem, and figure it out.
* Operate at speed — priorities will change, plans will move, and unexpected problems will come up. You’ll need to make decisions quickly and keep the team moving.
* Build for scale — design processes and teams that can handle 10x growth, not just solve today’s problem.
* Own outcomes, not just activities — set clear operational metrics and relentlessly drive performance, quality, productivity, and efficiency.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Significant experience building and running large, distributed, real-world operations.
* Experience in e-commerce, logistics, marketplaces, field operations, fast-scaling startups, hardware-adjacent businesses, or other operationally intensive environments.
* A track record of building teams and operating models from scratch, not just inheriting established ones.
* Strong people leadership experience, with the ability to build teams that are highly accountable, ambitious, and deeply committed to the mission.
* Extremely high ownership — you naturally think, “I’ll figure it out.”
* Extreme agility and resilience.

+ Plans change → you adapt, rather than freeze.
+ Pressure increases → you become clearer and more decisive.
+ Something breaks → you go after the root cause.

* Strong operational judgment — you know when to build a process, when to break one, and when to simply get things done.
* Comfortable working with incomplete information and making decisions without waiting for perfect data.
* A strong bias toward action, with the ability to balance speed, quality, cost, and scale.

**The Kind of Leader We Want**
You’re the person who:
  
  

* Can walk into a messy operation and figure out what needs to happen next.
* Has built teams from a handful of people into large, high-performing organizations.
* Can spend the morning looking at operational metrics and the afternoon solving a problem on the ground.
* Doesn’t need a perfect org structure or playbook to get started.
* Sets an extremely high bar — but earns trust by giving the team the support, context, and ownership to meet it.
* Builds teams that want to run through walls for them.
* Is calm when things are chaotic and gets more focused when the pressure goes up.
* Gets excited by operational complexity rather than intimidated by it.
* Has experience with robotics, AI data collection, or hardware operations

**Bonus, Not Required**
Experience or exposure to:
  
  

* Supply chain or manufacturing operations
* Field workforce operations
* Marketplace operations
* Multi-city / multi-location scaling
* Building operations in an early-stage or rapidly scaling startup

**Our Values**

* Empathy, Trust & Candor We put ourselves in the shoes of our colleagues and customers and don’t shy away from uncomfortable conversations, instead building trust through honest and direct feedback.
* Bias for Action We practice high-velocity decision-making, clear-eyed that we often operate with incomplete information. Growing quickly means it’s OK to be wrong, so long as we learn from our mistakes and course correct!
* Always Be Learning We’re a curious bunch, and with AI transforming our workplace we encourage everyone to learn from each other, compounding our knowledge and experience to help us change an entire industry.
* Act Like an Owner We work long, hard, and smart, building products that delight our users and drive growth. Your ability to impact Instawork is limited only by your courage and conviction, not your job description.

**About Instawork**
Founded in 2015, Instawork is the nation’s leading online labor marketplace for food services, hospitality, light industry, and logistics, connecting more than 7M skilled workers with local restaurants, hotels, warehouses, stadiums, and more. Our AI-powered platform serves thousands of businesses across more than 50 major markets in the United States and Canada. We're not just helping fill shifts, we're supporting local economies—and we're just getting started!
  
  
Instawork has been featured by CBS News, The Wall Street Journal, The Washington Post, and the Associated Press. Forbes included us on their Next Billion Dollar Startups list; RetailTech Breakthrough named us Workforce Hiring Solution of the Year for 2025; and Inc. 5000 recognized us as one of the country's top 10% fastest-growing companies two years in a row. But what matters most is our impact. We're solving real problems for real people, and we’re doing it at scale.
  
  
Join our team to help us build something that matters! We’re looking for superstars who want to help us shape the future of work. With hubs in San Francisco, Bangalore, and Chicago, city offices in New York, Phoenix, and Singapore, we're back to working together in-person five days a week because we believe the best ideas happen when great people collaborate face-to-face. We also value diverse perspectives and encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Learn more at www.instawork.com/about.

title: Center Director - Indiranagar Location
description:
**About us**

At Openhouse, we are building a network of premium play based learning centres across Bangalore. Our learning centres offer preschool, childcare and co-curricular activities for ages 1-10 years. We believe that modern parents are seeking professionally run schools that are child-centric, have quality infrastructure and follow global pedagogies.

Our learning centres are different from traditional K-12 schools or preschools. We are building learning hubs (micro-schools) at a neighbourhood level where parents can send children for play school, nursery, kindergarten and a range of co-curricular activities from dance to drama, chess to robotics!

**The problem**

We realise that in big urban metros, parents preferences are changing:

1. Families are more nuclear and there are a lot of childcare responsibilities especially in the early years which they need to figure out on their own.
2. Parents are dissatisfied with existing preschools due to an overemphasis on academics with subpar educators and infrastructure.

Looking at the above, Openhouse is trying to bridge the gap for modern thoughtful parents and be their support partner in the first 10 years of parenting. We have been on this mission since 2018 and already have 12 live learning centres across Bangalore and Kolkata where we help 4000+ families and mentor 200+ educators.

Click here to take a look at our modern centres.

Click here to view our Instagram Page

**Who are we?**

Founded by Stanford alumni and headquartered in Bangalore, Openhouse is an Ed Tech Startup. We emphasise on play based learning and believe that the future of education lies in designing games and activities that promote peer based learning. This philosophy reflects in each team member at Openhouse. Our team’s background spans institutions like Harvard, MIT, IIT, and ISB, and companies like Cult.fit and Truecaller. We’re backed by leading global education investors who believe in us.

**What is the role?**

As a Centre Director at Openhouse, you will play a pivotal role in managing one learning centre entrusted to you. It’s a role that allows you to build that centre in your neighborhood and create social and economical impact.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Working with our enthusiastic teachers by building an inclusive, growth oriented culture.
* Implementing our Curriculum in the centre for both preschool and afterschool programs
* Managing day to day functioning of the centre
* Owning the Professional Development of the entire team by bridging any knowledge or skill gaps.
* Maintaining open and effective communication with parents, sharing insights into their child's progress and milestones.

**Who is the ideal candidate?**

We are looking for someone who-

* Has at least 4-5 years of being a Preschool Teacher in a Premium Early Childhood Education school.
* Has good team management experience and has led teams before
* Has good communication and team building skills
* Is willing to be entrepreneurial and do whatever it takes to grow a learning centre in their community.
* Is outgoing and able to hold good quality conversations with parents, teachers and students alike
* Loves being around children and is passionate about quality education
* A course in Early Childhood Education or a B.Ed or NTT, MTT would also be great to have and is a bonus.

**Things you should know before applying**

* Location: Bangalore
* Timings: 8:30am to 5pm
* 5 day working week (However, 1 day of the weekend will be working, non negotiable)

title: Customer Experience Manager
description:
**Role: Customer Experience Manager (CEM) – Coliving**

**Zolo | Coliving**

**Own the cluster. Drive performance. Deliver consistent experience.**

**Why this role exists**

Zolo’s coliving business operates at scale across multiple properties in each city.

While individual properties are managed by on-ground teams, consistent performance across occupancy, customer experience, and profitability depends on strong cluster-level ownership.

Each cluster needs a leader who ensures:

* Properties are full and revenue targets are met
* Customer experience is consistent and NPS remains high
* Teams are trained, disciplined, and aligned
* Issues are identified early and resolved quickly

This role exists to ensure that a cluster of 10–20 properties runs with control, consistency, and accountability — delivering both strong business outcomes and great customer experience.

If the CEM is strong, the cluster performs predictably and improves continuously.

If the CEM is weak, performance drops, issues repeat, and teams lose direction.

**Your mandate is clear**

* Own occupancy, NPS, and profitability across your cluster
* Drive execution discipline and SOP adherence across all properties
* Build, train, and manage a strong on-ground team
* Identify and solve operational and customer experience issues
* Use data and numbers to drive decisions and improvements
* Ensure properties are audit-ready and consistently maintained

This is not a coordination role.

It is full ownership of cluster performance and outcomes.

**About Zolo**

Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.

People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.

Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.

Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.

Z Vacations enables meaningful travel experiences.

Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.

Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.

Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation by partnering deeply with property owners who think long term.

**What you will be responsible for**

1. Own Cluster Performance & Business Outcomes

* Take full accountability for occupancy, revenue, and margins
* Track property-level performance metrics regularly
* Identify underperforming properties and drive improvement
* Ensure consistent achievement of targets across cluster

2. Drive Execution Discipline & SOP Adherence

* Ensure all properties follow defined SOPs and checklists
* Conduct regular reviews with ACEMs and property teams
* Build structured routines for daily, weekly, and monthly tracking
* Ensure consistency in execution across all properties

3. Lead & Develop On-Ground Teams

* Manage ACEMs, property managers, and housekeeping teams
* Train teams on customer experience, processes, and standards
* Identify performance gaps and take corrective actions
* Build a motivated, disciplined, and accountable team

4. Ensure Customer Experience & Manage Escalations

* Track NPS and customer feedback across properties
* Handle escalations and ensure quick resolution
* Drive root cause analysis and prevent repeat issues
* Ensure consistent guest/resident experience across cluster

5. Use Data & Numbers to Drive Decisions

* Track key metrics like occupancy, revenue, and cost
* Use data to identify trends and problem areas
* Take action based on numbers, not assumptions
* Drive performance improvements through data-led decisions

6. Audit Properties & Maintain Control

* Conduct regular property audits (hygiene, operations, processes)
* Identify gaps and ensure timely closure
* Maintain high standards across all properties
* Ensure properties are always audit-ready

**What success looks like after 6–12 months**

* Cluster consistently meets occupancy and revenue targets
* High and stable NPS across all properties
* Strong SOP adherence and execution consistency
* Reduced escalations and faster issue resolution
* Well-trained, motivated, and accountable team
* Clear visibility and control over all properties

The cluster runs with discipline, predictability, and strong performance.

**Who this role is for**

You will likely thrive here if:

* You take ownership of outcomes across multiple locations
* You enjoy managing teams and driving performance
* You are disciplined and believe in structured execution
* You are comfortable working with numbers and targets
* You can handle pressure and make decisions on-ground
* You want to grow into larger operational leadership roles

**Experience we value**

* 1–3 years of experience in operations / multi-unit environments
* Experience managing teams (directly or indirectly)
* Exposure to customer-facing environments
* Basic understanding of business metrics (occupancy, revenue, cost)
* Strong execution and follow-up discipline

Hospitality experience is not mandatory. Ownership, leadership, and execution discipline are critical.

**The impact you will have**

* You directly influence revenue, occupancy, and profitability
* You shape customer experience across multiple properties
* You build and develop on-ground teams
* You ensure operational consistency at scale

**Why join now**

Zolo is scaling its coliving business aggressively across cities.

Cluster-level execution and leadership will define success.

This role is a critical stepping stone to larger city and business leadership roles.

If you believe in ownership, discipline, and driving outcomes at scale — this is the right role.

title: WFM Manager, LMAQ
description:
**Description**
Have you ever thought about what it takes to successfully deliver millions of packages to Amazon customers seamlessly every day like clock work? In order to make that happen, behind those millions of packages, billions of decisions get made by machines and humans. What is the accuracy of the customer provided address? Do we know exact location of the address on a Map? Is there a safe place to leave the package at? Can we make an unattended delivery? Would a signature be required? Is the address a commercial property? Do we know open business hours of the address? What if customer is not home? Is there an alternate delivery address? Does the customer have any special delivery preference? What are the other addresses that also have packages to be delivered on the same day? Are we optimizing the delivery associate’s route? Does the delivery associate know the locality well enough? Is there an access code to get inside the building? And the list simply goes on. At the core of it all is the underlying data that can help make those decisions in time. The Last Mile Analytics and Quality (LMAQ) team capitalizes on Amazon’s scale, speed, and ability to invent and simplify to accelerate the data flywheel and curate fresh and authoritative geospatial datasets to improve customer delivery experience. We work closely with tech and science teams on multiple initiatives to automate processes to operate at scale across all regions.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Key Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Drive end-to-end workforce management for the entire LMAQ space, designing and delivering short- and long-term labor planning strategies across all lines of business
* Own forecasting, planning, and execution to ensure operational performance meets or exceeds targets
* Build forecast models to drive headcount planning across spaces, programs, and sub-programs with high utilization, and cross-skilling optimization
* Manage headcount planning across the space, ensuring key programs and business needs are driven without impacting SLA, sustaining operational performance with the least churn for managers
* Ability to partner with multiple teams and build strong stakeholder relationships to drive HC planning for the LMAQ space
* Manage the VCC vs. B&M mix across sites, ensuring compliance, driving seating planning across sites, and driving key operational metrics like cross-site reporting, etc.
* Build a data-driven culture by championing automated solutions to drive LMAQ HC planning at a regular cadence with minimal effort
* Own end-to-end delivery of multiple projects focused on performance optimization and cost efficiency
* Guide the design, development, and maintenance of metrics, reports, analyses, and dashboards that inform key business decisions
* Work through and influence WFM leads and analysts across each space without direct authority, aligning them to a common planning and execution standard
* Demonstrate a strong eye for detail, uncovering trends, going beyond the obvious, and identifying root causes
* Thrive in ambiguous environments and proactively take on new challenges
* Influence hiring quality by raising the bar on interviewing standards across the organization

**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* 7+ years of operational and/or retail management experience
* Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Master's degree, or MBA in business, operations, human resources, adult education, organizational development, instructional design or related field
* Advanced degree in a quantitative field or an MBA
* Ability to think strategically and drive the detailed execution of specific initiatives
* Experience with workforce management tools and platforms (e.g., NICE, Verint, or proprietary systems)
* Familiarity with capacity planning, scheduling optimization, or labor modeling at scale
* Track record of delivering measurable cost savings or efficiency improvements

title: Manager (IFM - Technical Services & Sustainable Operations) — Campus Development
description:
**About the IIHS Campus Development**

The IIHS campus is located on a 54-acre site at Kengeri, Bengaluru, located between a 500-acre reserve forest and a 800-year old 150-acre lake. Its digitally augmented buildings and facilities, slated to be built over multiple phases, will enable interdisciplinary teaching-learning, research and practice, and demonstrate the best examples of Indian design and crafts. The campus will provide faculty, students and researchers with the opportunity to immerse themselves in and innovate around India’s core urban challenges.

The campus features a robust integrated infrastructure and services network supported by various sensors and other IoT devices to enable cost-effective high performance and long-term sustainability. This will be enabled via an intelligent digital twin to integrate all MEP services at site and building level to help in optimised predictive operations and maintenance.

The IIHS Campus Development team focuses on design, procurement, execution, and

documentation of the development of the IIHS Kengeri Campus. Joining the Campus Development team at IIHS offers a unique opportunity to be at the forefront of building one of India’s most ambitious, sustainable and climate-resilient campuses. Situated in the upcoming Kengeri area of Bengaluru, it is deeply rooted in principles of net neutrality and long-term environmental stewardship targeting Factor two to four infrastructure and services.

As part of this fast-paced and dynamic team, you will gain hands-on experience and

unparalleled exposure to interdisciplinary planning, design and implementation spanning various technology domains, architecture, urban design, planning and environmental design, . The role is designed to accelerate your professional development, offering meaningful engagement with cutting-edge practices in sustainable development. We are looking for candidates passionate about building a better future and eager to shape a living, learning campus from the ground up. Join this team if you are interested in a purpose-driven career.

**Job Description**

IIHS is looking to hire an experienced Integrated Facility Management (IFM) Manager – Technical Services & Sustainable Operations to assume direct operational accountability for mission-critical MEP infrastructure and sustainable campus operations across IIHS facilities. The incumbent will manage internal technical engineering staff while providing rigorous contractual governance over external IFM service providers, Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), and Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs). This role demands strict alignment with green campus benchmarking, net-zero resource targets, high-voltage asset uptime, and robust Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) regulatory compliance.

**Activities and Tasks**

Responsibilities will include, but not be limited to, the following:

* Hard services and critical infrastructure governance:
* Operations & maintenance:
  Overseeing routine and specialised O&M of high-voltage/ low-voltage (HT/LT) electrical systems, transformers, DG sets, HVAC central chillers, STP/ WTP facilities, and Fire & Life Safety (FLS) networks;
* BMS & IoT monitoring: Managing Building Management Systems (BMS) and IoT-enabled digital twin frameworks for real-time asset tracking and predictive fault detection;
* Preventive maintenance: Establishing and executing strict Planned Preventive Maintenance (PPM) schedules to ensure maximum equipment lifecycle and zero unplanned downtime;
* Sustainability and resource optimization:
* Green campus initiatives: Driving initiatives targeting net-zero energy, water efficiency, carbon footprint reduction, and campus zero-waste goals;
* Resource conservation: Monitoring and optimising energy/ water baselines through intelligent sub-metering, STP recycled water utilisation, and waste segregation protocols;
* Auditing and reporting: Conducting regular energy and environmental audits, tracking performance against institutional sustainability targets;
* Internal staff leadership & vendor/ AMC governance:
* In-house crew management: Directing, scheduling, upskilling, and evaluating performance standards for in-house technicians, electricians, and shift engineers;
* Contractual SLA enforcement: Drafting technical SOWs/ RFPs, tracking performance scorecards, and enforcing strict SLAs/ KPIs for external IFM service providers and OEM AMC partners;
* Compliance & risk control: Ensuring 100% adherence to statutory EHS guidelines, Electrical Inspectorate norms, local municipal rules, and leading disaster management emergency response drills;
* Financial budgeting: Formulating and tracking OPEX/ CAPEX budgets for hard services, utility bills, spare parts inventory, and engineering repairs;
* Institutional:
* Providing support to other IIHS activities including academics, research, training, practice, operations and others;
* Participating in all activities of Institution-Building at IIHS; carrying out tasks as assigned by IIHS; and traveling on IIHS work within or outside the country as and when needed.

**Structure and Reporting**

The Manager (IFM – Hard Technical Services & Sustainable Operations) will report directly to the Head – Campus Development or to any other person designated by the
Head at IIHS. The incumbent will need to collaborate effectively with the Campus Development Team, internal engineering staff, and external IFM/ AMC vendors.

**Person Specification**

The ideal candidate should possess:

* Bachelor’s degree (B.E. / B.Tech) in Electrical or Mechanical; professional certifications such as LEED AP, IGBC AP, or Certified Energy Manager (CEM) are highly desirable;
* Minimum 9 years of hands-on experience managing hard technical services, mission-critical infrastructure, and sustainable operations within complex campus environments;
* In-depth operational knowledge of BMS/IoT integrations, predictive maintenance models, Computer-Aided Facility Management (CAFM)/CMMS software, and energy management systems;
* Proven vendor negotiation expertise, crisis management composure, strong leadership of blue-collar and engineering teams, and executive-level reporting.

This offer is on an exclusive basis, which implies that other professional assignments (whether compensated or not) that bear a potential conflict of interest with IIHS cannot be undertaken.

The search will remain open until the position is filled.

**Location**

This position is based in Kengeri, Bengaluru and may entail travel to other locations in India.

**Review and Assessment**

The role and performance of the incumbent shall be subject to normal review and assessment systems at IIHS.

**Diversity Policy**

IIHS is an equal opportunity employer that encourages women, people with disabilities and those from economically and socially excluded communities with the requisite skills and qualifications to apply for positions.

**Contact**

Please write to us at careers@iihs.co.in if you need any clarifications while filling the online application form.

* Partner with cross functional teams to enable value delivery.
* Ensure compliance with procurement policies, contracting standards, and audit requirements.

* Improve data quality and reporting (spend visibility, savings tracking, pipeline health, performance metrics).

title: Planning & Fulfillment Manager
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
  
  
This Position reports to:
  
  
Manufacturing Unit Manager
  
  
  
  
  
  
**What We Believe In**
At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.
  
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
In this role, you will Oversees supply planning, inventory management, and resource management in the regional distribution center or local Sales organization. Manages planning initiatives to improve customer on-time delivery and lead time, ensuring adherence to inventory and supply plan.
  
  
The work model for the role is:
  
  
This role is contributing to the ABB India, Electrification Business Smart Power Division in India. will be based at “Nelamangala - Bangalore – India”.
  
  
**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Manage site supply planning and scheduling, ensuring alignment with Hub/PG S&OP processes by providing visibility into supply capacity, local objectives, and the site's ability to support demand plans.
* Own inventory and working capital management, supporting optimization of raw materials, WIP, finished goods, and project inventories while maintaining effective inventory control processes and meeting NWC targets.
* Manage fulfillment and short-term operational planning (S&OE), coordinating cross-functional teams to respond to demand fluctuations, mitigate supply risks, and ensure profitable and timely customer order execution.
* Oversee supply chain improvement initiatives with Lean Six Sigma practices to boost on-time delivery, reduce cycle times, refine forecast accuracy, better manage inventory, and make more effective use of resources.
* Oversee planning functions, system improvements, and staff development to refine planning workflows, expand ERP adoption, enhance team skills, and improve organizational effectiveness while supporting a results-driven culture.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Qualification: Degree in Engineering with 15+ years of relevant experience in Material Planning, Supply Chain, or related disciplines.
* Extensive experience in Material Planning and Supply Chain Management, with extensive experience in inventory control, procurement, and production support within large-scale organizations in the switchgear and electrical industry.
* Extensive experience in S&OP, demand planning, purchasing, inventory management, and supply chain coordination, ensuring seamless material availability and operational efficiency.
* Solid understanding of import and export logistics, including supplier management, freight forwarding, customs regulations, and international trade processes.
* Demonstrated ability in inventory optimization and working capital management, balancing service levels, inventory turns, and cost-effective material planning.
* Collaborative leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to coordinate cross-functional efforts, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement initiatives across the supply chain.
* Experience with switchgear and electrical products, including MCBs, wiring accessories, and distribution boards (DBs), along with effective communication and problem-solving skills to identify risks, uncover opportunities, and carry out corrective actions.

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.
  
  
Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

description:

Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.
  
  
We’re an award-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of  what we do:
  
  

* UK & Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft & Oracle partner
* 3300+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
* 10+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland & UK
* Best Workplace for Women in the UK & Ireland by GPTW
* Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW

We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.
  
  
**Job Description**
As Partner Operations Manager you will support the Partner Commercial Lead ensuring Version 1 meets and advances its tier and compliance obligations across Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, and Anthropic (and other partnerships as we scale). You will lead a back-office team responsible for the operational infrastructure underpinning our partner programmes - tracking certifications, managing partner portals, monitoring consumption and funding, and ensuring timely reporting to both internal stakeholders and partner organisations. You will work closely with the partner operations team who manage the day-to-day strategic relationships, providing the operational rigour that enables those relationships to deliver commercially. You will support across the Partner Hub, Sales, Marketing, and Delivery to ensure partner requirements are understood and met across the business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain a comprehensive understanding of partner programme requirements across Microsoft (Solutions Partner/CSP), AWS (Partner Network tiers), Oracle (OPN), and Anthropic (Claude Partner Network), and ensure Version 1 meets all tier thresholds and compliance obligations.
* Support the partner commercial leads in building strong operational relationships with key partner stakeholders across Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, and Anthropic, ensuring Version 1 is visible and well-positioned within each partner ecosystem.
* Increase awareness within Version 1 of the requirements and benefits of working collaboratively with our strategic partners, acting as the internal subject matter expert on partner programme mechanics.
* Manage partner funding programmes throughout their entire lifecycle, acting as the primary liaison between vendors, partner hubs, and commercial sellers. Accountable for maintaining a funding automation solution and ensuring all submissions are progressed through to funding drawdown.
* Work closely with Parter Managers and Presales to identify and capitalise on key partner-involved deals early in the pipeline, and support collaboration with Commercial to optimise partner involvement in major opportunities.
* Own the development and maintenance of a Partner Performance Dashboard; closely monitor consumption and rebate revenue across all partner programmes, communicating performance issues and corrective actions to Hub Leads.
* Identify partner accreditation and certification opportunities that underpin and endorse our offerings.
* Maintain a consolidated schedule of accreditation and certification audits across all four partners and communicate requirements and deadlines to the relevant partner managers and the Partner Commercial Lead.
* Be accountable for the successful execution of partner accreditation and certification audits.
* Own day-to-day operation of all partner portals: Microsoft Partner Center, AWS Partner Central, Oracle Partner Network portal, and Anthropic's partner management platform. Responsible for pipeline updating, opportunity registration, and ensuring Version 1's profile and credentials are current across each.
* Monitor and analyse partner performance across all programmes, identifying areas for improvement and implementing corrective actions.
* Support partner-based marketing activities across all four partner ecosystems.
* Ensure that partner marketplaces (Azure Marketplace, AWS Marketplace, Oracle Cloud Marketplace) are refreshed regularly with Version 1 offerings.
* Assist with the formulation of win-wires and partner award submissions across all partner programmes.
* Deliver data-driven insights on training, accreditation, certification, and competency requirements across all partner programmes, ensuring Version 1's investment in credentials directly enhances our partnership tier status and commercial position.
* Serve as a central source of partner programme information across the business - ensuring compliance, maintaining consistency, and implementing corrective measures as necessary, while overseeing monthly and quarterly reporting to track progress against partner objectives.
* Mentor, train, and develop back-office team members for career progression, performance improvement, and recognition purposes.
* Act as the operational interface between the Partner Commercial Lead and the partner managers, translating strategic priorities into actionable compliance, certification, and reporting tasks with clear ownership and deadlines.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of Experience in the technology industry, ideally within a partner, alliances, or vendor management function.
* Proven track record in developing and implementing successful partner programmes and managing partner operations requirements.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain strong relationships both internally and with partner organisations.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyse partner performance data and identify trends and risks.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple partner workstreams simultaneously.
* Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines, compliance schedules, and stakeholder requirements simultaneously.
* Experience managing and developing operational teams, including performance management, mentoring, and workload prioritisation.
* Sufficient commercial and technical literacy to understand cloud and AI partner programme structures, consumption models, and marketplace mechanics across hyperscaler and AI vendor ecosystems.

**Additional Information**
Why Version 1?
  
  
At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.
  
  

* Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
* Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
* Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance

title: SOC Manager
description:
**Company Description**

ISECURION is a CERT-In empanelled and ISO 27001:2022 certified cybersecurity consulting company that helps organizations stay secure in a complex digital landscape. The team focuses on strengthening security posture, achieving compliance, and building long-term cyber resilience for businesses of varying sizes and sectors. ISECURION delivers services such as Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT), compliance audits, cloud security, DFIR, risk assessments, and managed security services. Its practical, business-focused approach ensures clients not only identify vulnerabilities, but also understand their impact, prioritize remediation, and align with industry best practices and regulatory standards. The company is driven by a passionate team committed to cybersecurity, research, innovation, and meaningful security outcomes for clients.

**Role Description**

We are looking for an experienced SOC Manager with 4-5 years of experience in security operations to lead our Security Operations Center function. The role involves managing day-to-day SOC operations, leading a team of analysts, overseeing incident detection and response, and acting as the primary escalation point for security incidents across client environments.

**Key Responsibilities:**

• Lead and manage day-to-day operations of the Security Operations Center (SOC), ensuring 24x7 monitoring and coverage.

• Supervise, mentor, and manage the performance of SOC analysts (L1/L2/L3) and ensure adherence to SLAs.

• Oversee triage, investigation, and response for security alerts and incidents escalated from SIEM and other monitoring tools.

• Act as the primary escalation point for critical and high-severity security incidents, coordinating response and remediation efforts.

• Define, review, and continuously improve SOC processes, playbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

• Monitor and fine-tune SIEM use cases, correlation rules, and alerting thresholds to reduce false positives.

• Drive incident response activities, including containment, eradication, and post-incident root cause analysis.

• Prepare and present SOC performance metrics, incident reports, and trend analysis to leadership and clients.

• Coordinate with threat intelligence, vulnerability management, and IT teams for a holistic security posture.

• Ensure SOC operations align with relevant compliance and regulatory requirements (ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, RBI, etc.).

• Support audits, client reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives for the SOC function.

• Stay current on emerging threats, attack techniques, and industry best practices to guide SOC strategy.

**Qualifications**

• Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight, Microsoft Sentinel, or similar.

• Strong understanding of the incident response lifecycle, threat hunting, and forensics fundamentals.

• Familiarity with EDR/XDR, IDS/IPS, firewalls, and endpoint security tools.

• Working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and common attack vectors/TTPs.

• Understanding of networking fundamentals, log analysis, and security monitoring across cloud and on-premise environments.

• Experience managing shift rosters, escalation matrices, and SLA-driven SOC operations.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

• 4-5 years of overall experience in security operations, threat monitoring, or incident response, including prior experience leading or mentoring a SOC team.

• Strong understanding of SIEM operations, threat detection, and incident response lifecycle.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

• CISSP /
CISM

• GIAC certifications (GCIH, GCIA, or similar)

• CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker)

• Any other relevant or equivalent certifications will also be considered valuable.

**Collaboration and Communication**

• Work closely with client stakeholders, leadership, and cross-functional teams to align SOC operations with business needs.

• Communicate incident status, risk, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Demonstrate strong leadership, decision-making, and team management skills in a fast-paced environment.

The Production Team Leader is responsible for leading day-to-day manufacturing operations to achieve safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost objectives. The Production Team Leader works closely with cross-functional teams to resolve operational challenges, strengthen workforce capability, and foster a safe, inclusive, and high-performance shop floor culture.
  
  
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

* Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, production planning, resource allocation, and capacity management.
* Experience monitoring manufacturing performance and driving improvements in safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost.
* Experience working cross-functionally with functions such as Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Maintenance, and Human Resources.
* Working knowledge of applicable labor practices, collective bargaining agreements, employee relations, and workplace discipline processes.
* Strong communication, problem-solving, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.

* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, Black Belt, or equivalent continuous improvement certification.
* Practical experience applying Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, root cause analysis, and structured problem-solving methodologies.
* Knowledge of ERP/MRP systems within a manufacturing environment.
* Experience supporting automation, digitization, or factory modernization initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to develop employees through coaching, training, and multi-skilling.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing quality systems, regulatory requirements, and EHS practices.
* Ability to lead effectively in a fast-paced manufacturing environment while balancing customer commitments and operational priorities.
