title: Assistant Manager, Strategic Partner Operations
description:
**ABOUT US:**
LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.
  
  
LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.
  
  
**OUR PEOPLE:**
People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.
  
  
We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.
  
  
ROLE PROFILE:
  
  
The Strategic Partner Operations team supports the commercial management of LSEG’s Strategic Partner ecosystem, including Co-Sell and Re-Sell Partners. The team is responsible for maintaining accurate partner reporting, supporting revenue share and Co-Sell reporting processes, and providing a reliable view of the Partner book of business.
  
  
The team works closely with Partner Directors, Finance, Operations and other teams to improve data quality, reporting, revenue attribution and operational processes.
  
  
The team is responsible for maintaining and analysing the Partner book of business, consolidating reporting from partners and internal systems, identifying trends and data-quality gaps, and improving how end-client relationships, revenue and partner performance are tracked.
  
  
The team also manages the development and maintenance of a centralised global repository for Strategic Partner agreements, initially focused on Co-Sell agreements, to improve accessibility, governance and consistency of contractual information.
  
  
**ROLE SUMMARY:**
The successful candidate will be part of the Global Strategic Partners organisation and will lead the Strategic Partner Operations team, with two Senior Analysts reporting to the role.
  
  
The Assistant Manager will be responsible for maintaining and improving reporting across the Co-Sell and Re-Sell Partner portfolio, ensuring a trusted view of the Partner book of business and strengthening the processes, tools and controls that support the team.
  
  
The role will also lead the development of a centralised repository for Co-Sell Partner agreements, ensuring contracts and key information are accurately captured, organised and accessible. The Assistant Manager will work closely with Partner Directors and other stakeholders to improve reporting, data quality, governance and operational processes as the business grows.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:**

* Lead the Strategic Partner Operations team and directly manage two Senior Analysts, setting priorities, supporting development and ensuring high-quality delivery.
* Own the collection, consolidation and analysis of reporting received from Co-Sell Partners, ensuring submissions are timely, complete and aligned to agreed requirements.
* Maintain the Co-Sell and Re-Sell book of business as a reliable source of truth across partner, end-client, revenue, product and geographic information.
* Lead the development and maintenance of a centralised global repository for Co-Sell Partner agreements, ensuring documentation is complete, accurate and accessible.
* Maintain key contractual information and support governance of the repository, working with Partner Directors and relevant teams to address missing or outdated records.
* Reconcile partner reported information against internal systems and commercial records, identifying discrepancies, duplicate records, missing data and other data-quality issues.
* Produce regular management reporting and dashboards covering Partner performance, revenue contribution, end-client activity and key trends.
* Work with Finance and other teams to improve the consistency and accuracy of Co-Sell revenue attribution.
* Provide analysis and insights to Partner Directors and the Global Strategic Partners leadership team to support commercial priorities and decision making.
* Lead improvements to reporting tools and processes, with a focus on automation, scalability, accuracy and reducing manual activity.
* Establish clear reporting standards, controls and operating rhythms across the team to ensure consistent and high-quality delivery.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

* Experience in business, partner, commercial or revenue operations, with responsibility for reporting, data management and operational processes.
* Experience building, maintaining and governing databases, books of business or commercial data repositories, with a focus on data quality and accuracy.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis, with experience working with large and complex datasets.
* Experience using CRM, reporting and data visualisation tools, such as Salesforce and Power BI, to develop dashboards and management reporting.
* Experience developing and improving operational processes, with a focus on simplification, automation and scalability.
* Ability to interpret commercial contracts and agreements and translate contractual terms, reporting obligations and commercial models into operational requirements.
* Experience with commercial reporting and revenue attribution, including reconciling information across multiple systems and identifying data gaps or inconsistencies.
* Ability to translate complex data into clear insights and recommendations that support business decisions.
* Effective communication and management skills, with the ability to collaborate across Partner, Finance, Sales, Operations and other global teams.
* Experience leading and developing team members, setting priorities, managing delivery and creating an inclusive, collaborative and accountable team environment.
* Commitment to data quality, operational excellence, governance and continuous improvement.

**WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:**
As a member of the Global Strategic Partners organisation, you will gain exposure to some of LSEG's most important Co-Sell and Re-Sell Partners and to the breadth of Data & Analytics and Risk Intelligence products and services that underpin those relationships.
  
  
You will work closely with Partner Directors and Managers, Sales, Finance, Product, Operations and other specialist teams, giving you a broad understanding of how strategic partnerships are managed and how partner ecosystems contribute to LSEG's growth.
  
  
The role offers the opportunity to shape how we measure and manage the Co-Sell and Re-Sell business, improve the quality of decision-making through better data and reporting, and build scalable processes that can support future growth. You will also gain regular exposure to senior leaders and have the support of the wider team to help you develop your commercial, analytical and management capabilities.
  
  
You will also gain hands on experience leading and developing a team and working with key data, CRM, reporting and visualisation tools, including Excel, Salesforce and Power BI, while helping shape the tools and processes that support Strategic Partner Operations.
  
  
We recognize that to attract the best talent, we need to be flexible and we are open to discussing work arrangements with you. We take hybrid approach to workplace, this role is blended.
  
  
**Career Stage:**
Senior Associate
  
  
**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**
Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.
  
  
Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of
**Integrity, Partnership**
,
**Excellence**
and
**Change**
underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.
  
  
Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.
  
  
We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.
  
  
LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

title: AI Platform Services Manager
description:

Lead the strategic service direction, governance, and financial management of Hitachi Energy’s enterprise AI Platform services. * Strong knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI, risk management, compliance, and audit controls.
* Experience with FinOps, budgeting, consumption management, capacity planning, and cost optimization.
* Expertise in vendor management, licensing, contracts, renewals, and commercial negotiations.
* Solid understanding of enterprise AI platforms, cloud technologies, model lifecycle governance, and software delivery.
* Proven ability to lead, coach, and develop multidisciplinary teams in complex global environments.
* Excellent stakeholder management, strategic thinking, communication, and organizational skills.

title: Supervisor Data Management & Governance
description:
At Cardinal Health, we're developing innovative products and services that make healthcare safer and more productive. Join a growing, global company genuinely committed to making a difference for our customers and communities.

The Data & Analytics Function oversees the analytics lifecycle in order to identify, analyze and present relevant insights that drive business decisions and anticipate opportunities to achieve a competitive advantage. This function manages analytic data platforms, the access, design and implementation of reporting/business intelligence solutions, and the application of advanced quantitative modeling.

Data management acquires, validates, standardizes, enriches, protects and publishes structured, third party and unstructured data for use by the business. **Lead Operations. Drive Excellence. Deliver Unrivalled Experiences.**

**SWIFT Elite Cars is looking for a proactive and experienced Operations Manager**
to oversee daily transportation operations, manage fleet utilization, coordinate chauffeur services, and ensure seamless service delivery for our corporate and premium clientele.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in fleet management, operational planning, team leadership, and customer service, with the ability to maintain high service standards while improving operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

* **Daily Operations Management:**
  Oversee daily car rental and chauffeur-driven transportation operations to ensure smooth and timely service delivery.
* **Fleet Management:**
  Monitor vehicle availability, allocation, utilization, maintenance schedules, and operational readiness.
* **Trip Coordination:**
  Manage bookings, vehicle dispatch, chauffeur assignments, route planning, and real-time trip tracking.
* **Chauffeur Management:**
  Supervise drivers and operations staff, monitor attendance and performance, and ensure professional conduct.
* **Corporate Client Servicing:**
  Coordinate with corporate clients and key accounts to meet transportation requirements and resolve service-related issues.
* **Operational Efficiency:**
  Develop and implement processes to improve productivity, reduce delays, optimize fleet utilization, and control operating costs.
* **Service Quality:**
  Ensure timely pickups, professional chauffeur services, vehicle cleanliness, and a consistent premium customer experience.
* **Issue & Escalation Management:**
  Handle last-minute booking changes, vehicle breakdowns, chauffeur replacements, customer complaints, and other operational challenges.
* **Performance Monitoring:**
  Track operational KPIs, trip completion rates, vehicle utilization, customer feedback, and team productivity.
* **Reporting & Documentation:**
  Maintain accurate trip records, operational reports, vehicle documents, and other relevant records.
* **Compliance & Safety:**
  Ensure adherence to company policies, vehicle documentation requirements, safety standards, and applicable transport regulations.
* **Cross-Functional Coordination:**
  Work closely with sales, customer service, finance, and other teams to ensure seamless operations.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field preferred.
* 5–8 years of experience in transportation, car rental, fleet management, employee transportation, or chauffeur-driven services.
* Proven experience managing day-to-day operations, drivers, fleet allocation, and service delivery.
* Strong understanding of vehicle scheduling, trip monitoring, fleet utilization, and operational reporting.
* Excellent leadership, communication, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and fleet management or transportation management systems.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* A customer-first mindset with a strong focus on accountability, efficiency, and service excellence.

What We’re Looking For

A hands-on operations leader who can manage people, vehicles, and processes efficiently while ensuring reliability, cost control, and exceptional service for every journey.

Why Join SWIFT Elite Cars?

* Work with a premium car rental and chauffeur-driven mobility brand.
* Take ownership of critical operational functions and fleet performance.
* Collaborate with a professional team serving corporate and premium customers.
* Contribute to operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and business growth.

📩
**Interested candidates can apply directly through LinkedIn or share their CV at animeshm@swiftelite.co.in**

title: Manager, Data Management

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+

Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology,
  
  
infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
The TechOps SAP Integration Suite Manager is responsible for leading the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of enterprise integration solutions using SAP Integration Suite (SAP BTP Integration Suite). The role combines technical leadership, operational governance, stakeholder management, and team leadership to ensure seamless integration between SAP and non-SAP systems.
  
  
Key Responsibilities:
  
  

* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and oversee-ing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

Technical Leadership
  
  

* Lead integration development teams and provide technical guidance.
* Review solution designs, integration flows, and technical specifications. Mentor developers and promote engineering excellence.
* Drive technology adoption and continuous improvement initiatives.

SAP Integration Suite Operations (TechOps)
  
  

* Manage production support and operational readiness. Monitor integration interfaces and message processing.
* Handle incidents, root cause analysis, and problem management. Ensure SLA compliance and service availability.
* Implement proactive monitoring and alerting mechanisms.

Solution Development & Delivery
  
  

* Oversee development of integration flows, APIs, mappings, and adapters. Support integrations using REST, SOAP, OData, SFTP, IDoc, RFC, and APIs. Participate in complex integration design and implementation activities.
* Ensure successful deployment through Dev, QA, and Production environments.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management
  
  

* Collaborate with business, SAP functional teams, infrastructure, and security teams. Manage relationships with implementation partners and external vendors.
* Present project status, risks, and mitigation plans to leadership.

Governance, Compliance & Documentation
  
  

* Maintain architecture diagrams, integration catalogues, and operational procedures. Ensure compliance with security, audit, and regulatory requirements.
* Drive change management and release governance processes.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* 12+ years of SAP integration experience.
* 3+ years leading integration teams or managing enterprise integration platforms. SAP Integration Suite/BTP certifications preferred.

authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

Experience in IT Service environmentExperience in managing User access provisioning and Software LicensingExperience of managing 24x7 OperationsExperience of working with VendorsWorking experience in Service Management role
  
  
**Whats in it for you?**
  
At Tesco, we are committed to providing the best for you. 
  
 
  
As a result, our colleagues enjoy a unique, differentiated, market- competitive reward package, based on the current industry practices, for all the work they put into serving our customers, communities and planet a little better every day. 
  
 
  
Our Tesco Rewards framework consists of pillars - Fixed Pay, Incentives, and Benefits.  
  
 
  
Total Rewards offered at Tesco is determined by four principles -simple, fair, competitive, and sustainable. 
  
 
  
**Salary**
- Your fixed pay is the guaranteed pay as per your contract of employment. 
  
 
  
**Leave & Time-off**
- Colleagues are entitled to 30 days of leave (18 days of Earned Leave, 12 days of Casual/Sick Leave) and 10 national and festival holidays, as per the company’s policy. 
  
 
  
**Making Retirement Tension-FreeSalary**
- In addition to Statutory retirement beneets, Tesco enables colleagues to participate in voluntary programmes like NPS and VPF. 
  
 
  
**Health is Wealth**
- Tesco promotes programmes that support a culture of health and wellness including insurance for colleagues and their family. Our medical insurance provides coverage for dependents including parents or in-laws. 
  
 
  
**Mental Wellbeing**
- We offer mental health support through self-help tools, community groups, ally networks, face-to-face counselling, and more for both colleagues and dependents.  
  
 
  
**Financial Wellbeing**
- Through our financial literacy partner, we offer one-to-one financial coaching at discounted rates, as well as salary advances on earned wages upon request.  
  
 
  
**Save As You Earn (SAYE)**
- Our SAYE programme allows colleagues to transition from being employees to Tesco shareholders through a structured 3-year savings plan.  
  
 
  
**Physical Wellbeing**
- Our green campus promotes physical wellbeing with facilities that include a cricket pitch, football field, badminton and volleyball courts, along with indoor games, encouraging a healthier lifestyle. 
  
  
**About Us**
At Tesco, inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. We believe in treating everyone fairly and with respect, valuing individuality and uniqueness to create a true sense of belonging. Diversity and inclusion are deeply embedded in our values—we treat people how they want to be treated. Our goal is for all colleagues to feel they can be themselves at work, and we are committed to helping them thrive. Across the Tesco group, we are building an inclusive workplace that actively celebrates the cultures, personalities, and preferences of our colleagues, who in turn contribute to the success of our business and reflect the diversity of the communities we serve. 
  
 
  
 At Tesco Bengaluru, we are proud to be a Disability Confident Committed Employer, highlighting our commitment to creating a supportive environment for individuals with disabilities. We are dedicated to offering equal opportunities for all candidates and encourage applicants with disabilities to apply. Our recruitment process is fully accessible, and we are happy to provide reasonable adjustments during interviews. If you need any accommodations to participate in the recruitment process, please let us know. We are here to ensure that everyone has the chance to succeed. 
  
 
  
 We also believe in fostering a work environment where you can excel both professionally and personally. Our hybrid model allows you to work flexibly—spend 60% of your week collaborating in person with colleagues at our office locations or local sites, and the rest of the time working remotely. We understand that everyone’s life journey is unique, whether you are starting your career, pursuing passions, or navigating life changes, and we are here to support you. Flexibility is a core part of our culture, and we encourage open conversations about how we can best accommodate your needs, so talk to us throughout your application process on the support required.
  
 
  
When you join Tesco Bengaluru in this role, you'll be employed by Tesco Bengaluru Private Limited, the Tesco legal entity responsible for your employment.

title: Manager, Travel Experience Consultant
description:
As a Manager, Travel Experience Consultant, you will lead a dedicated team of Travel Consultants. This role requires a unique blend of people leadership, operational management, and relationship cultivation. You will be responsible for the day-to-day oversight of your team, ensuring they provide exceptional service, while also managing the strategic service relationship with the dedicated customer's Travel Manager and Specialists.
  
  
Your leadership will be key to developing a high-performing team, driving continuous improvement, and ensuring the success of the offline travel program for our most valued customers.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* People Leadership & Development: Serve as the frontline manager for a team of Business Travel Consultants. You will be responsible for coaching, training, and upskilling team members to deliver a best-in-class customer experience.
* Performance Management: Conduct regular 1:1 meetings and quarterly reviews to monitor progress, set clear expectations, and track career development using career maps. Provide continuous performance feedback to encourage desired behaviors and ensure alignment with corporate goals.
* Operational Management: Oversee the team's operational performance, monitoring call queues (ACD) and SLAs to ensure goals are met. You will perform root cause analysis on common service issues to develop and implement permanent corrective actions and process improvements.
* Customer Relationship Management: Act as the primary point of contact for the dedicated customer's Travel Manager. You will conduct regular check-ins, present performance statistics, and collaborate on improvement plans and service enhancements.
* Issue & Escalation Resolution:Take ownership of customer escalations, managing and resolving issues from start to finish. You will coach your team to proactively address traveler inquiries and aim for first-contact resolution. As Manager, you may also need to step in and directly handle escalated chats and calls to ensure prompt and effective resolution.
* Collaboration & Communication: Collaborate with the wider support team to meet performance and behavior metrics. You will work with your manager to prioritize and address customer requests for product and service enhancements. You will also communicate transparently with the dedicated customer about service improvements and corrective actions.
* Talent Acquisition & Onboarding: Screen and interview new hires as the organization scales. You will provide input for the New Hire Training Program and ensure its effective execution for modules delivered by the support team.
* Administrative Oversight: Manage approvals for employee travel bookings and handle Resignation Conversations with departing employees. You will lead these discussions with respect and curiosity, documenting insights to help improve the company.
* Engagement & Culture: Organize team engagement activities, both in-person and remote, to foster a positive, collaborative, and high-performing team culture.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Experience: A minimum of 5 years of progressive leadership experience in a contact center or support environment, with at least 5 years of experience at the manager level.
* Industry Expertise: A minimum of 5 years of experience in the travel industry, with deep knowledge of GDS platforms (Sabre and/or Amadeus).
* Customer Focus: A proven ability to live and breathe customer support, with a commitment to high customer engagement and a passion for resolving complex customer issues.
* Leadership Skills: A track record of building relationships, motivating teams, and acting as a proven mentor. You should have a clear understanding of the challenges facing a fast-growing company.
* Analytical Abilities: The ability to use a data-driven approach to identify operational challenges and inform strategic decisions.
* Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, along with strong presentation and facilitation skills.
* Technical Acumen: Familiarity with CRM applications (e.g., Salesforce, Twilio) and contact center applications (e.g., Calabrio, WorkDay).
* Personal Attributes: Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills. You should be able to work independently and as part of a team, and be flexible to work non-traditional shifts as needed.
* Education: Bachelor's degree preferred.

**What Sets You Apart**

* A reputation as a resolution-focused leader who champions change and consistently exceeds expectations.
* A proven ability to proactively identify and implement process improvements.
* A passion for developing others and fostering a solutions-oriented team culture.

title: Manager Business Optimization
description:
**About Us**

As a leading provider of high-quality food and beverage ingredients, we work with farming communities across the globe to grow, source and produce ingredients that are good for consumers, farmers, and the world around us. We supply household food brands and manufacturers worldwide with cocoa, coffee, dairy, nuts and spices ingredients which are often grown on our own farms and estates and sourced from hundreds of thousands of farmers across ~50 countries. Along with our diverse manufacturing and innovation capabilities, this means we can provide ingredients for a range of products, from a plant-based latte mix to an almond based snack bar or a dairy-free ice cream. Making a positive impact on people and planet is a core component of our Purpose, to be the change for good food and a healthy future. With a deep-rooted presence in the countries where our ingredients are grown, we are closer to farmers, enabling better quality, and more reliable, traceable, and transparent supply. And whoever we’re with, whatever we’re doing, we always make it real.

**Overview of the role**

Work with Procurement and planning teams to optimize the economic and operational performance of the plan-to-produce and source-to-pay processes across multiple food-ingredient manufacturing sites. The role combines demand and production planning, procurement analytics, cost analytics, and the digitalization of both functions — including applied AI and automation. It exists to close the value leakage that sits between planning, buying, and finance, and to engineer it out of the process permanently.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Demand & production planning**
  — work alongside the demand and production planners who own the plan: strengthen the statistical forecast baseline for a multi-thousand-SKU portfolio, introduce forecast variance and FVA discipline, improve line-level scheduling logic across blending and packaging capacity, and sharpen MRP shortage, scenario and S&OP analytics.
* **Procurement analytics**
  — equip category buyers with the analysis behind their decisions: vendor pricing and spend visibility, category planning and coverage tooling, BOM-based demand attribution to suppliers, supplier risk classification, and should-cost and make-vs-buy support.
* **Cost & financial analytics**
  — give Finance and Operations a common, trusted view of where value leaks: standard cost roll-up through multi-level BOMs, manufacturing variance analysis (PPV, yield, absorption), margin and working-capital impact of planning policy, SLOB/E&O exposure, and inventory and DIO reporting.
* **Service performance**
  — measure OTIF and fill rate on the customer's own methodology and attribute every miss to a planning, supply or capacity root cause, so the accountable function can act on evidence rather than opinion.
* **Digitalisation & AI**
  — the accountability owned outright: replace manual spreadsheet processes with auditable automated systems, build the planning and procurement decision tools the functions run on, and apply AI to analysis, extraction and workflow automation with defined validation and governance.
* **ERP & planning systems**
  — support the functional process owners through ERP and planning-platform implementation and migration: requirements definition, master data governance, data migration, UAT, cutover and hypercare.
* **Influence & team leadership**
  — direct and quality-assure an offshore analytics team, and earn adoption without direct authority by working through the incumbents in Commercial, Procurement, Manufacturing, IT and Finance who own the processes being improved.

**Experience and Qualification**

* Degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Statistics, Accounting or a related quantitative field.
* Cost or management accounting qualification (CMA / CIMA / ICMAI or equivalent) held alongside operational supply chain accountability.
* 10+ years spanning all three of demand planning, production planning, and procurement analytics — depth in one or two is not sufficient.
* 3+ years in food, beverage, spice or food-ingredient manufacturing (allergen controls, lot traceability, shelf life).
* Administrator-level configuration experience on an advanced planning system (DemandCaster strongly preferred), plus hands-on ERP data-level SQL in more than one dialect (Plex and Snowflake strongly preferred).
* Full-lifecycle ERP or planning-platform implementation as business process owner, through cutover and hypercare.
* Applied intermittent-demand forecasting (Croston, SBA, TSB, ADI/CV² classification, Forecast Value Add).
* Proven ability to build and deploy production-grade planning and procurement tools independently — advanced Excel engineering plus browser-based analytics applications. No dedicated developer support in this role.
* Demonstrated AI-enabled automation in production use, with a stated efficiency or accuracy result and a described validation and governance approach.
* Multi-site accountability and experience directing an offshore analytics team.
* Preferred: CPIM / CSCP / CPSM; Python or R; SAP IBP / S4 or Blue Yonder exposure; agricultural commodity or packaging category experience.

**First Year Success Measures**

Success in year one is evidenced by working systems in daily use and a quantified benefit, not by analysis delivered:

* Planning — corrected end-to-end capacity model in live use by the planners, and FVA reporting running in the monthly S&OP cycle.
* Procurement — buyer category console deployed and adopted by the buying team, with coverage and supplier risk visible in one place.
* Cost & working capital — quantified PPV and working-capital benefit agreed with Finance, and reduced aged SLOB exposure.
* Service — measurable OTIF and fill-rate improvement on the customer's own methodology, with every miss attributed to a root cause and owner.
* Digitalisation — phase one of the roadmap delivered, with the manual spreadsheet routines it replaced retired rather than run in parallel.

title: Manager - Breakdown & Repair Maintenance
description:
**About the Role:**

Manager Breakdown Maintenance & Preventive Maintenance is to ensure that equipment and machinery in a Café set up are maintained and repaired efficiently when they break down or experience unexpected failures. The role involves a combination of technical, managerial, and organizational tasks. Here are the key responsibilities.

**Roles and Responsibility:**

* Break down maintenance: Responsible for 450 cafes and 200 CDX(Xpress) outlets across the country .
* Repair & maintenance: Responsible for 450 cafes and 200 CDX(Xpress) outlets across the country .
* Supervision: Building program of all heating and A/C and Refrigeration based on daily schedules
* Equipment Inspection and Assessment: Conduct regular inspections of supplies, tools, machinery and equipment to identify potential issues.
* Emergency Response: Quickly respond to breakdowns or unexpected equipment failures, ensuring that downtime is minimized to maintain
* Diagnosis: Identify the root causes of equipment failures and breakdowns by working with maintenance teams and using diagnostic tools.
* Coordination: Coordinate with maintenance technicians, mechanics, and engineers to ensure prompt repair and maintenance activities
* Resource Allocation: Allocate resources, such as personnel, tools, and spare parts, to address breakdowns efficiently.
* Scheduling: Develop and maintain a maintenance schedule to prevent future breakdowns by conducting routine maintenance activities and predictive maintenance.
* Cost Management: Monitor and manage the budget allocated for breakdown maintenance, making sure it is used effectively and efficiently.
* Vendor Management: Work with external vendors and suppliers to source replacement parts and services as needed for repairs.
* Documentation: Maintain detailed records of equipment breakdowns, repairs, and maintenance activities for future reference and analysis.
* Reporting: Provide regular reports to higher management on breakdown statistics, downtime, and measures taken to address them.
* Safety Compliance: Ensure that all maintenance activities comply with safety regulations and standards to protect the well-being of maintenance staff and other employees.
* Training: Develop and implement training programs for maintenance personnel to enhance their skills in diagnosing and repairing equipment.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for process and equipment improvement to reduce the frequency of breakdowns.
* Inventory Management: Oversee the inventory of spare parts and supplies required for breakdown maintenance to ensure an adequate supply.
* Root Cause Analysis: Conduct root cause analysis to prevent recurring breakdowns by addressing underlying issues.
* Quality Control: Ensure that equipment repairs and maintenance are done to high standards to prevent frequent breakdowns and maximize equipment lifespan.
* Collaboration: Work closely with other departments, such as production and engineering, to understand their needs and coordinate maintenance activities accordingly.
* Overall, the breakdown maintenance manager plays a crucial role in minimizing equipment downtime, ensuring the reliability and efficiency of production processes, and reducing maintenance-related costs QSR (Quick Service restaurant) environment.

**Experience & Qualification:**

1. Any bachelor's degree (mechanical, electrical, industrial, etc.) is preferable.
2. 10+ years of experience. 5+ Years - experience in Retail chains.
3. Good Arithmetical & Reasoning Ability
4. Effective communication skills to convey technical information to team members, other departments, and stakeholders.
5. Clear communication during breakdown situations to coordinate activities and provide updates.
6. Extensive Experience in A/C and Refrigeration for Repair and maintenance of equipment in Cafés
7. Capability to assess the technical skills of the maintenance team.
8. Knowledge In Troubleshoot
9. Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS) for tracking and managing maintenance activities.
10. Ability to leverage technology for planning, scheduling, and analyzing breakdown maintenance data.

**Language Fluency: English, Hindi and Kannada. Open to travel PAN India**

**Job Description:**
The Manager, Evidence Generation Operations Enablement (non-site based) provides non-site-based study operations support across intake and triage, study progress documentation, close-out tracking, fair market value support, cross-functional coordination, investigator-initiated and collaborative research contracting support, evidence package upload, and vendor artifact storage. The role delivers consistent, high-quality, and traceable operational execution across repeatable evidence generation workflows, enabling Global Evidence Generation teams to focus on scientific strategy, study prioritization, final decisions, and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
**About the Role:**
The Manager, Evidence Generation Operations Enablement (non-site based) coordinates study operations activities across multiple non-site-based study types. The role manages intake completeness, review logistics, study documentation, close-out packages, FMV records, contracting materials, vendor artifacts, and evidence package archival. The role works with Global Evidence Generation, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Procurement, local operating companies, vendors, and study teams, escalating strategic, scientific, budget, legal, compliance, or non-standard documentation questions to the appropriate owner.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute:**

* Receive and log evidence generation, collaborative research, study support, and contracting requests, including requester, asset, indication, region, timing, request type, and completeness status.
* Conduct first-pass completeness checks and route requests to the appropriate Global Evidence Generation, portfolio, study, or functional owner.
* Coordinate cross-functional synopsis and protocol review logistics, including reviewer lists, timelines, meeting scheduling, comment collation, version control, and action tracking.
* Escalate conflicting scientific, strategic, legal, or compliance comments to Global Evidence Generation for resolution.
* Maintain study documentation checklists, status trackers, milestone updates, open-action logs, and repository records for assigned non-site-based studies.
* Prepare study status summaries for study leads or governance review, including progress updates, risks, dependencies, and missing documentation.
* Apply standard close-out procedures, collect final study documents, track vendor, budget, and contract close-out actions, and store final close-out packages.
* Flag missing documents, unresolved payments, pending approvals, open risks, or study-specific exceptions to the appropriate owner.
* Support first-pass FMV documentation, rate-table checks, assumption capture, and archival of FMV outcomes with contract packages.
* Prepare internal contracting initiation packages for investigator-initiated research, collaborative research, and other non-site-based agreements, including study overview, intellectual property terms, publication rights, budget inputs, and required approvals.
* Coordinate Legal or shared contracting review and track amendments, renewal triggers, negotiation points, and contracting lifecycle milestones.
* Store vendor artifacts, statements of work, scorecards, correspondence, contract records, and performance documentation with correct metadata, access controls, retention category, and study linkage.
* Maintain traceable logs for intake, review, contracting, close-out, vendor artifacts, and evidence package archival.
* Identify recurring process gaps and support improvements to templates, trackers, checklists, and handoff materials aligned with quality and compliance requirements.
* Use approved digital, automation, and AI-enabled tools, where appropriate, to support intake, documentation tracking, review coordination, issue identification, and operational reporting while maintaining accuracy, traceability, privacy, and human oversight.

**Qualifications:**

* A degree in a scientific, medical, life sciences, pharmacy, public health, operations, health economics, or related discipline is required.

* Working knowledge of evidence generation study operations, intake management, documentation tracking, study close-out, and cross-functional review coordination.
* Familiarity with investigator-initiated research, collaborative research, contracting workflows, FMV documentation, Legal review routing, and vendor artifact management.

title: Global Treasury Operations, Manager
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
An experienced individual for our Markets Operations who demonstrates subject matter expertise in one or more responsibilities of the operation that includes the execution of Global Treasury investment portfolio and/or liability management related workflows, supports Funding and Collateral Transformation products in line with market deadlines and internal SLAs. The individual works independently with regard to accomplishing responsibilities, strives to provide excellent client service and supports Risk Excellence culture of State Street. The individual should possess extensive knowledge and experience on securities, settlements, rates, treasury products, and related financial attributes. Will require to work closely with Business teams, Functional teams, Business Risk, Compliance and Technology teams on day-to-day basis to ensure seamless BAU. A large element of the role is transformation of the function, from operating model changes to a new technology infrastructure to reduce risk, create efficiency and improve service delivery. The role will be needed to drive the transformation whilst remaining focused on BAU so as to not compromise on service.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
The team you will be joining plays an important role in the overall success of State Street. As a leading provider of trading and lending solutions to the world’s institutional investors, we deliver the industry’s most innovative platforms, financing and portfolio solutions. Our capabilities are backed by proprietary, high-value research, insights and indicators that power clients’ investment decisions, accelerate performance and help investors stay ahead of shifting markets. Across our comprehensive set of solutions – data-driven macro market intelligence that give an information advantage; client-first platforms and tools that redefine trading; financing solutions that streamline liquidity access; and portfolio solutions designed to help achieve peak performance – we deliver a breakthrough edge to drive business success.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As an Officer you will
  
  

* Liaise with front office, compliance, finance, claims, and IT teams to support the full trade lifecycle.
* Responsible for Markets participation in programs such as ISO 20022, TD+1, and other bank wide initiatives.
* Provide Trade Support for Asset Management and Liability Management teams of Global Treasury
* Actively participate in the Peer Repo project and implementation
* Monitor exception reporting and provide necessary insight on resolution
* Monitor derivative and investment portfolio valuations and report on exceptions
* Investigate recon variances and provide root cause analysis
* Provide trade support and static data set up for Funding and Collateral Transformation team
* Monitor and perform collateral management functions in accordance with approved policies and procedures
* Oversee daily activities and help junior team members with subject matter expertise, trainings and understanding the core business operations
* Proposes and works to implement workflow changes, leading to improved productivity
* Work directly with the business and other Global Treasury stakeholders to provide information and/or operational solutions as needed
* Work proactively on updating job aids and procedures, making sure that team is adhering to the newly adopted processes
* Support the “Risk Excellence” culture within the business
* Work well with all GTO members and GT/GM stakeholders as demonstrated by being responsive to requests, striving for excellent client service
* Execute Funds & Securities Transfers for Repo/Reverse Repo activities.
* Perform or approve cash/GL processing.
* Take a leadership role in broader based projects as a subject matter expert.
* Responsible for KRI/Operating Metrics reporting and other overarching team related responsibilities.
* Focus on the control environment to drive a strong risk & control culture across the global teams to ensure processes are robust & compliant.
* Partner with Technology and partake in Markets Operations to deliver a best-in-class E2E workflow solution, removing manual touchpoints and increasing STP
* Support applicable Change the Bank and Run the Bank Projects impacting the team, from inception; providing SME support, testing and monitoring into Production.
* Ensure vendor oversight and hold them accountable to high standards of delivery. Stay abreast of all regulatory and market changes and ensure adherence and no impact to service standards as a result of these changes.
* Partner with ERM and compliance colleagues globally to ensure Markets Operations remains disciplined with respect to adherence to resiliency strategy, control assurance etc.
* Support audits and ensure adherence to operational risk and compliance policies.
* High level of personal commitment to each task, can-do attitude, and a drive to deliver.
* Proactive approach to problem solving, delivering results and finding better ways.

**What We Value**
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* Strong risk mitigation, problem solving, and decision making skills
* Ability to think critically and resolve complex problems
* Drive automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency
* Stay updated on industry regulations and best practices related to FX Confirmation, Settlement operations.

**What You'll Bring To The Role**

* Front-to-back knowledge of the Treasury product related Confirmation, Settlement, systems, markets and instruments
* Hands-on experience in managing FICC, NSCC, Repo, reverse repo, DTC and FED settlements
* Working knowledge in Settlement/Payment department & understanding payment life cycle
* Familiarity with systems such as Markitwire, Summit, In-trader, MCH, Hogan , IBS, Bloomberg, FXALL, SWIFT

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Graduate and above preferably in Finance
* B.COM, BBM/BBA. MBA (Finance), M.COM or any degree related to Finance or Commerce
* Good knowledge in Back-office confirmations and settlement
* Knowledge of Global Markets, custody, cash management and payment systems
* Good Communication Skills both written and oral
* 10+ years of experience in Treasury/Investment operations/Financial Services industry

**Additional Requirements**

* Knowledge of Macros, Artificial intelligence, Automation tool etc
* Shift Timings: NAM - 6pm to 3am IST
* Persona: 4 days' work from office
* Location: Mumbai / Bangalore

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

**As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets.**
**At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.**

**Your Role:**
R&D Operations and Communication Manager
  
  
**Location:**
Elanco IAC, Bangalore
  
  
**Reports to:**
R&D Site Lead
  
  
**Role Summary**
This role is a strategic partner and force multiplier to the R&D Site Lead & Lead Team, operating at the center of site leadership rather than in support of it.
  
  
This role is responsible for translating global & site strategy into tangible action, culture & communication at Elanco Innovation & Alliance Center (IAC).
  
  
This role is responsible for serving as the chief of operations and communications for the local site. The person in this role serves as a trusted extension of the R&D Lead Team, representing the office in forums where sound judgment, discretion, and credibility are essential.
  
  
The Site Operations role not only provides administrative and coordination support but also helps advance key site priorities through a focus on leadership effectiveness, strategic alignment, and organizational health advancing global initiatives and translating them at the ground level in consultation with the local R&D Lead Team.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities: -**
**Strategic Partnership & Site Leadership**

* Serve as strategic advisor and thought partner to the R&D Site Lead & Lead Team shaping how strategic initiatives translate into concrete site-level action
* Partner with the leadership team and enable the site's strategic planning and prioritization efforts by facilitating discussions, tracking key initiatives, and helping ensure leadership attention is directed toward critical priorities
* Facilitate stakeholder discussions and support business case development for strategic site capabilities, including opportunities to enhance IAC’s role as an AI hub within the R&D, partnering on the AI COP
* Build and sustain direct working partnerships with R&D executive and functional lead team members, acting as a trusted point of contact on their behalf for site-level priorities, cross-functional dependencies, and follow-through

**Executive Communications & Organizational Narrative**

* Provide support and enable successful delivery of flagship site events such as R&D Connect Week —from theme and content architecture through post-event communications to the larger audiences (internal & external)
* Facilitate and support senior leadership engagement initiatives including townhalls, and speaker preparation
* Provide communications support for the Site Lead by helping craft executive briefings, leader emails, and broader site communications that are impactful, engaging, and people-centric
* Build and protect a consistent communications narrative that ties site activity back to a central R&D theme across the year

**Organizational Health**

* Work closely with the HSE Lead and team, providing coordination and operational support while acting as an integral member of the team.
* Champion site culture enhancement ideas that include employee engagement initiatives, cross-functional team building activities, and serving as the R&D ERG Liaison in partnership with the EBS ERG Leadership.
* Lead organizational change management (OCM) on site, through major transitions, pairing structured process with communication that helps people make sense of what's changing and why
* Partner with R&D Lead Team to collate talent advancement and the STA (short-term assignment) pipeline for talent across the site

**Governance, Project & Team Leadership**

* Project manage operational initiatives to delivery representing the local R&D Lead Team and global functional leaders
* Schedule and facilitate R&D Lead Team meetings, floor initiatives and cross-functional governance forums, capture minutes, key decisions + action points
* Own the site's project portfolio dashboard and reporting cadence for leadership and global stakeholders
* Maintain oversight of site operations (logistics, visitor and delegate management, calendar and travel support for visiting leaders), ensuring consistent quality and timeliness
* Potentially own and execute site-based projects

**What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):**

* Minimum 10+ Years of relevant experience working in a global environment or supporting a global environment, specifically in animal/human health R&D

**What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications):**

* Proven experience operating as a strategic partner to leaders in a global, matrixed organization
* Executive presence and the discretion to handle highly confidential, sensitive matters
* Exceptional written communication — able to write convincingly and authentically
* Track record of driving execution across functions without formal authority
* Comfort leading through ambiguity and building structure or governance where none previously existed

**Additional Information:**

* Based in Bangalore, India, at the IAC site, expected to complete 30 days/Quarter of in-office presence.
* Frequent partnership with global, cross-time-zone stakeholders across the US and Europe

title: Cluster Head- Last Mile

Daily rituals and processes like “Problem First Mindset,” “Listen or Die,” our Internal Mobility Program, Talent Reviews, and Continuous Performance Management embody these principles.
  
  
We offer competitive compensation — both cash and equity-based — tailored to job roles, individual experience, and skill, along with employee-centric benefits and a supportive work environment. Our holistic wellness program, MeeCare, includes benefits across physical, mental, financial, and social wellness. This includes extensive medical insurance for employees and their families, wellness initiatives like telehealth, wellness events, and fitness-related perks.
  
  
To support work-life balance, we offer generous leave policies, parental support, retirement benefits, and learning and development assistance. Through personalized recognition, gratitude for stretched work, and engaging activities, we promote employee delight at the workplace. Additional benefits such as salary advance support, relocation assistance, and flexible benefit plans further enrich the Meesho experience.
  
  
At Meesho, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where every individual can thrive. In compliance with the
**Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016**
, we uphold the following principles:
  
  

* Equal Opportunity: We ensure that employment opportunities are never denied on the grounds of disability if the candidate is otherwise competent to perform the job.
* Accessible Workplace: Our facilities are designed to be fully accessible, with amenities and assistive devices provided to support differently abled individuals in their work.
* Inclusive Hiring Process: We adopt a transparent and non-discriminatory selection process, including providing application forms in alternate formats and offering reasonable accommodations during interviews upon request.
* Career Growth: We provide adequate training post-recruitment and pre-promotion, with training materials available in accessible formats to enable equal career progression.

Meesho welcomes applicants and employees of all abilities and is dedicated to fostering an environment where differently abled persons can achieve their full potential.

title: Lab Manager - Hardware Engineering
description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. Today, we are tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing — an era in which our GPUs act as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that understand the world. Doing what has never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent.
  
  
NVIDIA’s Silicon Co-Design Group is the team that gets every GPU, SoC, and CPU silicon program from first power-on to high-volume production. We are hiring a Lab Manager to own hardware engineering lab operations across our Bangalore, Hyderabad and Pune Design Center.Your labs are where silicon meets reality — where every bring-up, validation experiment, and rework cycle happens, and where a day lost hits the program directly. You own the section: multiple labs, varied product classes, and a team of rework, reflow, and logistics technicians delivering daily for engineering. Your decisions show up in lab uptime, bring-up readiness, capital plan accuracy, and audit outcomes on safety and physical IP. You are the leader the program turns to when a new product class needs a lab spun up fast, when an EHS or security gap surfaces, or when capacity for the next roadmap year hasn’t been planned.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Own and Run multiple labs across varied product classes — silicon bring-up, validation, and engineering experiments. Lead rework, reflow, and logistics technicians (including outsourced workers); develop them to self-manage opex procurement, planning, and day-to-day execution.
* Plan ahead of the roadmap. Forecast long-term lab needs — space, power, cooling, thermal, reflow capability, equipment — and own the capital and expense plan that supports it. Drive growth, reconfiguration, and ramp-down as programs evolve.
* Engage Bring-up early. Partner with Bring-up managers to scope incoming silicon programs — requirements, procurement, budget, staffing — so infrastructure and personnel land ahead of priority milestones, on cost.
* Hold the safety and security bar. Drive lab EHS compliance and security control. Be the recognized safety champion and physical IP asset expert — set guidelines, run reviews, operate with audit-ready discipline.
* Run equipment cradle-to-grave. Own capital and expense planning, purchasing, warranty, calibration, and inventory — shipment, import, EC components, bonding — with a clear, auditable process across all labs.
* Standardize across sites. Coordinate with global lab managers to learn and propagate best practices and standardize lab operations where it adds leverage.
* Role may involve travel across our Bangalore, Hyderabad, and Pune Design Centers

**What We Need To See**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience), with overall 8+ years of experience in silicon/HW lab setup, management, and maintenance.
* At least 3+ years managing a technical lab environment and leading teams across sites, with a track record of owning a multi-lab section — including capital and expense equipment planning, vendor and outsourced-worker management, and inventory/logistics tracking.
* Hands-on experience operating lab equipment (oscilloscope, DAQ, and other common equipment) and consumer hardware assembly/teardown, solder/rework — with familiarity in HW bring-ups, computer systems, and debugging.
* Experience working with multi-functional teams — SW, validation, ASIC, and other hardware/software functions — with excellent communication abilities across sites.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience with CPU/SOC chip bring-up and validation process.
* Multi-site or global lab coordination experience — shared standards, vendor frameworks, or capacity planning across regions.
* Comfortable using AI productivity tools (Claude, Copilot, or equivalent) to compress reporting, analysis, and operational workflows — with judgment about where AI helps and where it doesn’t.

* Facilitate communication between departments to ensure seamless execution of production
* plans.

* Recommend actions to address capacity constraints.
* Optimize resource allocation to meet production targets.
* Maintain planning and production records in accordance with company procedures.
* Ensure compliance with Siemens processes, quality standards (ISO & IRIS), and EHS requirements.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing and process improvement initiatives.
* Improve planning accuracy and production efficiency.
* Lead productivity improvement and cost reduction projects.
* Support digitalization and ERP enhancement initiatives, AI implémentations etc.

* Production Planning & Scheduling

* SAP / ERP Systems
* Capacity Planning
* Inventory Management
* Demand Forecasting
* Supply Chain Coordination
* Lean Manufacturing
* Root Cause Analysis

+ On-Time Delivery (OTD)

Take actions to identify opportunities to improve process controls and simplify process. You will track the technology incidents across the organization and drive reduction in incident counts by adopting reactive and proactive approaches. You will ensure right severity classification of incidents, appropriate comms to technology and business stakeholders and will drive the faster resolution of the incidents. You will work with CXCG- Customer Experience, Command center and Service desk to identify the customers’ and employees’ issues proactively and drive improvements.
  
You will define process KPIs and develop MIS dashboards working with MIS team and will drive thematic service improvements based on the KPIs trends. You will drive effective problem management practices to address root cause and contributory causes of the incidents.
  
As a leader, coach, and mentor, you will provide your team with the objectives of department’s goals aligned to company’s strategic direction. You will also be providing necessary support to your team in achieving the targets and meeting their learning & development needs. This critical leadership role will directly report to Head of Incident Management
  
Key result Areas- Incident Management: Effective management of 24X7 incident management. Continuous improvement of process controls and comms protocols of Incident
  
Management, including Technology and Business updates. Take complete ownership of the Incidents from Start to End in recording, prioritizing, categorizing, Communicating, escalating, and driving the incident towards resolution. Take complete charge of the Major incident call and manage it skillfully. Take actions to proactively identify issues working with Command Center including the improvement of the monitoring. Improve Customer and Employee experience by proactively detecting service issues through CRM dashboards and Service tickets analysis, take prompt actions with relevant teams.
  
- Stakeholders Engagement / Management: Educate the Incident process and Problem Management to stakeholders. Establish feedback system to gather opportunities for improvement.
  
- Risks, Audit and Control Compliance: Process Risks are proactively managed without any delays. Any observations of Internal and External audit to be addressed within the stipulated time.
  
- Service Reporting: Define KPIs and work with MIS team to produce interactive
  
dashboards and presentations for different stakeholders including senior executives. Drive improvements based on KPIs.
  
- Team Management: Provide team clarity about their deliverables, identify their
  
development needs, and do regular check-ins. Ensure compliance of mandatory
  
learning and annual leave.
  
- Coordinating and prioritizing work as per the business criticality and completing
  
assigned tasks within the timelines.
  
- Perform analysis to proactively identify the issues and take necessary actions to fix it.
  
- Identify the Gaps, prepare Service Improvement plans with measurable outcomes and work with SMEs to close it and to improve the overall experience.
  
- Identify the areas of redundant manual effort and work towards automating it. Support the team’s objectives and prepare periodical management reports
  
Knowledge, Skills and Experience- The incumbent should be self-driven with 12+ experience in service management designing, defining, and driving ITIL processes, preferably from Banking Industry.
  
- Understanding relevant industry standards and practices is desirable.
  
- Significant experience in leading support for large, complex, multi-functional environments.
  
- Prior meaningful technology and business/industry work experience including experience in Incident and Problem management. Experience in driving service improvements based on incident trends and themes.
  
- Knowledge & experience in Proactive incident management will be desirable.
  
- Demonstrable experience attracting, hiring, retaining, and leading top process and engineering talent.
  
- Experience with Scrum, Kanban, or other Agile development techniques would be desired (but not mandatory).
  
- Knowledge of financial industry standards and business practices.
  
- Ability to build positive relationships with own team, business, and technology partners.
  
- Understanding of infrastructure (IAAS), platform (PaaS), Software (SAAS) and function (FaaS) service offerings.
  
- Experience in establishing Management Information System and defining KPIs.
  
- The candidate must be able to multitask, handle changing priorities and work independently in a fast-changing environment.

* Stock Control: Maintain optimal stock levels for fast-moving, slow-moving, and critical components across bin locations to prevent stockouts
* Inventory Accuracy: Conduct regular cycle counts, physical stock audits, and system reconciliations against the Dealer Management System (DMS) or ERP (SAP/Oracle)
* Warehouse Layout & 5S: Manage bin-locating systems, barcoding/RFID workflows, material handling equipment (MHE), and safety compliance
* Obsolescence Control: Monitor and liquidate slow-moving and dead stock to safeguard working capital
* Order Fulfillment & Supply Chain Coordination
* Order Processing: Review open orders, track daily pick-pack-dispatch cycles, and ensure high Order Fill Rates (OTIF - On-Time In-Full) for dealer networks
* Plant & Vendor Liaison: Coordinate closely with manufacturing plants, central procurement hubs, and technical teams for urgent backorders and campaign/recall rollouts
* Logistics & Dispatch: Manage third-party logistics (3PL) partners, freight carriers, and transport timelines to reduce transit damage and delivery lead times
* Commercial, Warranty & Compliance
* Warranty & Returns: Oversee the proper receipt, inspection, and processing of defective parts, core returns, and manufacturer warranty claims
* KPI Monitoring: Track monthly warehouse operational metrics, logistics expenditures, and budgetary constraints
* Policy Enforcement: Enforce corporate spares guidelines, regional compliance regulations, and warehouse safety protocols
* Team Leadership & Capability Building
* Train warehouse staff and dealer parts personnel on modern parts operations, safety protocols, and ERP systems
* Lead performance reviews, shift scheduling, and cross-functional problem-solving initiatives

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  

* Order Fill Rate / Service Level: Target percentage of dealer/workshop orders fulfilled completely and on time
* Stock Accuracy Rate: Precision between physical stock and system inventory records (Target: >98%)
* Inventory Turnover / Days of Inventory: Keeping holding days within our-defined financial limits to optimize cash flow
* Dispatch Turnaround Time (TAT): Time elapsed from initial order receipt to final courier dispatch

What you'll bring:
  
  

* Education qualification
* Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical / Automobile / Production Engineering, or a professional Degree/Diploma in Supply Chain or Materials Management
* 5 to 8+ years of experience in automotive spare parts management, warehouse logistics, or aftersales supply chain within an OEM or major dealer group
* Hands-on proficiency in Dealer Management Systems (DMS). Strong command of data analysis tools (MS Excel, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP)
* Demonstrated leadership, vendor negotiation prowess, an analytical mindset, and strong crisis-management abilities

What matters to us:
  
  

* Quality of work
* Structured problem-solving
* Dissatisfaction with mediocre work
* Ability to multi-task and handle a dynamic working environment
* Resilient attitude to bounce back after failing

About Us:
  
  
Exponent is building the energy stack powering commercial EVs in India. Our proprietary battery and charging technology enables safe, reliable 15-minute rapid charging while delivering a 3,000-cycle battery life warranty using standard lithium-ion cells. Today, our platform powers high-utilisation commercial vehicles - from three-wheelers to intercity buses, making electric mobility rapid, more reliable and more affordable than petroleum.
  
  
Founded by Arun Vinayak (Founding Partner & Former Chief Product Officer, Ather Energy), Exponent is a 250+ member team of passionate builders solving some of the toughest engineering challenges in energy.
  
  
If solving hard engineering problems across mechanics, thermal systems, power electronics, manufacturing, and the charging network, while staying obsessed with customer experience excites you, we'd love to build with you.

title: FINANCE OPERATIONS MANAGER
description:
**FINANCE OPERATIONS MANAGER — FINKRAFT.AI**
  
Location: Bangalore, HSR | Full-time | Level: L3 | Reports to: CFO

**ABOUT FINKRAFT.AI**

Finkraft.ai is a B2B SaaS company that enables enterprises to maximize GST claims on travel and expense data. The platform automates invoice collection, validation, and reconciliation across airlines and hotels — helping finance teams at McKinsey, BCG, Capgemini, Abbott, and 1,250+ enterprises improve compliance, visibility, and cash recovery. We've recovered ₹300Cr+ in GST claims for clients and are scaling from $1.5M to $10M ARR in 18 months.

**WHY THIS ROLE**

Most finance ops roles at this stage give you one lane. This one gives you the whole road.

You will own AR, AP, payroll, banking, cash projections, statutory compliance, and management reporting — and present that picture directly to the CFO, founders, and BU heads. You're not a back office here. You're the operational spine of a company that processes financial data for Fortune 500 clients, with a Dubai entity activating in Phase 3.

If you've wanted a role where your work is visible, your ownership is real, and your growth isn't capped by a 6-layer hierarchy — this is it.

**WHAT YOU WILL OWN IN 90 DAYS**

- Receivables fully under control: AR aging clean, DSO tracked weekly, every outstanding collection has a named owner and a resolution date.
- Rolling 13-week cash forecast live: updated every Monday, shared with CFO and CEO. Actuals vs. forecast tracked; deviations explained, not just noted.
- Statutory calendar at zero-miss: GST, TDS, payroll, and vendor obligations tracked and met without a CFO prompt.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Accounts Receivable

* Manage the full invoice-to-collection lifecycle for B2B clients, including SaaS billing, milestone invoices, and usage-based models
* Maintain AR aging reports; track and report DSO weekly
* Drive structured collections follow-ups with defined escalation SLAs — no open items beyond 60 days without a documented owner
* Handle disputes, partial payments, and credit note processing
* Flag credit risk on any account showing payment pattern deterioration

Accounts Payable

* Own the payables calendar: vendor payments, renewals, subscriptions, fixed costs — nothing missed, no late penalties
* Validate vendor invoices for accuracy, GST compliance, and PO matching
* Negotiate vendor payment timelines where leverage exists
* Reconcile bank transactions against payables weekly

Payroll & Salary Operations

* Coordinate monthly payroll run with vendor or HRMS — inputs gathered, validated, disbursed on schedule
* Ensure TDS (salary), PF, and ESI are correctly computed, deducted, and filed each month
* Maintain salary register and reconcile payroll entries in Zoho Books / Tally
* Flag headcount cost variances to CFO monthly

Banking Operations

* Perform weekly bank reconciliations across ICICI, Axis, and GCC accounts (ENBD, GIB) as entities activate
* Prepare payment batches, manage signatory routing, and analyse bank statements
* Own UAE entity banking ops from Month 9 when Dubai activates
* Support signatory change processes and banking documentation

Cash Flow & Financial Projections

* Maintain rolling 13-week cash flow forecast: inflows (collections, advances), outflows (payroll, vendors, statutory, subscriptions)
* Update actuals vs. forecast weekly; flag deviations >10% with root-cause note
* Support CFO on quarterly and annual projections for board and investor reporting
* Track burn rate and runway; raise early warnings when runway approaches threshold

Financial Metrics & MIS Reporting

* Produce monthly MIS pack: P&L summary, AR/AP aging, cash position, DSO, DPO, payroll cost vs. budget, open statutory dues
* Own the finance operations metrics dashboard: DSO, DPO, cash conversion cycle, AR coverage ratio, payable days
* Own the BU head monthly finance review pack
* Support CFO in preparing investor-facing financial slides

Statutory Compliance

* Ensure on-time filing and payment of GST (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B), TDS (194C, 194J, 194H, 192), PF, ESI, and professional tax
* Maintain a statutory dues calendar — at-risk deadlines escalated 7 days in advance
* Coordinate with external CA for GST reconciliation, TDS returns, and annual audit support
* Compliance gaps flagged to CFO within 24 hours of identification

Accounting & Systems

* Daily, hands-on entries in Zoho Books / Tally ERP — clean books, every day
* No miscoded entries; no suspense balances aged beyond 7 days
* Maintain audit-ready documentation at all times
* Identify and implement process improvements that reduce close cycle time

Requirements
  
  

**WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU**

Must Have:

* 3–6 years in finance operations at a B2B SaaS, fintech, or high-growth startup — not a services firm or manufacturing company
* Hands-on daily use of Zoho Books or Tally ERP. Not "familiar with." You use it today.
* Working knowledge of GST (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, ITC reconciliation) and TDS (194C, 194J, 194H, 192). You file — not just review.
* Experience running AR/AP for a B2B recurring-revenue business: SaaS billing models, milestone invoices, credit notes
* Has personally coordinated payroll — not just reviewed payslips
* Has built or contributed to a cash flow projection or 13-week forecast at least once

Strong Preference:

* CA Inter or CMA Inter
* Has presented a finance ops review or MIS pack to a founder, CFO, or BU head directly
* Has worked through a CFO transition, audit crunch, or statutory catch-up — knows what clean books under pressure means
* Exposure to GCC / UAE banking operations

Giga has recently raised a $61M Series A and is working with Fortune 500 customers to deploy the next generation of customer experience - real-time AI agents that can understand emotion, resolve issues instantly, and scale across the world's largest enterprises.

Industry leaders like DoorDash trust Giga with their most complex support and operations workflows across voice, chat, and email, in high-stakes regulated environments where accuracy and compliance matter. We're at an exciting inflection point.

The work affects millions of people every day, and our team has the autonomy to make true impact - with brilliant founders, a clear path forward, and the kind of momentum that defines generational companies.

We're hiring an Operations Manager to run Giga's India entity as we grow the team there. You'll own the entity's day-to-day operations, help us hire and onboard great people, and support revenue operations with our go-to-market team.

This is a broad, hands-on role for someone who likes building from scratch. You'll work closely with leadership in San Francisco, and the systems you set up will become how Giga runs in India. You'll be expected to build the playbook, not inherit one.

* 5+ years in operations, business operations, or HR and finance operations, ideally at a high-growth startup.

* Prior experience at an AI or B2B SaaS startup
* Experience with list building to target leads
