title: Head of Operations
description:
Head of Operations \| VYONE
 
**Location:** 
 Bengaluru, India
 



**Experience:** 
 8–10 years
 



**Role Type:** 
 Founding Team / Senior Leadership
 



  





 VYONE is building a new category in automotive ownership in India. Our ambition is to create a trusted ownership ecosystem that supports customers throughout their vehicle journey, from buying and servicing to insurance, maintenance, resale, and everything in between.
 



  





 We are looking for a
 **Head of Operations** 
 who can help us build that ecosystem from the ground up.
 



 This is not a traditional operations role where established processes already exist. We are looking for a
 **builder** 
 . Someone who enjoys starting with a blank sheet, is open to new ideas, challenges conventional ways of working, experiments quickly, and can convert ideas into scalable operating systems.
 



  





 The person joining us should have
 **8–10 years of operations experience** 
 , preferably across automotive, mobility, service businesses, marketplaces, customer experience, fleet management, dealer operations, insurance, or other businesses involving large partner ecosystems.
   




 What you will be responsible for
 
 You will own and build VYONE's operational backbone, including the processes, partnerships, service network, customer experience standards, and operational frameworks required to scale the business.
 



  





 A major part of your role will be identifying and building relationships with the right partners across the automotive ecosystem, including dealerships, service centres, workshops, insurance providers, roadside assistance companies, detailing partners, tyre and battery partners, financing companies, used\-car networks, and other relevant service providers. Partner identification, onboarding, governance, and performance management are already central themes in the current role definition.
 



  





 You will also work closely with the founders to identify
 **new business segments and opportunities** 
 where VYONE can create value. We want this person to continuously think about how the VYONE ecosystem can expand, what new categories we can enter, what partnerships we should build, and how those partnerships can create stronger value for both customers and VYONE.
 



 The role will involve building a strong
 **VYONE Business Partner Network** 
 across the market. You will help create a structured ecosystem where selected partners work with VYONE under clearly defined service standards, commercial arrangements, customer experience guidelines, and SLAs. The objective is not simply to onboard vendors, but to create a reliable network that becomes an important part of VYONE's competitive advantage.
 



  





 You will design operational processes across the complete customer lifecycle, ensuring that every interaction is simple, transparent, dependable, and built around customer trust. This includes defining workflows, escalation processes, quality standards, turnaround times, communication protocols, and partner accountability.
 



  





 You will also work closely with the product and technology teams to translate real\-world operational requirements into scalable systems, dashboards, workflows, and automation. As the business grows, your responsibility will be to ensure that processes that begin manually can eventually become structured, technology\-enabled, and scalable.
   




 Who we are looking for
 
 We are looking for someone who is
 **entrepreneurial, hands\-on, commercially aware, and comfortable operating in ambiguity** 
 .
 



 You should be someone who can walk into a new market, understand how the ecosystem works, identify the right partners, negotiate relationships, build processes, solve operational gaps, and continuously improve the customer experience.
 



 Most importantly, you must have a
 **builder mindset** 
 . VYONE is still being built, which means ideas will evolve, processes will change, and new opportunities will emerge. We want someone who welcomes that environment instead of waiting for a finished playbook.
 



  





 Experience in automotive operations, mobility, fleet management, aftersales, dealer operations, service networks, automotive insurance, customer lifecycle management, marketplaces, or partner\-led businesses would be highly relevant.
 



  





 Strong experience in
 **partner and vendor management, operational process design, SLA management, customer experience, commercial negotiations, cost management, and operational performance** 
 will be important for this role.
   




 What success will look like
 
 Success in this role will mean building a dependable partner ecosystem, improving service quality, creating scalable operational processes, maintaining strong partner performance, controlling service economics, and delivering an experience that customers consistently trust.
 



 As VYONE grows, this person will play a major role in defining
 **how the business operates, how our partner ecosystem works, and how we build an entirely new category within India's automotive ownership market** 
 .
 



  





 If you have spent your career running operations but have always wanted the opportunity to
 **build something rather than simply manage something** 
 , we would like to hear from you.
 



  





**Join VYONE and help us build the operating ecosystem behind the future of car ownership in India.**

title: Manager, RA Publishing & Submissions
description:

title: Director, Country Clinical Operations Management
description:
**Company Description**
**About AbbVie**
 AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience \- and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us atwww.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie onLinkedIn,Facebook,Instagram,XandYouTube.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Country Clinical Operations Manager is the key leader for Clinical Operations at the country level for both internal \& external partners. Accountable for the strategic and operational management for clinical operations and clinical site management activities for the assigned country/ies. Responsible for leading the implementation of the corporate vision and objectives, operating across all therapeutics areas to support the execution of AbbVie's pipeline. The role is accountable for country clinical trial performance, providing strategic planning, oversight and direction of the country team to ensure on time, within budget and quality delivery of internally conducted clinical studies. The Country COM is accountable to develop a highly collaborative framework with internal and external key stakeholders across the local and global organization to best position AbbVie in advancing clinical research and accelerating the transformation of science into best\-in\-class medicines.
   

  

 Defines the country strategy and operational plans aligned with AbbVie's business priorities, Clinical Development Operations and affiliate objectives in order to position the country for near and long term success.
   

  

 Continuously assess country site footprint across all therapeutic areas, expanding where there are opportunities and needs to support the pipeline.
   

  

 Provides leadership, strategic direction and oversight for all country activities across all stages of the clinical trial (country \& site feasibility, selection and start\-up, throughout study conduct and closure), ensuring high quality and scientific integrity of trial deliverables. Accountable for all Country level CDO deliverables for internally managed Clinical Studies.
   

  

 Provide leadership and oversight to the clinical research team including, but not limited to: \* performing accompanied visits (on\-site and off\-site) \* accelerate AbbVie's priority programs through close collaboration with internal and external stakeholders \*conduct trend analysis and gap assessments to proactively identify training and developmental opportunities for assigned personnel \* drive performance and address gaps to ensure the team achieves country and site level KPIs, KRIs \& metrics
   

  

 Partners with internal stakeholders to drive insightful and impactful interactions and promote the value of the clinical research team through the contribution to the R\&D portfolio success. Partners with GMA Medical Affairs Head to co\-Lead the 'One R\&D' collaboration within the affiliate. Operates as 'CDO Head' to support and represent non\-CSM CDO personnel based within the affiliate.
   

  

 Accountable for the identification of resource needs, management of the allocated resources and timely hiring of clinical research staff to support clinical trials execution. Responsible for maintaining team capacity aligned with organizational needs, applying flexible and effective approaches for responsibilities assignment, that promotes staff development and retention.
   

  

 Defines and implementsthe optimal team organizational structure to support the needs of the business which allows the team to operate in a matrix and evolving environment, ensuring effective collaboration with key capabilities and roles. Identifies and implements strategies and tactics to ensure continuous efficiency, effectiveness and productivity of the country. Responsible for building a high performing team, accountable for the operational excellence in the execution of clinical trials.
   

  

 Accountable for ensuring adherence to applicable global and local regulations, ICH Guidelines and AbbVie Quality Management System, promoting a quality driven local organization, oriented to continuous improvement and excellence. Accountable for country Intelligence and impact analysis of all significant changes affecting the conduct of clinical studies, and for implementing procedural adjustments and orientation to guarantee team preparedness, alignment and compliance, as needed.
   

  

 Ensures Inspection Readiness across all activities, through effective leadership and oversight, promoting quality\-driven initiatives. Responsible for the development of a critical thinking organization, focused on gap assessment, risk identification and mitigation strategies. Acts as the country expert for audit and inspection related processes, and may also serve as the local AbbVie host for in\-country inspections/audits.
   

  

 Accountable for functional budget planning and management, ensuring accurate budgets and forecasts. Works closely with finance counterparts, guaranteeing seamless budget control processes and accurate communication of budget status, cost and issues to allow timely decision\-making. Responsible for country feasibility, site selection strategy, and expanding AbbVie's site footprint within the country to support the pipeline.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Education: Bachelors or equivalent degree, health related (e.g. Medical, Scientific, Nursing, Pharmacy) preferred.
   

  

 Minimum of 5 years of work experience in clinical research, demonstrating a high level of expertise on study monitoring and management across multiple Therapeutic Areas, Study Phases and in fully cycle (startup to closeout) processes. Solid understanding of drug development process (and medical device preferred) and requirements such as GCP, ICH, etc. Robust knowledge of local clinical trial setting (regulatory and healthcare environment).
   

  

 At least 2 years of experience in line management of staff including acquisition of talent, performance management, growth and development, managing employee relations, coaching and mentoring of staff and teams preferred.
   

  

 Proven track record in project management, strong planning and organizational skills and a high level of adaptability in a dynamic environment with experience leading (within country or region) projects with competing deadlines.
   

  

 Experience in setting and driving the strategy and leading the management and completion of global trials assigned to the country/ies. Experience in functional budget planning (preferred), resource planning \& assignment, quality management at country or regional level.
   

  

 Strong leadership competencies. Robust experience in leading teams through change, leveraging team contribution to support business strategies. Gives guidance and inspiration to their direct reports and teammates.
   

  

 Fosters an environment that promotes the sharing of ideas, information, and best practices (internal and external to the organization) to drive continuous improvement.
   

  

 Proven leadership skills in a cross\-functional, matrix environment, with ability to influence and align key stakeholders, forge strong partnership where needed and promote seamless collaboration at all levels. Proactively responds to the needs of others and makes their own needs and business strategy known. Externally approaches stakeholders with customer service orientation in order to be perceived as a clinical study partner of choice.
   

  

 Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to evaluate complex issues from multiple perspectives and drive smart decision making.
   

  

 Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate persuasively in a succinct and comprehensive manner to colleagues at all levels. Engenders trust throughout the organization and seeks to grow and stretch key talent for future possibilities. Acts with integrity in accordance with AbbVie code of business conduct and leadership values.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives and serving our community. Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled.

* Culture Definition: Set the target culture and cultural narrative, ensuring structural changes are supported by the right behaviors and mindsets.
* Infrastructure \& Tracking: Build and manage a rigorous tracking, reporting, and governance infrastructure to monitor the health and progress of all transformational initiatives.
* Stakeholder \& Executive Influence: Manage complex, highly interdependent cross\-functional initiatives, leveraging strong reporting and influencing abilities to align senior management and diverse stakeholders.

****Preferred Experience****

title: Head of Startups - India and South Asia
description:
NVIDIA Inception is our free global programme for start\-ups building with AI, data science and accelerated computing — now more than 40,000 companies worldwide, with over 2,000 of them based in India alone. South Asia is one of the fastest\-moving corners of that network: a market whose density sits in applied and vertical AI — medical imaging, drug discovery, edge vision, agentic and sovereign AI, robotics, agri\-tech, AI governance — rather than in frontier model labs.
   

  

 We are looking for an Inception Regional Lead to own that motion end to end. This is a builder’s role with a commercial edge. You will set the regional strategy, lead a team of Inception Partner and Community managers across India, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and neighbouring markets, and be personally accountable for how much NVIDIA hardware, software and cloud the region’s start\-ups design in and consume. You will spend real time on the ground in founders’ offices, because that is where stalled accounts turn into concrete asks. And you will act as the connective tissue between start\-ups and the rest of NVIDIA — worldwide field operations, solution architects, developer marketing, the reseller and cloud partner ecosystem, and NVentures.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Own the South Asia Inception strategy and number. Set regional priorities, coverage model and account tiering across strategic, member, community and prospect accounts; forecast and report on pipeline, design wins and consumption to programme and field leadership.
* Lead and grow the team. Manage, coach and develop a team of Inception Partner and community programme managers. Set territory and vertical coverage, run the operating cadence, and raise the bar on technical fluency and commercial rigour across the team.
* Drive commercial outcomes with start\-ups. Move accounts from awareness to technical discovery to a named workload — running workload, benchmark and target\-metric discovery, qualifying architecture and annual cloud spend, and landing hardware and cloud asks through the Inception Benefits Catalog, rebate programmes, DGX Cloud credits and preferred pricing.
* Build the partner and reseller motion. Work with OEMs, resellers, cloud and NVIDIA Cloud Partners and system integrators so that start\-up demand converts cleanly into fulfilled orders and deployed capacity.
* Deepen the ecosystem. Build durable relationships with the region’s VCs and accelerators through the Inception VC Alliance, and with research parks, IITs and university incubators, government innovation bodies and industry associations, to generate high\-quality inbound and give members a route to capital and customers.
* Land the technical value. Partner with solution architects and developer relations to get members productive on the NVIDIA stack — NIM, NeMo, Nemotron, Riva, Isaac Sim, Omniverse, Morpheus, Clara, Jetson, DGX and AI Enterprise — and drive Deep Learning Institute training, hackathons, workshops and bring\-your\-own\-project days at scale.
* Tell the region’s story. Work with developer and Inception marketing on co\-marketing plans, technical blogs, member showcases, testimonials and video, and represent Inception at GTC, AI Summits, and regional start\-up and investor events.
* Run the programme cleanly. Own member onboarding, tier qualification, data hygiene and reporting in NVIDIA’s programme and CRM systems, so that regional performance is measurable and auditable.
* Bring the market back to NVIDIA. Feed structured intelligence on regional workloads, competitive pressure, sovereign AI initiatives and funding trends to product, field and executive stakeholders.


**What We Need To See**
* 12\+ years of experience across start\-up ecosystem development, developer or partner programmes, technology alliances, business development or technical sales — with at least 5 years leading and developing a team.
* BS/BTech in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. MBA or advanced degree welcome.
* Demonstrated ownership of a commercial target in a technology business, with a track record of turning early\-stage relationships into revenue, design wins or measurable platform adoption.
* Working technical fluency in AI and accelerated computing: you can hold a credible conversation with a founder or CTO about model training and inference, GPU selection and sizing, on\-premises versus cloud trade\-offs, and where NVIDIA’s software stack fits.
* Deep, current knowledge of the South Asian start\-up ecosystem — founders, investors, accelerators, incubators, research institutions and the policy environment — and the network to open doors quickly.
* Proven success operating in a large, matrixed organization, influencing sales, marketing, engineering and executive stakeholders without formal authority.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication; comfort presenting to founders, investors and NVIDIA executives with equal ease.
* Willingness to travel frequently across the region.


**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**
* Direct experience at a start\-up, VC firm, accelerator or incubator — you know how founders actually make decisions and where programmes create or destroy value for them.
* Hands\-on background with GPU infrastructure, cluster deployment or MLOps, or prior experience as a solution architect or developer advocate.
* Experience building go\-to\-market motions with cloud providers, OEMs, resellers or system integrators in India.
* A public track record in the AI community — speaking, writing, or convening founders and investors.
* Experience with sovereign AI, regulated\-industry AI (healthcare, financial services, public sector) or edge and robotics deployments in emerging markets.

description:
**About Zluri: Securing the AI Future**




  





 Zluri is building the Identity Control Plane for the AI Era\- a unified platform that brings real\-time visibility and governance to every identity in an organization, human and non\-human alike. We combine Identity Security Posture Management (ISPM), Identity Visibility \& Intelligence (IVIP), and Identity Governance into a single platform powered by a Context Graph architecture.
 



 While others build agents to do the work, we build the infrastructure to keep them from going rogue.
 



  





 We're a Series B startup backed by Lightspeed, MassMutual Ventures, Endiya Partners, and Kalaari Capital, trusted by 200\+ enterprise customers to secure their identity landscape. If you're excited to help define how the world governs identity in an AI\-first future, we'd love to talk.
 



  





**About the Role:**




  





 The Revenue Operations (RevOps) Manager will be the connective tissue between our Sales and Customer Success (CS) teams. Your mission is to break down silos, streamline the complete sales\-to\-renewal lifecycle, and leverage AI to ensure our revenue\-generating teams have the forward\-looking processes, actionable data, and intelligent tools they need to operate at peak efficiency.
 



  





**Roles and Responsibilities:** 




  





**Salesforce Management \& Optimization (Core Focus)** 



* Mandatory: Serve as the primary owner and administrator of our Salesforce CRM, ensuring data integrity, optimized architecture, and seamless integrations.
* Design and implement advanced workflows, custom objects, validation rules, and automation using Salesforce Flows to specifically support Sales and CS workflows.
* Manage user roles, profiles, permission sets, and security controls across all Sales and CS functions within Salesforce.



  





**Sales Operations \& Pipeline Management** 



* Optimize the opportunity lifecycle from creation to closed\-won, ensuring standardized sales stages, exit criteria, and accurate forecasting.
* Reduce sales friction by automating manual tasks, streamlining quoting (CPQ), and simplifying contracting and approval processes.
* Build and maintain executive\-level dashboards and reports in Salesforce to track pipeline health, win/loss rates, sales velocity, and rep capacity.



  





**Customer Success Operations (CS Ops) \& Retention** 



* Architect and optimize the post\-sale customer journey, including frictionless handoffs from Sales to CS, onboarding workflows, and automated renewal/expansion tracking within Salesforce.
* Develop and manage customer health scores, churn\-risk alerts, and product\-usage dashboards to proactively guide CS interventions.
* Partner with CS leadership to map and streamline capacity planning, Quarterly Business Review (QBR) processes, and upsell/cross\-sell playbooks.
* Ensure full visibility into the customer lifecycle by tightly integrating the CS tech stack (ChurnZero, Freshdesk, etc) with Salesforce.



  





**GTM Tech Stack \& Integrations** 



* Own and manage the broader Sales and CS tech stack, ensuring flawless data flow into and out of Salesforce.
* Ensure smooth data handoffs from marketing automation platforms into the sales environment, maintaining clear lead routing and SLA enforcement.
* Evaluate, implement, and onboard new tools, championing AI adoption to eliminate manual data entry, improve rep productivity, and increase CS visibility.
* Identify and deploy emerging AI use cases within Sales and CS (e.g., predictive forecasting, automated workflow triggers, conversational intelligence) to drive next\-level operational efficiency.



  





**Data, Analytics, \& Forecasting** 



* Develop robust reporting for both pre\-sale and post\-sale metrics, including ARR, MRR, Gross Retention Rate (GRR), Net Retention Rate (NRR), time\-to\-value, and churn analysis.
* Proactively audit data hygiene to ensure accurate attribution, forecasting, and reporting across all revenue functions.



  





**Enablement \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Train Sales and CS teams on new processes, tools, and best practices within Salesforce.

title: R&D Lab Manager
description:
**About Us**




 Exide Energy Solutions Ltd is an advanced energy storage company focused on the design, development, and manufacturing of lithium\-based battery cells for electric mobility and stationary energy storage applications. The company is building indigenous cell manufacturing capabilities in Bangalore, India,
 



 With a strong emphasis on technology localization, supply chain resilience, and cost competitiveness, Exide Energy Solutions Ltd is investing in materials R\&D, supplier ecosystem development, and gigafactory\-scale manufacturing. The organization aims to deliver high\-performance, safe, and sustainable battery solutions while reducing import dependency and accelerating India’s transition to clean energy.
 



  





**Role Purpose**




 The R\&D Lab Manager is responsible for the overall management and operation of the industrial battery R\&D laboratory, including analytical equipment handling, material processing, coin\-cell assembly, pouch\-cell manufacturing, electrochemical testing, and laboratory infrastructure. The position acts as the primary interface between R\&D scientists, laboratory teams, and CFT departments to ensure timely execution of development projects, efficient resource utilization, and smooth laboratory operations.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities**




**Laboratory Operations Management:** 



* Manage day\-to\-day operations of the R\&D laboratory.
* Ensure timely execution of R\&D activities assigned by R\&D Scientists.
* Plan manpower allocation, equipment scheduling, and laboratory resources.
* Monitor laboratory productivity, safety, quality, and operational efficiency.



  





**Team Management/Leadership:** 




 Lead and supervise a multidisciplinary laboratory team comprising:
 


* Material Processing Team
* Analytical Testing Team
* Coin Cell Assembly Team
* Pouch Cell Manufacturing Team
* Electrochemical Testing Team
* Laboratory Support Staff



  





**R\&D Project Execution:** 



* Coordinate with R\&D Scientists to receive project requirements and testing plans.
* Assign tasks and monitor execution through laboratory teams.
* Track project timelines, deliverables, and resource utilization.
* Provide regular status updates to R\&D Scientists.



  





**Equipment \& Facility Management:** 




 Manage operation, maintenance, calibration, and utilization of:
 


* Powder XRD, XPS, XRF etc.
* ARC (Accelerating Rate Calorimeter)
* Glove Boxes
* Dry Lab
* Analytical Equipment’s Related Chemical Testing
* Battery Cyclers
* Environmental Chambers
* Coin Cell Assembly Equipment
* Pouch Cell Manufacturing Equipment
* Battery Material Processing Equipment
* Electrochemical Testing Instruments



  





**Cross\-Functional Coordination:** 



* Coordinate with Production, Quality, Maintenance, Facilities, Procurement, Stores, EHS, Finance, and Administration departments.
* Facilitate support required for R\&D trials, equipment installation, facility modifications, and utility requirements.
* Coordinate with plant teams during scale\-up activities and technology transfer projects.
* Ensure timely resolution of inter\-departmental operational issues.



  





**Consumables, Procurement \& Capex:** 



* Monitor laboratory consumables, spare parts, and inventory levels.
* Raise purchase requisitions and track procurement activities.
* Prepare technical specifications, justifications, and Capex proposals for new equipment.
* Support vendor evaluation, installation, commissioning, and acceptance activities.



  





**Documentation \& Financial Coordination:** 



* Ensure proper maintenance of laboratory records, SOPs, logs, and reports.
* Coordinate invoice verification and billing documentation.
* Process procurement and payment\-related documents in coordination with Accounts and Procurement departments.
* Maintain asset and inventory records.



  





**Safety \& Compliance:** 



* Ensure compliance with laboratory safety and EHS requirements.
* Conduct regular safety inspections and risk assessments.
* Ensure safe handling of chemicals, materials, cells, and equipment.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience**



* Bachelor’s degree in engineering/science
* 5\+ years in lithium battery lab and cell manufacturing
* Knowledge of lithium\-ion battery materials, cell assembly, and electrochemical testing.
* Experience in managing industrial R\&D laboratories.
* Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
* Excellent coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Knowledge of laboratory equipment maintenance and facility management.
* Experience with procurement, Capex management, and documentation processes

description:
Are you a passionate and results\-driven professional eager to ensure the highest quality in software products? We are looking for a Senior Manager, Operations Management, responsible for leading testing initiatives and providing both technical expertise.
   

  

 7EDGE is a Digital Product Engineering Company based in Bengaluru, India. Our core expertise lies in crafting modern applications with cloud\-native services, specializing in microservices and serverless architecture tailored to the requirements of enterprises and startups alike. We deliver unparalleled solutions to industries and companies across the globe. As the company is expanding rapidly, we are looking to grow our \[Job Family] by hiring talented individuals who are eager to learn and contribute to our success.
   

  

 In this role, you will leverage your technical expertise and problem\-solving skills to:
   

  

* Own consolidated P\&L — gross margin, revenue realisation, and billable utilisation — across multiple business units simultaneously.
* Govern revenue mix across BUs, actively managing concentration risk and holding each BU lead accountable to revenue commitments and GTM plans.
* Translate annual business goals into measurable OKRs for diverse direct reports and govern achievement throughout the year.
* Lead technology delivery teams — defining structure, driving outcome\-based delivery, and leveraging AI to improve team productivity.
* Develop and empower direct reports who are themselves managers, through coaching, delegation, and succession planning.
* Communicate business performance — including underperformance and recovery plans — proactively and directly to the CEO and leadership.


 This role presents a valuable opportunity to apply your technical expertise in leading high\-impact projects, while also contributing to the professional growth of your team. If you are ready to take on this dynamic and fulfilling position, we encourage you to submit your application.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Business Performance \& P\&L Ownership**
* Own consolidated business performance across multiple BUs or delivery functions — directly accountable for gross margin targets, revenue realisation, and billable utilisation.
* Build and maintain a real\-time system for monitoring financial health across all functions simultaneously.
* Identify margin or revenue risks early — before they become critical — and take corrective action with speed.
* Produce consolidated P\&L reports and present them to the CEO and senior leadership with confidence and specificity.


**Revenue Diversification \& Multi\-BU Governance**
* Govern revenue mix across multiple BUs — actively managing concentration risk and driving healthy diversification.
* Hold per\-BU leads accountable to revenue commitments and go\-to\-market plans through structured governance cadences.
* Lead technology delivery teams with direct accountability for their structure, performance, and outcomes.
* Drive the shift from effort\-based to outcome\-based delivery and leverage AI to improve team and delivery productivity.


**Annual Aspiration Translation \& OKR Governance**
* Translate annual business plans and company goals into measurable OKRs for diverse direct reports across functions.
* Facilitate both top\-down goal cascading and bottom\-up alignment throughout the year.
* Report goal status honestly to CEO and leadership — including when things are off track — and present proactive recovery plans.
* Maintain a regular review cadence that keeps all direct reports aligned to annual commitments.


**People Leadership \& Empowerment**
* Lead through direct reports — not around them. Set clear goals, delegate with genuine freedom, and stay connected without micromanaging.
* Involve the team in key decisions before finalising, especially where they hold more detail than you do.
* Develop direct reports through regular coaching, in\-the\-moment feedback, and structured growth plans.
* Maintain succession plans for critical roles and build trust across both delivery and operations functions.


**Accountability, Resilience \& Communication**
* Take full personal ownership of outcomes — flag problems proactively, always with a recovery plan in hand.
* Stay composed under pressure and stabilise the team rather than passing stress downward.
* Communicate hard truths clearly and directly to the CEO and direct reports without softening the message.
* Build a team environment where problems are raised early — not hidden — through psychological safety and trust.


 REPORTING LINE
   

  

* You will be reporting to the CEO.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in operations or business management.
* Demonstrated ownership of P\&L — revenue and gross margin — across more than one business unit or delivery function simultaneously.
* Direct reports who are themselves managers leading their own teams (not individual contributors).
* Experience governing 2 or more functions simultaneously, each with different KPIs, and holding each lead accountable to outcomes.
* Proven experience leading a technology delivery team with direct accountability for its structure, performance, and outcomes.
* Strong financial acumen — ability to discuss specific margin percentages, utilisation rates, and revenue targets without being prompted.


**Preferred Qualification**
* Experience in a digital product engineering, technology services, or SaaS delivery environment.
* Track record of translating company goals into function\-level OKRs and governing achievement throughout the year.
* Practical experience driving the shift from effort\-based to outcome\-based delivery in technology teams.
* A clear, informed perspective on how AI changes service delivery operations and team productivity.
* Experience presenting consolidated performance reports to a CEO or equivalent — including underperformance and recovery plans — with honesty and clarity.
* An MBA or equivalent post\-graduate qualification is an advantage but not required.


**Perks/Benefits**
* Personalized learning opportunities to enhance your career.
* Competitive salary structure aligned with industry standards.
* Comprehensive health insurance and wellness programs.
* A collaborative and innovative work environment where your ideas are valued.
* Regular team\-building events, company outings, and engaging workplace activities.
* A culture of appreciation with Peer and Spot Recognition programs to celebrate your contributions.

title: Campus Manager
description:
**Job Description:** 




  





**Position Overview:** 




 The Campus Manager is responsible for creating a cohesive campus environment, overseeing travel logistics, managing expenses, coordinating events, and ensuring efficient inhouse operations.
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 




  





**Campus Management:** 



1. Foster an inclusive campus culture that encourages community engagement, student satisfaction, and overall well\-being.
2. Collaborate with departments to organize and oversee campus activities, events, and programs that enhance the student experience.
3. Maintain the campus infrastructure, ensuring safety, cleanliness, and functionality.
4. Develop and enforce campus policies and guidelines to ensure a respectful and harmonious environment.



**Travel Management:** 



1. Coordinate travel arrangements for staff, faculty, and students, including transportation, accommodations, and itineraries.
2. Negotiate with travel vendors to secure cost\-effective solutions while prioritizing quality and comfort.
3. Implement a streamlined system for tracking travel plans, ensuring timely communication and smooth logistics.



**Expense Management:** 



1. Establish and manage an expense tracking system, overseeing budgets, reimbursements, and financial reporting.
2. Review and approve expense reports, ensuring accuracy, adherence to policy, and proper documentation.
3. Identify opportunities for cost savings and recommend resource allocation strategies.



**Event Management:** 



1. Plan, coordinate, and execute various campus events, including workshops, seminars, cultural events, and conferences.
2. Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure successful event logistics, promotion, and participation.
3. Manage event budgets, track expenses, and assess event effectiveness for future improvements.
4. Address and resolve campus\-related concerns or issues promptly while maintaining clear communication.



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Bachelor's degree in business administration, Hospitality, or a related field.
* Proven experience in campus management, travel coordination, expense management, event planning, and hostel management.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to cultivate positive relationships with diverse stakeholders.
* Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities to manage multiple responsibilities concurrently.
* Proficiency in relevant software for expense tracking, travel planning, event management, and communication.
* Understanding of financial principles and budget management.
* Leadership skills to motivate and guide campus staff, fostering a collaborative team environment.

****About WPP Media****
 WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
   

  

 WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
   

  

 At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP \& WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:

* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.

****Role Summary And Impact****

* Lead end\-to\-end planning operations across multiple campaigns, brands, or markets while ensuring consistency in quality, timelines, and strategic output.

title: Senior Manager, Payroll
description:
**Recruitment Fraud Alert**
 We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.
   

  

****What To Know:****
* Commvault does not conduct interviews by email or text.
* We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.


 If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com
   

  

****About Commvault****
 Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) is the gold standard in cyber resilience. The company empowers customers to uncover, take action, and rapidly recover from cyberattacks – keeping data safe and businesses resilient. The company’s unique AI\-powered platform combines best\-in\-class data protection, exceptional data security, advanced data intelligence, and lightning\-fast recovery across any workload or cloud at the lowest TCO. For over 25 years, more than 100,000 organizations and a vast partner ecosystem have relied on Commvault to reduce risks, improve governance, and do more with data.
   

  

**About Commvault**
 Commvault is a worldwide leader in delivering backup and recovery for the progressive enterprise. Commvault enables you to protect, manage, and use your data, while managing it in a consistent, compliant way. Our automated solutions work on\-prem and in the cloud, and work with the digital tools and procedures you’re already using. Keep your data accessible and actionable with a single solution that ensures your data is always available — no matter what.
   

  

 What you will do
   

  

 We are seeking an accomplished Senior Manager \- Payroll to lead end\-to\-end payroll operations across APAC and EMEA. This role will be accountable for accurate, timely, and compliant payroll delivery across multiple countries and will serve as the regional subject matter expert for payroll operations and payroll accounting.
   

  

 The role will partner closely with People Operations, Accounting, Tax, Treasury, Benefits, Legal, Equity Administration, HRIS, and external payroll providers. The successful candidate will combine hands\-on payroll and accounting expertise with strong leadership, controls, vendor governance, and transformation capabilities.
   

  

 How you will make an impact
   

  

 Global Payroll Operations
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end payroll delivery across APAC and EMEA, ensuring each payroll is complete, accurate, approved, funded, and processed within established timelines.
* Oversee regular and off\-cycle payrolls, bonus and commission runs, equity\-related payroll impacts, statutory payments, benefits deductions, and termination settlements.
* Own payroll calendars, input governance, pre\-payroll validations, variance reviews, approval workflows, and post\-payroll controls.
* Serve as the senior escalation point for complex payroll matters and ensure timely resolution of employee, stakeholder, and vendor issues.
* Coordinate payroll activities across countries, time zones, legal entities, and service providers while maintaining consistent global standards.


 Payroll Accounting and Financial Close
   

  

* Own payroll accounting across the assigned countries, including payroll journal entries, general ledger interfaces, account mappings, and posting controls.
* Review payroll\-related accruals and provisions, including salaries, incentives, commissions, employer taxes, benefits, leave, and other employee\-related costs.
* Lead monthly and quarterly balance sheet reconciliations and ensure reconciling items are investigated, documented, and resolved promptly.
* Partner with Accounting during month\-end, quarter\-end, and year\-end close to ensure payroll expenses and liabilities are complete and accurately recorded.
* Provide payroll cost analysis, flux explanations, and supporting schedules for management reporting and audit requirements.
* Partner with Treasury on payroll funding, payment controls, cash requirements, and resolution of rejected or returned payments.


 Compliance, Controls, and Audit
   

  

* Ensure payroll compliance with applicable country requirements relating to tax withholding, social insurance, pensions, employment regulations, statutory benefits, reporting, and remittances.
* Maintain a strong payroll control framework, including segregation of duties, approvals, access controls, change management, reconciliations, and evidence retention.
* Support internal audit, external audit, statutory audit, tax reviews, and SOX or equivalent control testing, as applicable.
* Monitor regulatory changes across APAC and EMEA and coordinate timely updates to payroll processes, systems, and documentation.
* Maintain current payroll policies, standard operating procedures, country playbooks, process maps, control narratives, and business continuity plans.


 Vendor and Stakeholder Management
   

  

* Lead relationships with global and local payroll providers, defining clear accountability for service delivery, issue management, compliance, and continuous improvement.
* Monitor service\-level agreements, accuracy, timeliness, responsiveness, recurring defects, and corrective action plans.
* Partner effectively with People Operations, HRIS, Benefits, Tax, Legal, Equity, Accounting, Treasury, and Finance Systems teams.
* Support new\-country launches, legal entity changes, acquisitions, divestitures, vendor transitions, and payroll system implementations.


 Payroll Transformation, Systems, and Analytics
   

  

* Drive standardization, simplification, automation, and scalable operating practices across regional payroll processes.
* Lead or support payroll technology initiatives, integrations, testing, data validation, vendor migrations, and control enhancements.
* Develop payroll dashboards and operational metrics covering accuracy, timeliness, compliance, cases, controls, vendor performance, and employee experience.
* Analyze root causes of payroll errors and implement sustainable preventive actions.
* Use advanced Excel and reporting tools to perform reconciliations, trend analysis, exception reporting, and management reporting.


 Leadership
   

  

* Lead, coach, and develop regional payroll professionals, setting clear goals, priorities, quality standards, and development plans.
* Build a culture of accountability, controls awareness, continuous improvement, collaboration, and customer service.
* Plan team capacity and provide resilient coverage for payroll deadlines, close cycles, audits, and critical projects.
* Communicate payroll risks, decisions, performance, and transformation priorities clearly to Finance and People leadership.


 What you need to be successful
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance.
* Minimum 10 years of progressive payroll experience, including substantial responsibility for multi\-country payroll operations across APAC and EMEA.
* At least 6 years of people leadership experience, with demonstrated capability to lead and develop payroll professionals.
* Strong payroll accounting knowledge, including journal entries, accruals, general ledger interfaces, balance sheet reconciliations, payroll liabilities, and financial close requirements.
* Demonstrated knowledge of multi\-country payroll compliance, statutory reporting, employment taxes, and governance requirements.
* Experience managing outsourced payroll providers and operating within a matrixed global organization.
* Experience supporting internal controls and audit requirements in a controlled finance environment.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel capability and strong analytical, problem\-solving, and project management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and explain complex payroll matters clearly.
* Ability to manage competing priorities, confidential information, and critical deadlines across multiple time zones.


**Preferred Qualifications And Experience**
* CA, CPA, CMA, MBA (Finance), or an equivalent professional qualification.
* Experience in a publicly listed, multinational, technology, SaaS, or high\-growth organization.
* Hands\-on experience with Workday and one or more global payroll platforms or service providers, together with ERP system such as NetSuite.
* Experience with payroll transformation, global payroll consolidation, system implementation, vendor migration, or operating model redesign.
* Experience with equity compensation, mobility, acquisitions, new\-country implementation, and cross\-border payroll matters.


 You'll love working here because...
   

  

* Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing.

description:

 Texas Instruments (TI) is looking for an energetic, service minded leader, who enjoys helping others to succeed by providing team members and clients with motivation and support in a positive and professional work environment as a Program Management Engineer. We are seeking a highly motivated individual who will challenge teammates to achieve flawless execution goals, while maintaining strong working relationships. Success in this role is measured by the ability to grow the number of new products and drive the forecasted return on investment.
   

  

**Responsibilities Include**
* Lead a cross functional team on the execution of releasing new products and ensuring successful return on investment for every development; the team consists of Design, Marketing, Systems\& Applications, Validation, Product\& Test Engineering, Firmware/Software Engineering, Manufacturing, Field, and Quality

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Please note that we will only be able to accept candidates who have the appropriate rights and documentation for employment in India.
   

  

**Who We Are.**
 Axi is a leading global provider of margin and deliverable Foreign Exchange, Contracts for Difference (CFDs), and Financial Spread betting. Our business has evolved into a world\-class, multifaceted brokerage with offices in six regions. With heavy investment in the latest trading technology, Axi seeks to offer the most comprehensive end\-to\-end trading experience available, servicing traders of all levels from beginners to institutional\-level clients.
   

  

**Let's talk about the cool stuff you will do at Axi!**
 We are looking for an experienced
 **Delivery Manager** 
 to drive the successful delivery of strategic technology initiatives across our global engineering teams. You will be responsible for owning the delivery lifecycle from planning through execution, ensuring projects are delivered on time, at the highest quality, and with predictable outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast\-growing fintech organization where you'll lead transformation initiatives, partner with cross\-functional stakeholders across global regions, and leverage modern technologies and AI\-driven tools to continuously improve delivery excellence.
   

  

**Your EDGE Assignment / You Will**
**Delivery Cadence**
* Define, document, and continuously improve the team's delivery cadence — sprint/iteration length, ceremony schedule (planning, refinement, review, retro), and reporting rhythm.
* Ensure the cadence is followed: ceremonies happen on schedule, with the right people, producing real decisions.
* Adapt cadence to the needs of different workstreams (e.g., a fast\-moving feature team vs. a compliance\-heavy workstream) without fragmenting the organisation into inconsistent processes.


**Stage Gate Ownership**
* Own the criteria for moving work between stages (e.g., Discovery → Ready for Build → In Progress → Review → Release) and enforce them consistently.
* Act as the checkpoint before work advances: confirm acceptance criteria are met, dependencies are cleared, risk/compliance sign\-offs are in hand, and Definition of Done is completed.
* Act when something is not ready and explain exactly what is missing and what is needed to pass the gate.
* Track and report exceptions/waivers when a gate is bypassed and ensure it is a deliberate decision.


**Delivery Planning**
* Build delivery plans grounded in real data: backlog sizing (story points/estimates), team velocity history, known dependencies, and risk.
* Convert scope and velocity into realistic timelines and communicate them as ranges with clear assumptions and confidence levels.
* Re\-forecast the plan on a regular cadence (e.g., every sprint) as scope, velocity, or risk changes, and proactively flag slippage.
* Maintain visibility tools (burnup/burndown, roadmap views, RAID logs) that let stakeholders self\-serve status.


**Cross\-Team Coordination \& Reporting**
* Be the primary point of contact for delivery status to leadership and stakeholders — translating team\-level detail into a clear picture of progress, risk, and trade\-offs.
* Identify and actively manage cross\-team dependencies, blockers, and resourcing conflicts before they hit the critical path.
* Facilitate trade\-off conversations (scope vs. time vs. quality) with data.


**Process Ownership \& Continuous Improvement**
* Own the delivery process documentation (workflow stages, gate criteria, estimation method, ceremony structure) and keep it current, e.g. in Confluence.
* Run retrospectives that produce real process changes.
* Balance rigor with pragmatism — add process where it removes risk or ambiguity and remove process if not needed.


**Are you the one?**
* 8\+ years in a Delivery Manager, Scrum Master, Program Manager, or Technical Project Manager role, ideally spanning multiple teams or workstreams.
* Demonstrated experience running Agile/Scrum (or Kanban/hybrid) delivery cadences end\-to\-end — not just attending ceremonies but designing and improving them.
* Hands\-on experience with story\-point estimation, velocity tracking, and forecasting delivery timelines from that data.
* Proven ability to hold a line on process/quality gates under deadline pressure, with the communication skill to do so without becoming a bottleneck or being seen as purely a blocker.
* Strong stakeholder management — comfortable presenting status, risk, and trade\-offs to senior leadership.
* Fluency with delivery tooling (Jira, Confluence, or equivalent) and building reporting views (burnup/burndown, roadmaps, dashboards) that reduce manual status\-chasing.
* Hands\-on exposure to tools such as Postman and Datadog, with an interest in leveraging AI to improve delivery and operational efficiency.
* Proven experience delivering technology transformation initiatives, including system migrations, process transitions, or Global Capability Centre (GCC) setup and transition projects.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to turn ambiguous, fast\-moving work into a clear plan and a clear narrative.


**Preferred Skills**
* Experience in \[industry — e.g., fintech, trading platforms, regulated environments], particularly where compliance/risk sign\-off is part of the stage\-gate process.
* Certification such as CSM, PSM, SAFe, or PMP (useful signal, not a substitute for hands\-on experience).
* Experience introducing or maturing a delivery process in an organization that didn't previously have one.


**Axi's bag of delights**
* Competitive and attractive compensation.
* Extensive learning opportunities including professional certifications and soft\-skills development.
* 18 annual leave days and 12 sick leave days per year.
* Public holidays as declared by local government.
* Maternity leave as per law.
* Health insurance coverage.


**Axi's interview journey**
* Talent Acquisition Round – 45 Minutes
* Hiring Manager Interview – 1 Hour
* Final Interview – 1 Hour


 Please note that our organization works with recruitment agencies on a pre\-approved basis only. A recruitment agency that wishes to submit candidate profiles or resumes for consideration must obtain prior written consent from our talent acquisition team. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, and we will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Should we receive an unsolicited resume from a recruitment agency that does not have prior written consent, we will not be responsible for the payment of any fees related to the recruitment of the candidate represented in the unsolicited resume.
   

  

 At Axi, we prioritize creating a workplace that upholds fairness and respect for all. We encourage every individual within our community to contribute towards a culture where everyone feels a sense of belonging and is treated with the dignity they deserve. We make all employment\-related decisions—whether in hiring, compensation, training, performance reviews, or termination—based on merit and without bias, ensuring equal opportunities for everyone. We consciously work to identify and overcome any unconscious biases, with a commitment to fostering an inclusive environment where every employee and candidate feels genuinely welcomed and valued.

title: Founders Office
description:
**Founder's Office – Offline Sales \& Business Growth** 

  
 



**Lumov \| Bengaluru \| Full\-time \| In\-office** 




  




**About Lumov** 

 Lumov is a venture\-backed healthcare startup building India's leading pain management and orthopaedic solutions brand. Our portfolio spans orthopaedic supports, rehabilitation products, mobility aids and everyday wellness solutions, serving consumers through hospitals, distributors, retail and leading e\-commerce platforms.
 



 Founded by
 **Harvard Business School** 
 and
 **IIT Kharagpur** 
 alumni with deep investing experience in Indian healthcare, Lumov offers an opportunity to build a category\-defining healthcare company from the ground up in a fast\-paced, ownership\-driven environment.
 


**About the Role** 

 This is a Founder's Office position built around one core mandate:
 **own and build Lumov's offline sales business end\-to\-end, working directly alongside the founder.** 




 You won't be handed a playbook \- you'll help write it. This role is for someone who wants to learn what it actually takes to build a business: not just execute a function, but sit close enough to the decisions to understand
 *why* 
 they're made. Over time, expect exposure across hiring, planning, forecasting, and the broader strategic and operating questions that come with growing a company.
 



 Having a, analytical problem solving mindset is extremely critical with a zeal to execute and delivery results.
 



  




**What You'll Do** 

  
 



**Offline Sales – Build \& Run** 



* Design and stand up the offline sales function from scratch: territory approach, channel mix, distribution/retail partnerships
* Hire, train, and manage the on\-ground sales team as it's built out
* Visit distributors, channel partners, customers PAN India to build the business out
* Work on holistic business from hiring to tracking, performance management, sales \& business operations, etc.

* Set and own targets \- business planning, forecasting, and performance tracking
* Run a regular review cadence (yourself and with the founder) \- what's working, what's not, and why
* Troubleshoot in the field when needed \- this is a build role, not a spreadsheet\-only role



**Founder's Office – Broader Scope** 



* Partner with the founder on overall business decisions beyond your core sales mandate

**Who You Are** 
* 2\+ years of experience, ideally in a startup \- operating roles, growth, sales, or general management

* From a strong college/institute (open to newer\-tier IIMs / IITs and equivalent programs)
* High ownership, low ego \- comfortable being told "figure it out" and actually figuring it out
* Genuinely hungry to learn entrepreneurship from the inside, not just draw a title

**Compensation** 
* Competitive CTC
* Super\-normal performance\-linked bonus on top of fixed, tied to sales targets achieved
* ESOPs, vesting tied to tenure and performance (eligible after probation)


**Why Join** 

 You'll be one of the first people building Lumov's offline business, working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with the founder rather than several layers removed. If you do this well, you're not just running a function \- you're learning how to build a company, with a real stake (via ESOPs) in the outcome.

**hr@acontor.in**

title: VP - Business Manager
description:
**Job Title: VP\- Business Manager**
 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected, and opinions count. We foster continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. As part of the Risk \& Compliance (R\&C) function, you’ll play a vital role in supporting HSBC’s second line of defence, ensuring robust risk management and operational excellence across the Group.
   

  

 The Risk \& Compliance (R\&C) function is HSBC’s Second Line of Defence, responsible for reviewing and challenging the activities of the Group’s businesses to ensure effective risk management. With a global headcount of \~14,000 and annual costs of \~$1\.5bn, R\&C is evolving its operating model, requiring robust oversight, administration, and management. This role is pivotal in supporting the R\&C CAO CoE, driving operational excellence, and enabling strategic objectives in a dynamic, highly scrutinized environment. The role holder needs to understand the impact of all these changes on Risk \& Compliance and HSBC and support the Global R\&C COO, Global R\&C CAO and Head CAO CoE as necessary. The role holder will be required to interact with many internal and external parties at the highest level of management and therefore needs an outstanding level of professionalism and gravitas. As a Senior Business Manager within the R\&C C oE, you will be a strategic partner to Lines of Business and Global R\&C Sub\-functions, helping leaders turn centrally produced financial, workforce and performance data into clear decisions and practical action. You will connect insight with business context, identify risks and opportunities, generate ideas to improve performance and help shape priorities across the function. Reporting to the R\&C Head of CAO CoE India, you will work with global, regional and business stakeholders to translate information into a compelling performance story, challenge assumptions and coordinate delivery. Financial analysis and tracking remain important; however, the core data and reporting are produced centrally. Your value will come from interpreting what the data means, asking the right questions and enabling timely, well\-informed choices.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine strong business judgement, curiosity and influencing skills with an understanding of risk management and organisational performance. They will be comfortable leading a team, navigating a global matrix and moving stakeholders from insight to action.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
 The role holder will share good practice globally, lead a team and build trusted relationships across the function. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Partner with the Global R\&C CAO wider team and senior leaders to understand priorities, performance and delivery challenges across assigned Lines of Business and Global Sub\-functions. Use centrally produced financial, workforce and performance information to build a clear view of what is changing, why it matters and where leadership action is required.
* Identify trends, risks, opportunities and emerging themes, connecting information across teams to generate ideas for improved performance, effectiveness and service delivery. Challenge assumptions and test whether plans, resources and investments remain aligned to business priorities.
* Use scenario analysis to explore choices, trade\-offs and potential outcomes for the relevant Sub\-function or Line of Business.
* Support decisions on consultancy, third\-party spend, hiring and out\-of\-plan requirements by assessing business need, value and alignment to priorities. Track agreed actions and outcomes, helping leaders understand whether interventions are delivering the intended impact.
* Support senior leaders across Lines of Business and Sub\-functions with integrated business management covering performance, people, priorities, governance and organisational effectiveness. Create clear leadership narratives from centrally produced Management Information, focusing discussion on decisions, actions and opportunities rather than reporting alone.
* Coordinate business planning and governance rhythms, ensuring priorities, dependencies and actions remain visible and connected. Coordinate and execute the business change and organisational design activity required to deliver the agreed financial resource plan, across both cost and FTE
* Build trusted relationships with R\&C leadership and partners across the Global Businesses, Global Functions, Finance and HR. Facilitate constructive, evidence\-based conversations that help stakeholders align on priorities and make timely decisions.
* Bring together perspectives from global and regional stakeholders to spot themes, share learning and scale effective ideas. Provide constructive challenge to existing practices and proposed initiatives, developing practical solutions to complex issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve value, simplify activity and redirect resources to the areas of greatest strategic importance.
* Lead, coach and develop direct reports, creating clear priorities and promoting curiosity, collaboration and high\-quality delivery. Support effective performance, talent and succession management across the team


**To Be Successful You Will**
**Knowledge \& Qualifications**
* Strong understanding of business management, organisational performance and strategy execution.
* Ability to interpret financial, workforce and operational information and connect it to business context and decisions. Sound understanding of the external banking environment, including regulatory, political and competitive factors.
* Strong awareness of internal control, operational risk and the role of Risk \& Compliance.
* Awareness of data governance and the importance of reliable, consistent information for decision\-making. Demonstrated success in using business, financial, workforce or operational insight to influence senior decisions and improve outcomes. Experience turning complex data and competing viewpoints into clear narratives, options and recommendations.
* Proven ability to identify opportunities, generate practical ideas and lead performance or organisational improvement.
* Experience working with central Finance, HR or data teams and applying their outputs within a business context.
* Strong stakeholder management experience in a complex, global matrix organisation. Experience shaping and delivering people, capability or engagement plans across diverse teams.
* Experience coordinating and executing business change and organisational design activity to deliver cost and FTE plans. Strategic and commercial judgement, with the ability to connect insight to business priorities. Intellectual curiosity and confidence asking questions that uncover the story behind the data.
* Ability to spot patterns, risks and opportunities and develop practical ideas in response.
* Excellent communication, storytelling and influencing skills, including with senior stakeholders. Strong leadership, collaboration and facilitation skills.
* Comfort interpreting data and scenarios without needing to own the underlying financial production processes.
* Proactive, resilient and effective in a fast\-moving international environment. Outstanding organisational and problem management skills, and extensive project and programme management exposure


**hsbc.com/careers
   

  

 You’ll achieve more at HSBC**
 HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

title: Director Guest Service Center
description:

 Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Target is an iconic brand, a Fortune 50 company and one of America's leading retailers.
   

  

 Target Enterprise Services (TES) is close to the action when it comes to supporting guests, team members and enterprise partners. Through our Service Centers, we deliver exceptional experiences, resolve complex issues, generate business insights and help shape enterprise decisions that improve the end\-to\-end guest journey.

 As a Director, Service Center, you will lead a large\-scale service center operation while serving as a strategic voice for the guest across the enterprise.  differentiated and connected guest experiences.

 boundaries.

 transformation efforts.

title: Chief of Staff
description:

We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.
   

  

 Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.
   

  

 Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.
   

  

**eBay Bengaluru is looking for an experienced, motivated, highly organized, and adaptable individual with a consistent record as chief of staff and a strong background as technical program manager to join the eBay Bengaluru Innovation hub to help define and drive the eBay Bengaluru vision, establish strong operational approach and lead TPM organization.**
**Your objective is to define the eBay Bengaluru vision and roadmap, as well as build and drive the Organizational Operating System. You will be the force multiplier who ensures the organization is highly aligned and comes true to its vision. You will ensure our site strategy, multi\-million dollar financial allocations, and technical roadmaps are synchronized and optimized. You aren't here to facilitate the process—you are here to own and evolve it.**
**The
 **Responsibilities****
****1\. Define and own ebay Bengaluru vision and roadmap****
* eBay Bengaluru vision and mission: Take ownership of eBay Bengaluru vision, establish long term roadmap and YoY goals to achieve the vision.
* Success Metrics: Collaborate to define success metrics and operationalize operational rigor to track, manage progress towards goals.
* eBay Bengaluru Initiatives: Drive various eBay Bengaluru initiatives which helps establish the innovation attitude rooted in eBay culture. Establish engineering and operational excellence and drive AI transformation across the organization.
* Establish Financial and site operations governance:
* Site governance: Own and establish metrics and goals across people and site operational metrics and establish weekly, monthly and quarterly reviews and executive updates.
* Financial governance: Collaborate with the finance leadership to establish financial controls and operationalize compliance.
* return on investment Analysis: Develop standardized tracking for the business impact of our investments, providing the eBay Bengaluru GM and team members with a clear "Value\-per\-Dollar" view of our cloud and platform spend.
* Technical Program Management:
* Establish TPM function in eBay Bengaluru: Own the responsibility to define the TPM org in Bengaluru with clear expectations, ways of working, culture and hiring bar, demonstrating standard methodologies across eBay.
* Accountable to project management and deliver impact: Own and drive various large and sophisticated technical projects spanning cross organization and cross geographies. Own and drive various initiatives for continuous upskilling and AI transformation in what we do and how we do.
* Operational Excellence \& Reliability
* Value Stream Mapping: Apply Lean methodologies to visualize our engineering workflows. You will proactively detect bottlenecks, identify "waste" in our processes, and implement systemic fixes to increase engineering velocity.
* Engineering/Product Excellence: Collaborate with team members to establish common standards for engineering and operational excellence, including roadmap and project management, establish mechanisms to ensure the team is operating with high bar and as a one integrated eBay team.

**Who

title: Director, IT Operations
description:
At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.
   

  

 For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off\-the\-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we’re building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on.
   

  

 Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We’re a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.
   

  

**Title** 
 : Director, IT Operations
   

  

**Reporting to** 
 : VP, CISO
   

  

**Location** 
 : Bangalore
   

  

**Department** 
 : Information Technology
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Director of Information Technology leads the strategy, delivery, and improvement of internal technology services for a global SaaS company. The role covers employee technology experience, service management, infrastructure, cloud, networking, identity, selected business applications, portfolio governance, vendors and licensing, and business continuity and disaster recovery.
   

  

 This is a strategic player\-coach role that develops a capable service organization while remaining able to lead major incidents, review architecture and configurations, diagnose complex issues, and perform targeted technical work. The Director partners with the CISO and other leaders on cybersecurity, compliance, data governance, and responsible AI. Security, privacy, resilience, data protection, and responsible AI are expected considerations in every service, project, purchase, and operational decision. The role supports corporate IT and does not own the customer\-facing SaaS production platform.
   

  

**Key Outcomes**
* Higher stakeholder confidence and satisfaction through clear service ownership, performance measures, and executive communication.
* More stable, measurable IT services with fewer high\-impact recurring incidents.
* An approved, business\-aligned IT strategy and roadmap covering architecture, investment, risk, capacity, and workforce needs.
* A rationalized project and application portfolio focused on the highest\-value work.
* Responsible AI adoption supported by practical governance, workforce enablement, data safeguards, and measurable value.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, engineering, business, or a related field; equivalent directly relevant experience may be substituted.
* Ten to twelve years of progressive IT experience, including at least five years leading managers or multidisciplinary technical teams.
* Broad internal IT leadership experience across service delivery, end\-user technology, cloud, infrastructure, networking, identity, endpoints, collaboration, and selected enterprise applications in a distributed environment.
* Demonstrated success with IT strategy, service management, project and application portfolio governance, budgets, vendors, licensing, workforce planning, and executive communication.
* Experience partnering with security leadership on controls, risk remediation, audit support, incident response, business continuity, and disaster recovery.
* Technical depth to review architecture and configurations, diagnose complex failures, lead major incidents, and use scripting or automation without becoming the routine systems administrator.
* Practical experience with responsible AI or automation governance and enablement; M\&A or major integration experience is strongly preferred.
* Leadership experience in a SaaS or technology company and familiarity with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Azure, Workday, Jira, Netskope, SentinelOne, ChatGPT, Claude, or comparable platforms are preferred. Relevant ITIL, PMP, security, cloud, or AI governance certifications are helpful but not required.


**Core Competencies**
 Strategic thinking and business alignment; executive communication and stakeholder management; service ownership; technical judgment; people leadership and delegation; cybersecurity, risk, privacy, and resilience; responsible AI and data judgment; financial and vendor acumen; and global, cross\-cultural collaboration.
   

  

**Working Conditions**
* Needs collaboration across United States, Bulgaria, and India time zones.
* Expected to be reachable through the company paging process for major incidents and executive escalations.
* Occasional domestic and international travel may be required. This description summarizes the primary responsibilities of the role and may be adjusted as business needs change. Reasonable accommodations may be made for qualified individuals with disabilities.


**How We Think About AI**
 At Quickbase, we view AI as a tool to accelerate how work gets done — not replace it. We encourage thoughtful use of AI to improve speed, quality, and decision\-making, while maintaining strong judgment, accountability, and data integrity.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Statement**
 Quickbase is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply – even if you don’t meet every qualification listed. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

* Night Shift Allowance
* Hybrid Work Allowance
* Mobile and Internet Allowance
* Meal Benefit
* Office Transportation
* On\-Call Weekend Allowance
* Weekend Working Allowance
* Employee Referral Bonus

 Key job responsibilities

* You are accountable for the overall strategy of a large program. You successfully manage all stages (from concept to delivery). Your program meets business goals and/or shows measurable improvements in your customer’s experience, business or employee efficiency or execution, compliance adherence, financial or other metrics, etc.

You influence team priorities and business strategy through data\-supported contributions. You are able to make a case for project priorities, resource allocation, and/or appropriate program adoption, to achieve a desired business outcome, resolve a technical deficiency, or unblock delivery.

You foster a constructive dialogue, harmonize discordant views, and lead the resolution of contentious issues (build consensus). You partner successfully with customers, stakeholders, and engineering teams.
